        final qs = data['questions'];
        if (qs is List) return qs;

  PracticeQuestion _localQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int index) {
    final topic = filter.topicLabel.toLowerCase();
    final subject = filter.subject.toLowerCase();

    if (_mentions(subject, const ['computer science', 'cs', 'programming']) &&
        _mentions(topic, const [
          'condition',
          'conditions',
          'conditional',
          'if',
          'else',
          'branch',
          'branching',
          'boolean',
        ])) {
      final a = 2 + (index % 4);
      final b = 1 + ((index * 3) % 4);
      final truth = a > b;
      return PracticeQuestion(
        id: 'fallback-cs-cond-$index',
        subject: filter.subject,
        topicLabel: filter.topicLabel,
        mode: filter.mode,
        difficulty: filter.difficulty,
        prompt:
            'What does this print?\n\nint a = $a;\nint b = $b;\nif (a > b) {\n  print("A");\n} else {\n  print("B");\n}',
        options: const ['A', 'B', 'Nothing', 'Error'],
        correctIndex: truth ? 0 : 1,
        explanation: truth
            ? 'a is greater than b, so the if branch runs.'
            : 'a is not greater than b, so the else branch runs.',
        recommendedTimeSeconds: filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? 30,
      );
    }

    final x = 2 + index;
    final y = x * 3 + 1;

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: 'fallback-$index',
      subject: filter.subject,
      topicLabel: filter.topicLabel,
      mode: filter.mode,
      difficulty: filter.difficulty,
      prompt: 'Compute 3 * $x + 1.',
      options: ['$y', '${y + 1}', '${y - 1}', '${x + 1}'],
      correctIndex: 0,
      explanation: '3 * $x + 1 = $y.',
      recommendedTimeSeconds: filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? 20,
    );
  }

  bool _mentions(String haystack, List<String> needles) {
    final h = haystack.toLowerCase();
    for (final n in needles) {
      if (h.contains(n)) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  String? _asString(Object? v) {
    if (v == null) return null;
    if (v is String) return v;
    return v.toString();
  }

  List<String> _asStringList(Object? v) {
    if (v is List) {
      return v
          .map((e) => e.toString())
          .where((e) => e.trim().isNotEmpty)
          .toList(growable: false);
    }
    return const [];
  }

  int? _asInt(Object? v) {
    if (v is int) return v;
    if (v is num) return v.toInt();
    if (v is String) return int.tryParse(v);
    return null;
  }

import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    final sessionSalt = DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.abs();
    var seed = _seedFromFilter(filter) + sessionSalt;
    var attempts = 0;
    final maxAttempts = count * 90;

    while (out.length < count && attempts < maxAttempts) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 17 + attempts * 11),
        filter,
        seed + attempts,
      );
      attempts++;
      if (used.add(_fingerprint(q))) {
        out.add(q);
      }
    }

    while (out.length < count) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 29),
        filter,
        seed + out.length * 13,
      );
      out.add(
        PracticeQuestion(
          id: '${q.id}-${out.length}-${sessionSalt % 100000}',
          subject: q.subject,
          topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
          mode: q.mode,
          difficulty: q.difficulty,
          prompt: q.prompt,
          options: q.options,
          correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
          explanation: q.explanation,
          recommendedTimeSeconds: q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
        ),
      );
    }

    return out;
  }

  PracticeQuestion _postProcessMode(
    PracticeQuestion q,
    PracticeFilter filter,
    int seed,
  ) {
    final decoratedPrompt = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards =>
        'Flashcard\nRemember first, reveal second.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Speed round\nAnswer fast.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep =>
        'Bagrut-style / exam-style\nRead carefully and choose precisely.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder =>
        'Concept builder\nUnderstand the rule, then solve.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive =>
        'Adaptive mode\nThe session can shift in pace and level.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.bagrut =>
        'Bagrut-style\nSolve like a formal school exam question.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.prompt,
    };

    final decoratedExplanation = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => 'Flashcard review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Fast review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep => 'Exam reasoning: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => 'Concept walkthrough: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive => 'Adaptive feedback: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.bagrut => 'Bagrut reasoning: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.explanation,
    };

    final adjustedTime = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 6,
      PracticeMode.speedRound => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 10,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 12,
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 8,
      PracticeMode.adaptive => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
      PracticeMode.bagrut => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 16,
      PracticeMode.practice => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
    };

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: '${q.id}-${seed.abs() % 10000}',
      subject: q.subject,
      topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
      mode: q.mode,
      difficulty: q.difficulty,
      prompt: decoratedPrompt,
      options: q.options,
      correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
      explanation: decoratedExplanation,
      recommendedTimeSeconds: adjustedTime < 8 ? 8 : adjustedTime,
    );
  }

  PracticeQuestion _buildQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int seed) {
    final subject = _norm(filter.subject);
    final topicLabel = filter.topicPath.isEmpty
        ? 'General'
        : filter.topicPath.join(' • ');
    final generatorNote = _norm(filter.generatorNote);
    final topic = _norm('$topicLabel $generatorNote');

    if (_isCS(subject) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, [
          'civics',
          'citizenship',
          'government',
          'democracy',
        ]) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, ['history']) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, ['geography']) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, ['literature', 'adab'])) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'if',
        'if statement',
        'if statements',
        'condition',
        'conditions',
        'conditional',
        'branch',
        'else',
        'boolean',
      ])) {
        return _csIfStatements(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['loop', 'loops', 'for', 'while', 'iteration'])) {
        return _csLoops(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['variable', 'variables', 'assignment', 'operator'])) {
        return _csVariables(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['big o', 'complexity', 'algorithm'])) {
        return _csComplexity(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'array',
        'arrays',
        'stack',
        'queue',
        'tree',
        'map',
      ])) {
        return _csDataStructures(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _csMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isMath(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'geometry',
        'triangle',
        'circle',
        'angle',
        'rectangle',
        'perimeter',
        'area',
      ])) {
        return _mathGeometry(filter, topicLabel, seed);

      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'function',

        'algebra',
        'equation',
        'linear',

      ])) {
        return _mathAlgebra(filter, topicLabel, seed);

        return _mathProbability(filter, topicLabel, seed);

    if (_isPhysics(subject)) {

    if (_isEnglish(subject)) {

===== apps/classmate_mobile/lib/features/practice/data/practice_generator.dart.ai-remote.1773165534.bak =====
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  static const String _apiBaseUrl = String.fromEnvironment(
    'CM_API_BASE_URL',
    defaultValue: 'http://127.0.0.1:3001',
  );

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    try {
      final remote = await _generateViaApi(filter);
      if (remote.isNotEmpty) return remote;
    } catch (_) {}
    return generateFallback(filter);
  }

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generateFallback(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = max(1, filter.questionCount);
    final seedBase = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
    final used = <String>{};
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];

    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      var attempts = 0;
      PracticeQuestion q = _generateOne(filter, seedBase + i * 9973, i);

      while (attempts < 8) {
        final fp = _fingerprint(q);
        if (!used.contains(fp)) {
          used.add(fp);
          break;
        }
        attempts++;
        q = _generateOne(filter, seedBase + i * 9973 + attempts * 131, i);
      }

      out.add(q);
    }

    return out;
  }

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> _generateViaApi(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final client = HttpClient()..connectionTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 8);
    try {
      final uri = Uri.parse('$_apiBaseUrl/practice/generate');
      final req = await client.postUrl(uri);
      req.headers.contentType = ContentType.json;
      req.write(
        jsonEncode({
          'subject': filter.subject,
          'topicPath': filter.topicPath,
          'topicLabel': filter.topicLabel,
          'mode': filter.mode.name,
          'difficulty': filter.difficulty.name,
          'questionCount': filter.questionCount,
          'timePreferenceSeconds': filter.timePreferenceSeconds,
          'useAiTiming': filter.useAiTiming,
          'maxLives': filter.maxLives,
        }),
      );

      final res = await req.close();
      final body = await utf8.decodeStream(res);

      if (res.statusCode < 200 || res.statusCode >= 300) {
        throw HttpException(
          'practice generate ${res.statusCode}: $body',
          uri: uri,
        );
      }

      final decoded = jsonDecode(body);
      final rawQuestions = decoded is List
          ? decoded
          : (decoded is Map<String, dynamic> ? decoded['questions'] : null);

      if (rawQuestions is! List) return const [];

      final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
      for (var i = 0; i < rawQuestions.length; i++) {
        final q = rawQuestions[i];
        if (q is! Map) continue;

        final map = Map<String, dynamic>.from(q as Map);
        final options =
            (map['options'] as List?)
                ?.map((e) => '$e')
                .where((e) => e.trim().isNotEmpty)
                .toList() ??
            const <String>[];

        var correctIndex = map['correctIndex'] is int
            ? map['correctIndex'] as int
            : -1;
        final correctText = map['correct']?.toString();
        if (correctIndex < 0 && correctText != null && options.isNotEmpty) {
          correctIndex = options.indexOf(correctText);
        }
        if (correctIndex < 0 && options.isNotEmpty) correctIndex = 0;

        if (options.isEmpty) continue;

        out.add(
          PracticeQuestion(
            id:
                map['id']?.toString() ??
                _id(filter.subject, filter.topicLabel, i, body.hashCode),
            subject: map['subject']?.toString() ?? filter.subject,
            topicLabel: map['topicLabel']?.toString() ?? filter.topicLabel,
            mode: _parseMode(map['mode']?.toString()) ?? filter.mode,
            difficulty:
                _parseDifficulty(map['difficulty']?.toString()) ??
                filter.difficulty,
            prompt: map['prompt']?.toString() ?? 'Solve the question.',
            options: options,
            correctIndex: correctIndex.clamp(0, options.length - 1),
            explanation:
                map['explanation']?.toString() ??
                'Review the correct option carefully.',
            recommendedTimeSeconds:
                _asInt(map['recommendedTimeSeconds']) ?? _timeFor(filter),
          ),
        );
      }

      return out;
    } finally {
      client.close(force: true);
    }
  }

  PracticeQuestion _generateOne(PracticeFilter filter, int seed, int index) {
    final subject = _norm(filter.subject);
    final topic = _norm(filter.topicLabel);

    if (_subjectMentionsAny(subject, [
      'computer science',
      'cs',
      'programming',
    ])) {
      if (_topicMentionsAny(topic, [
        'condition',
        'conditions',
        'conditional',
        'if',
        'else',
        'branch',
        'branching',
        'boolean',
      ])) {
        return _csConditionsAccurate(filter, filter.topicLabel, seed, index);
      }

      if (_topicMentionsAny(topic, [
        'big o',
        'complexity',
        'time complexity',
      ])) {
        return _csBigOAccurate(filter, filter.topicLabel, seed, index);
      }

      return _csConditionsAccurate(filter, filter.topicLabel, seed, index);
    }

    if (_subjectMentionsAny(subject, ['math', 'mathematics'])) {
      if (_topicMentionsAny(topic, ['quadratic', 'parabola', 'trinomial'])) {
        return _mathQuadraticAccurate(filter, filter.topicLabel, seed, index);
      }
      if (_topicMentionsAny(topic, [
        'linear',
        'line',
        'slope',
        'affine',
        'y = mx',
      ])) {
        return _mathLinearAccurate(filter, filter.topicLabel, seed, index);
      }
      return _mathLinearAccurate(filter, filter.topicLabel, seed, index);
    }

    if (_subjectMentionsAny(subject, ['physics'])) {
      return _physicsForcesAccurate(filter, filter.topicLabel, seed, index);
    }

    return _genericAccurate(filter, filter.topicLabel, seed, index);
  }

===== apps/classmate_mobile/lib/features/practice/data/practice_generator.dart.ai-rewrite.1773165247.bak =====
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generateFallback(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final count = filter.questionCount < 1 ? 1 : filter.questionCount;
    final topicLabel = filter.topicLabel;

    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      out.add(
        _generateOne(
          filter,
          DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch + i * 9973,
          i,
        ),
      );
    }

    return out;
  }

  static const String _baseUrl = String.fromEnvironment(
    'CM_API_BASE_URL',
    defaultValue: 'http://127.0.0.1:3001',
  );

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final uri = Uri.parse('$_baseUrl/practice/generate');
    final client = HttpClient();

    try {
      final request = await client.postUrl(uri);
      request.headers.set(HttpHeaders.contentTypeHeader, 'application/json');
      request.add(
        utf8.encode(
          jsonEncode({
            'subject': filter.subject,
            'topicPath': filter.topicPath,
            'questionCount': filter.questionCount,
            'mode': filter.mode.name,
            'difficulty': filter.difficulty.name,
            'timePreferenceSeconds': filter.timePreferenceSeconds,
            'useAiTiming': filter.useAiTiming,
            'maxLives': filter.maxLives,
          }),
        ),
      );

      final response = await request.close();
      final body = await response.transform(utf8.decoder).join();

      if (response.statusCode < 200 || response.statusCode >= 300) {
        throw Exception(
          'Practice generation failed (${response.statusCode}): $body',
        );
      }

      final decoded = jsonDecode(body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
      final raw = (decoded['questions'] as List?) ?? const [];

      return raw
          .map((e) {
            final m = Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map);
            return PracticeQuestion(
              id: (m['id'] ?? '').toString(),
              subject: (m['subject'] ?? filter.subject).toString(),
              topicLabel: (m['topicLabel'] ?? filter.topicLabel).toString(),
              mode: _parseMode((m['mode'] ?? filter.mode.name).toString()),
              difficulty: _parseDifficulty(
                (m['difficulty'] ?? filter.difficulty.name).toString(),
              ),
              prompt: (m['prompt'] ?? '').toString(),
              options: ((m['options'] as List?) ?? const [])
                  .map((x) => x.toString())
                  .toList(growable: false),
              correctIndex: (m['correctIndex'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
              explanation: (m['explanation'] ?? '').toString(),
              recommendedTimeSeconds:
                  (m['recommendedTimeSeconds'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 30,
            );
          })
          .toList(growable: false);
    } finally {
      client.close(force: true);
    }
  }

  PracticeMode _parseMode(String value) {
    switch (value) {
      case 'flashcards':
        return PracticeMode.flashcards;
      case 'speedRound':
        return PracticeMode.speedRound;
      case 'examPrep':
        return PracticeMode.examPrep;
      case 'conceptBuilder':
        return PracticeMode.conceptBuilder;
      case 'adaptive':
        return PracticeMode.adaptive;
      case 'practice':
      default:
        return PracticeMode.practice;
    }
  }

  PracticeDifficulty _parseDifficulty(String value) {
    switch (value) {
      case 'easy':
        return PracticeDifficulty.easy;
      case 'hard':
        return PracticeDifficulty.hard;
      case 'olympiad':
        return PracticeDifficulty.olympiad;
      case 'adaptive':
        return PracticeDifficulty.adaptive;
      case 'medium':
      default:
        return PracticeDifficulty.medium;
    }
  }
}

              PracticeTopicNode(
                label: 'Newton Laws',
                children: <PracticeTopicNode>[
                  PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Newton First Law'),
                  PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Newton Second Law'),
                  PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Newton Third Law'),
                ],
              ),
              PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Energy'),
              PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Momentum'),
            ],
          ),
          PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Electricity'),
          PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Waves'),
        ],
        'Computer Science': <PracticeTopicNode>[
          PracticeTopicNode(
            label: 'Algorithms',
            children: <PracticeTopicNode>[
              PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Big-O Notation'),
              PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Sorting'),
              PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Recursion'),
            ],
          ),
          PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Data Structures'),
          PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Networks'),
        ],
        'Math': <PracticeTopicNode>[
          PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Algebra'),
          PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Functions'),
          PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Calculus'),
          PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Probability'),
        ],
      };

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    return List<PracticeQuestion>.generate(
      filter.questionCount,
      (index) => _buildQuestion(filter, index),
      growable: false,
    );
  }

  PracticeQuestion _buildQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int index) {
    final topic = filter.topicLabel;
    if (filter.subject == 'Physics' && topic.contains('Newton Second Law')) {
      return _physicsNewtonQuestion(filter, index);
    }
    if (filter.subject == 'Computer Science' && topic.contains('Big-O')) {
      return _bigOQuestion(filter, index);
    }
    if (filter.subject == 'Math') {
      return _mathQuestion(filter, index);
    }
    return _conceptQuestion(filter, index);
  }

  PracticeQuestion _physicsNewtonQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int index) {
    final mass = 1 + _rng.nextInt(8);
    final accel = 2 + _rng.nextInt(8);
    final force = mass * accel;
    final options = <int>{
      force,
      force + mass,
      force + accel,
      max(1, force - accel),
    }.toList()..shuffle(_rng);
    final correctIndex = options.indexOf(force);

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: 'physics-newton-$index-${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}',
      subject: filter.subject,
      topicLabel: filter.topicLabel,
      mode: filter.mode,
      difficulty: filter.difficulty,
      prompt:
          'A $mass kg object accelerates at $accel m/s². What net force acts on it?',
      options: options.map((e) => '$e N').toList(growable: false),
      correctIndex: correctIndex,
      explanation:
          'Use Newton’s Second Law: F = m × a = $mass × $accel = $force N.',
      recommendedTimeSeconds: _timeFor(
        filter.difficulty,
        filter.mode,
        fallback: 15,
      ),
    );
  }

  PracticeQuestion _bigOQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int index) {
    const prompts = <Map<String, Object>>[
      <String, Object>{
        'prompt':
            'What is the time complexity of binary search in a sorted array?',
        'options': <String>['O(1)', 'O(log n)', 'O(n)', 'O(n log n)'],
        'correct': 1,
        'explanation':
            'Binary search halves the search space every step, so it runs in O(log n).',
      },
      <String, Object>{
        'prompt':
            'What is the time complexity of checking every pair in a list of n items?',
        'options': <String>['O(log n)', 'O(n)', 'O(n²)', 'O(2^n)'],
        'correct': 2,
        'explanation': 'Two nested loops over n items usually produce O(n²).',
      },
      <String, Object>{
        'prompt': 'What best describes Big-O notation?',
        'options': <String>[
          'Exact runtime in seconds',
          'Upper-bound growth rate',
          'Memory address count',
          'Compiler optimization level',
        ],
        'correct': 1,
        'explanation':
            'Big-O describes how runtime or space grows as input size grows.',
      },
    ];

    final item = prompts[index % prompts.length];
    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: 'cs-bigo-$index-${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}',
      subject: filter.subject,
      topicLabel: filter.topicLabel,
      mode: filter.mode,
      difficulty: filter.difficulty,
      prompt: item['prompt'] as String,
      options: (item['options'] as List<String>).toList(growable: false),
      correctIndex: item['correct'] as int,
      explanation: item['explanation'] as String,
      recommendedTimeSeconds: _timeFor(
        filter.difficulty,
        filter.mode,
        fallback: 12,
      ),
    );
  }

  PracticeQuestion _mathQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int index) {
    final a = 2 + _rng.nextInt(10);
    final b = 1 + _rng.nextInt(10);
    final correct = a + b;
    final options = <int>{
      correct,
      correct + 1,
      correct + 2,
      max(0, correct - 1),
    }.toList()..shuffle(_rng);
    final correctIndex = options.indexOf(correct);

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: 'math-$index-${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}',
      subject: filter.subject,
      topicLabel: filter.topicLabel,
      mode: filter.mode,
      difficulty: filter.difficulty,
      prompt: 'What is $a + $b ?',
      options: options.map((e) => '$e').toList(growable: false),
      correctIndex: correctIndex,
      explanation: 'Add the two numbers directly: $a + $b = $correct.',
      recommendedTimeSeconds: _timeFor(
        filter.difficulty,
        filter.mode,
        fallback: 8,
      ),
    );
  }

  PracticeQuestion _conceptQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int index) {
    const options = <String>[
      'Concept recall',
      'Analytical reasoning',
      'Procedural fluency',
      'All of the above',
    ];

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: 'concept-$index-${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}',
      subject: filter.subject,
      topicLabel: filter.topicLabel,
      mode: filter.mode,
      difficulty: filter.difficulty,
      prompt:
          'In ${filter.topicLabel}, which practice style helps most when building mastery?',
      options: options,
      correctIndex: 3,
      explanation:
          'Strong learning mixes recall, reasoning, and repeated procedural practice.',
      recommendedTimeSeconds: _timeFor(
        filter.difficulty,
        filter.mode,
        fallback: 10,
      ),
    );
  }

  int _timeFor(
    PracticeDifficulty difficulty,
    PracticeMode mode, {
    required int fallback,
  }) {
    if (mode == PracticeMode.speedRound) return 7;
    if (mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) return 0;
    switch (difficulty) {
      case PracticeDifficulty.easy:
        return max(6, fallback - 4);
      case PracticeDifficulty.medium:
        return fallback;
      case PracticeDifficulty.hard:
        return fallback + 7;
      case PracticeDifficulty.olympiad:
        return fallback + 15;
      case PracticeDifficulty.adaptive:
        return fallback;
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    var seed = _seedFromFilter(filter);
    var attempts = 0;
    final maxAttempts = count * 40;

    while (out.length < count && attempts < maxAttempts) {
      final question = _buildQuestion(filter, seed++);
      final key = _fingerprint(question);
      attempts++;

      if (used.add(key)) {
        out.add(question);
      }
    }

    while (out.length < count) {
      final base = _buildQuestion(filter, seed++);
      out.add(
        PracticeQuestion(
          id: '${base.id}-${out.length}',
          subject: base.subject,
          topicLabel: base.topicLabel,
          mode: base.mode,
          difficulty: base.difficulty,
          prompt: base.prompt,
          options: base.options,
          correctIndex: base.correctIndex,
          explanation: base.explanation,
          recommendedTimeSeconds: base.recommendedTimeSeconds,
        ),
      );
    }

    return out;
  }

  int _seedFromFilter(PracticeFilter filter) {
    final text = [
      filter.subject,
      ...filter.topicPath,
      filter.mode.name,
      filter.difficulty.name,
      '${filter.questionCount}',
      '${filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? -1}',
    ].join('|');

    var total = 17;
    for (final code in text.codeUnits) {
      total = (total * 31 + code) & 0x7fffffff;
    }
    return total;
  }

  String _fingerprint(PracticeQuestion q) =>
      '${_norm(q.subject)}|${_norm(q.topicLabel)}|${_norm(q.prompt)}|${q.correctIndex}';

  PracticeQuestion _buildQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int seed) {
    final subject = _norm(filter.subject);
    final topicPath = filter.topicPath.isEmpty
        ? <String>['General']
        : filter.topicPath;

        return _csLoops(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }

      }

        return _csComplexity(filter, topicLabel, seed);

      ])) {

    }

    if (_isMath(subject)) {

        'circle',

        'perimeter',
        'area',
        'parallel',

        return _physicsEnergy(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }

    }

    return _generalFallback(filter, topicLabel, seed);
  }

  PracticeQuestion _csIfStatements(

    final builders = <PracticeQuestion Function()>[
      () {

        final condition = switch (op) {

          '<=' => x <= y,

    PracticeQuestion q,

  ) {

        'Adaptive mode\nThe session can shift in pace and level.\n\n${q.prompt}',

        'Bagrut-style\nSolve like a formal school exam question.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.prompt,
    };

    final decoratedExplanation = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => 'Flashcard review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Fast review: ${q.explanation}',

      PracticeMode.adaptive => 'Adaptive feedback: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.bagrut => 'Bagrut reasoning: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.explanation,
    };

    final adjustedTime = switch (filter.mode) {

      PracticeMode.speedRound => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 10,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 12,

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';

String normalizeMathInline(String input) {
  if (input.isEmpty) return input;

  var t = input.trim();

  t = t.replaceAll('−', '-');
  t = t.replaceAll('×', r'\times ');
  t = t.replaceAll('÷', r'\div ');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\', r'\');

  t = t.replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(r'\\\((.*?)\\\)', dotAll: true),
    (m) => r'$' + (m.group(1) ?? '').trim() + r'$',
  );

  t = t.replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(r'\\\[(.*?)\\\]', dotAll: true),
    (m) => r'$$' + (m.group(1) ?? '').trim() + r'$$',
  );

  t = t.replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(r'(?<!\\)sqrt\s*\(([^()]+)\)'),
    (m) => r'$\sqrt{' + (m.group(1) ?? '').trim() + r'}$',
  );

  t = t.replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(r'(?<!\\)frac\s*\{([^{}]+)\}\s*\{([^{}]+)\}'),
    (m) =>
        r'$\frac{' +
        (m.group(1) ?? '').trim() +
        r'}{' +
        (m.group(2) ?? '').trim() +
        r'}$',
  );

  t = t.replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(r'(?<!\\)([A-Za-z0-9]+)\^([A-Za-z0-9]+)'),
    (m) =>
        r'$' +
        (m.group(1) ?? '').trim() +
        r'^{' +
        (m.group(2) ?? '').trim() +
        r'}$',
  );

  t = t.replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(r'(?<!\\)([A-Za-z0-9]+)\/([A-Za-z0-9]+)'),
    (m) =>
        r'$\frac{' +
        (m.group(1) ?? '').trim() +
        r'}{' +
        (m.group(2) ?? '').trim() +
        r'}$',
  );

  if (RegExp(r'(\\[A-Za-z]+|\$[^$]+\$|\$\$[\s\S]+\$\$)').hasMatch(t)) {
    return t;
  }

  return t;
}

class PracticeGenerator {
  static const _apiBase = String.fromEnvironment(
    'CM_API_BASE_URL',
    defaultValue: 'http://127.0.0.1:3001',
  );

  static const _devToken = String.fromEnvironment('CM_DEV_TOKEN');

  final BagrutRepository _bagrutRepo = BagrutRepository();

  void _log(String message) {
    debugPrint('practice.generator $message');
  }

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    _log(
      'generation_started mode=${filter.mode.name} subject=${filter.subject} topic=${filter.topicLabel} count=${filter.questionCount}',
    );

    if (filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut) {
      final bagrut = await _generateBagrutQuestion(filter);
      if (bagrut != null) {
        _log('bagrut_used count=1');
        return [bagrut];
      }

      _log('bagrut_unavailable fallback_used reason=bagrut_null');
      final fallback = await generateFallback(filter);
      _log('question_count_returned source=fallback count=${fallback.length}');
      return fallback;
    }

    final remote = await _generateFromApiWithRetry(filter);
    if (remote.isNotEmpty) {
      _log('question_count_returned source=api count=${remote.length}');
      return remote;
    }

    _log('fallback_used reason=api_empty_after_retry');
    final fallback = await generateFallback(filter);
    _log('question_count_returned source=fallback count=${fallback.length}');
    return fallback;
  }

  Future<PracticeQuestion?> _generateBagrutQuestion(
    PracticeFilter filter,
  ) async {
    final dto = await _bagrutRepo.getQuestion(
      subject: filter.subject,
      topicLabel: filter.topicLabel,
    );
    if (dto == null) return null;

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: 'bagrut-${dto.examCode}-${dto.questionIndex}-${dto.year}',
      subject: dto.subject,
      topicLabel: dto.topicLabel,
      mode: PracticeMode.bagrut,
      difficulty: _parseDifficulty(dto.difficulty) ?? filter.difficulty,
      source: PracticeQuestionSource.bagrut,
      prompt: normalizeMathInline(
        dto.promptLatex.isNotEmpty ? dto.promptLatex : 'Bagrut question',
      ),
      options: const [
        'Open with NOVA',
        'Show official solution',
        'Save for later',
        'End question',
      ].map(normalizeMathInline).toList(),
      correctIndex: 1,
      explanation: normalizeMathInline(
        dto.solutionLatex.isNotEmpty
            ? dto.solutionLatex
            : 'Official Bagrut-style solution unavailable.',
      ),
      recommendedTimeSeconds: 3600,
    );
  }

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generateFallback(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    _log(
      'fallback_used mode=${filter.mode.name} subject=${filter.subject} topic=${filter.topicLabel}',
    );
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final count = filter.questionCount < 1 ? 1 : filter.questionCount;

    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      out.add(_localQuestion(filter, i));
    }

    return out;
  }

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> _generateFromApiWithRetry(
    PracticeFilter filter,
  ) async {
    var last = const <PracticeQuestion>[];
    for (var attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
      last = await _generateFromApi(filter);
      if (last.isNotEmpty) {
        _log('api_success attempt=${attempt + 1} count=${last.length}');
        return last;
      }
      _log('api_failure attempt=${attempt + 1} reason=empty_after_parse');
      await Future<void>.delayed(
        Duration(milliseconds: attempt == 0 ? 700 : 0),
      );
    }
    return last;
  }

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> _generateFromApi(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final client = HttpClient()
      ..connectionTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 60);

    try {
      final uri = Uri.parse('$_apiBase/practice/generate');
      _log('api_request_started uri=$uri');
      _log('api_request_dev_token_len=${_devToken.length}');
      final req = await client
          .postUrl(uri)
          .timeout(
            const Duration(seconds: 90),
            onTimeout: () => throw TimeoutException(
              'practice.generate postUrl timeout after 20s',
            ),
          );

      req.headers.contentType = ContentType.json;
      req.headers.set(HttpHeaders.acceptHeader, 'application/json');
      if (_devToken.isNotEmpty) {
        req.headers.set(HttpHeaders.authorizationHeader, 'Bearer $_devToken');
      }

      final payload = <String, Object?>{
        'subject': filter.subject,
        'topicLabel': filter.topicLabel,
        'topicPath': filter.topicPath,
        'topicPathText': filter.topicPath.isEmpty
            ? filter.topicLabel
            : filter.topicPath.join(' > '),
        'mode': filter.mode.name,
        'difficulty': filter.difficulty.name,
        'questionCount': filter.questionCount,
        'timePreferenceSeconds': filter.timePreferenceSeconds,
        'useAiTiming': filter.useAiTiming,
        'maxLives': filter.maxLives,
        'strictPromptSummary': buildStrictPracticeFilterSection(filter),
      };

      _log('api_request_payload=${jsonEncode(payload)}');
      req.write(jsonEncode(payload));

      final res = await req.close().timeout(
        const Duration(seconds: 90),
        onTimeout: () =>
            throw TimeoutException('practice.generate close timeout after 90s'),
      );
      final body = await utf8
          .decodeStream(res)
          .timeout(
            const Duration(seconds: 60),
            onTimeout: () => throw TimeoutException(
              'practice.generate body timeout after 90s',
            ),
          );
      _log('api_response_status=${res.statusCode}');

      if (res.statusCode < 200 || res.statusCode >= 300) {
        _log('api_failure reason=http_${res.statusCode} body=$body');
        return const [];
      }

      final decoded = jsonDecode(body);
      final rawQuestions = _extractQuestions(decoded);

      _log('api_raw_question_count=${rawQuestions.length}');

      final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
      for (var i = 0; i < rawQuestions.length; i++) {
        final q = _parseQuestion(rawQuestions[i], filter: filter, index: i);
        if (q != null) {
          out.add(q);
        } else {
          _log('api_question_dropped index=$i reason=parse_null');
        }
      }

      _log('api_success_parsed_count=${out.length}');
      return out;
    } catch (e, st) {
      _log('api_failure reason=exception error=$e');
      debugPrint('$st');
      return const [];
    } finally {
      client.close(force: true);
    }
  }

  List<dynamic> _extractQuestions(dynamic decoded) {
    if (decoded is List) return decoded;
    if (decoded is Map<String, dynamic>) {
      final direct = decoded['questions'];
      if (direct is List) return direct;

      final data = decoded['data'];
      if (data is Map<String, dynamic>) {
        final qs = data['questions'];

===== apps/classmate_mobile/lib/features/practice/data/practice_generator.dart.bak.1773515448 =====
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';
import 'practice_prompt_builder.dart';
import 'bagrut_repository.dart';


String normalizeMathInline(String input) {
  if (input.isEmpty) return input;

  var t = input.replaceAll('\r\n', '\n').replaceAll('\r', '\n').trim();

  t = t.replaceAll('\u00A0', ' ');
  t = t.replaceAll('−', '-');
  t = t.replaceAll('×', r'\times ');
  t = t.replaceAll('÷', r'\div ');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\$', r'$');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\left', '');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\right', '');

  final commands = <String>[
    'alpha',
    'beta',
    'gamma',
    'delta',
    'theta',
    'lambda',
    'mu',
    'pi',
    'sigma',
    'Delta',
    'pm',
    'neq',
    'leq',
    'geq',
    'approx',
    'to',
    'infty',
    'cdot',
    'times',
    'div',
    'frac',
    'sqrt',
    'sin',
    'cos',
    'tan',
    'log',
    'ln',
    'lim',
    'sum',
    'int',
    'text',
    'implies',
    'iff',
  ];

  for (final cmd in commands) {
    t = t.replaceAll('\\\\$cmd', '\\$cmd');
  }

  t = t.replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(r'\\\(([\s\S]*?)\\\)'),
    (m) => '\$${(m.group(1) ?? '').trim()}\$',
  );
  t = t.replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(r'\\\[([\s\S]*?)\\\]'),
    (m) => '\$\$${(m.group(1) ?? '').trim()}\$\$',
  );

  t = t.replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(r'\\?frac\s*([A-Za-z0-9])\s*([A-Za-z0-9])'),
    (m) => r'\frac{${m.group(1)!}}{${m.group(2)!}}',
  );
  t = t.replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(r'\\?sqrt\s*([A-Za-z0-9])'),
    (m) => r'\sqrt{${m.group(1)!}}',
  );

  final bareLatex = <RegExp>[
    RegExp(r'(?<!\$)(\\frac\s*\{[^{}]+\}\s*\{[^{}]+\})(?!\$)'),
    RegExp(r'(?<!\$)(\\sqrt\s*\{[^{}]+\})(?!\$)'),
    RegExp(r'(?<!\$)(\\lim(?:_[^ ]+)?)'),
    RegExp(r'(?<!\$)(\\Delta\s*=\s*[^$\n,.]+)(?!\$)'),
    RegExp(r'(?<!\$)(\\(?:alpha|beta|gamma|delta|theta|lambda|mu|pi|sigma|Delta))(?![A-Za-z])'),
  ];
  for (final re in bareLatex) {
    t = t.replaceAllMapped(re, (m) => '\$${m.group(1)!.trim()}\$');
  }

  final rawMath = <RegExp>[
    RegExp(r'(?<!\$)\b[a-zA-Z0-9]+\s*=\s*[-+]?[a-zA-Z0-9]+\b(?!\$)'),
    RegExp(r'(?<!\$)\b[a-zA-Z]+\s*\+\s*[a-zA-Z]+\s*=\s*-?\d+\b(?!\$)'),
    RegExp(r'(?<!\$)\b\|[^|\n]+\|\s*[<>=]\s*[^ \n]+\b(?!\$)'),
    RegExp(r'(?<!\$)\b[a-zA-Z]\^2\s*[-+]\s*4[a-zA-Z]{1,2}\b(?!\$)'),
    RegExp(r'(?<!\$)\b[a-zA-Z]\s*[<>=]\s*-?\d+\b(?!\$)'),
    RegExp(r'(?<!\$)\b\d+\s*[<>=]\s*[a-zA-Z]\b(?!\$)'),
    RegExp(r'(?<![A-Za-z])ke3(?![A-Za-z])'),
    RegExp(r'(?<![A-Za-z])kge3(?![A-Za-z])'),
    RegExp(r'(?<![A-Za-z])kle3(?![A-Za-z])'),
  ];
  for (final re in rawMath) {
    t = t.replaceAllMapped(re, (m) {
      final v = m.group(0)!.trim();
      if (v == 'ke3') return r'$k<3$';
      if (v == 'kge3') return r'$k\ge 3$';
      if (v == 'kle3') return r'$k\le 3$';
      return '\$${v}\$';
    });
  }

  t = t.replaceAll(r'\left', '');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\right', '');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\alpha', r'\alpha');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\beta', r'\beta');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\gamma', r'\gamma');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\delta', r'\delta');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\theta', r'\theta');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\lambda', r'\lambda');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\mu', r'\mu');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\pi', r'\pi');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\sigma', r'\sigma');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\Delta', r'\Delta');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\sqrt', r'\sqrt');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\frac', r'\frac');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\to', r'\to');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\approx', r'\approx');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\pm', r'\pm');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\sum', r'\sum');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\int', r'\int');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\text', r'\text');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\implies', r'\implies');
  t = t.replaceAll(r'\\iff', r'\iff');

  t = t.replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r'(?<!\n)\n(?!\n)'), (_) => ' ');
  t = t.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[ \t]{2,}'), ' ');
  t = t.replaceAll(RegExp(r' *\n *\n+'), '\n\n');

  while (t.contains('\$\$\$\$')) {
    t = t.replaceAll('\$\$\$\$', '\$\$');
  }
  while (t.contains('\$\$\$')) {
    t = t.replaceAll('\$\$\$', '\$\$');
  }

  return t.trim();
}

String normalizeMathInline(String text) {
  var t = text;

  // Convert \( ... \) → $...$
  t = t.replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r'\\((.*?)\\)'), (m) => '\$${m.group(1)}\$');

  // Convert \[ ... \] → $...$
  t = t.replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r'\\[(.*?)\\]'), (m) => '\$${m.group(1)}\$');

  // Repair lost leading backslashes on common latex commands inside math/text.
  t = t.replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(
      r'(^|[^\A-Za-z])(frac|sqrt|cdot|times|leq|geq|neq|pm|mp|approx|left|right|alpha|beta|gamma|delta|theta|lambda|mu|pi|sigma)',
    ),
    (m) => '${m.group(1)}\${m.group(2)}',
  );

  // Wrap simple powers if they are still plain text.
  t = t.replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(r'(?<!\$)([a-zA-Z0-9]+\^[0-9]+)(?!\$)'),
    (m) => '\$${m.group(1)}\$',
  );

  // Wrap simple slash fractions if they are still plain text.
  t = t.replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(r'(?<!\$)([0-9a-zA-Z]+/[0-9a-zA-Z]+)(?!\$)'),
    (m) => '\$${m.group(1)}\$',
  );

  return t;
}

class PracticeGenerator {
  static const _apiBase = String.fromEnvironment(
    'CM_API_BASE_URL',
    defaultValue: 'http://127.0.0.1:3001',
  );

  static const _devToken = String.fromEnvironment('CM_DEV_TOKEN');

  final BagrutRepository _bagrutRepo = BagrutRepository();

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    if (filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut) {
      final bagrut = await _generateBagrutQuestion(filter);
      if (bagrut != null) return [bagrut];
      return generateFallback(filter);
    }

    final remote = await _generateFromApiWithRetry(filter);
    if (remote.isNotEmpty) return remote;

    return generateFallback(filter);
  }

  Future<PracticeQuestion?> _generateBagrutQuestion(
    PracticeFilter filter,
  ) async {
    final dto = await _bagrutRepo.getQuestion(
      subject: filter.subject,
      topicLabel: filter.topicLabel,
    );
    if (dto == null) return null;

    return PracticeQuestion(
      source: PracticeQuestionSource.api,
      id: 'bagrut-${dto.examCode}-${dto.questionIndex}-${dto.year}',
      subject: dto.subject,
      topicLabel: dto.topicLabel,
      mode: PracticeMode.bagrut,
      difficulty: _parseDifficulty(dto.difficulty) ?? filter.difficulty,
      prompt: dto.promptLatex.isNotEmpty ? dto.promptLatex : 'Bagrut question',
      options: const [
        'Open with NOVA',
        'Show official solution',
        'Save for later',
        'End question',
      ],
      correctIndex: 1,
      explanation: dto.solutionLatex.isNotEmpty
          ? dto.solutionLatex
          : 'Official Bagrut-style solution unavailable.',
      recommendedTimeSeconds: 3600,
    );
  }

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generateFallback(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final count = filter.questionCount < 1 ? 1 : filter.questionCount;

    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      out.add(_localQuestion(filter, i));
    }

    return out;
  }

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> _generateFromApiWithRetry(
    PracticeFilter filter,
  ) async {
    var last = const <PracticeQuestion>[];
    for (var attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
      last = await _generateFromApi(filter);
      if (last.isNotEmpty) return last;
      await Future<void>.delayed(
        Duration(milliseconds: attempt == 0 ? 700 : 0),
      );
    }
    return last;
  }

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> _generateFromApi(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final client = HttpClient()
      ..connectionTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 60);

    try {
      final uri = Uri.parse('$_apiBase/practice/generate');
      debugPrint('practice.generate uri=$uri');
      debugPrint('practice.generate devTokenLen=${_devToken.length}');
      final req = await client
          .postUrl(uri)
          .timeout(
            const Duration(seconds: 90),
            onTimeout: () => throw TimeoutException(
              'practice.generate postUrl timeout after 20s',
            ),
          );

      req.headers.contentType = ContentType.json;
      req.headers.set(HttpHeaders.acceptHeader, 'application/json');
      if (_devToken.isNotEmpty) {
        req.headers.set(HttpHeaders.authorizationHeader, 'Bearer $_devToken');
      }

      final payload = <String, Object?>{
        'subject': filter.subject,
        'topicLabel': filter.topicLabel,
        'topicPath': filter.topicPath,
        'topicPathText': filter.topicPath.isEmpty
            ? filter.topicLabel
            : filter.topicPath.join(' > '),
        'mode': filter.mode.name,
        'difficulty': filter.difficulty.name,
        'questionCount': filter.questionCount,
        'timePreferenceSeconds': filter.timePreferenceSeconds,
        'useAiTiming': filter.useAiTiming,
        'maxLives': filter.maxLives,
        'strictPromptSummary': buildStrictPracticeFilterSection(filter),
      };

      debugPrint('practice.generate payload=${jsonEncode(payload)}');
      req.write(jsonEncode(payload));

      final res = await req.close().timeout(
        const Duration(seconds: 90),
        onTimeout: () =>
            throw TimeoutException('practice.generate close timeout after 90s'),
      );
      final body = await utf8
          .decodeStream(res)
          .timeout(
            const Duration(seconds: 60),
            onTimeout: () => throw TimeoutException(
              'practice.generate body timeout after 90s',
            ),
          );
      debugPrint('practice.generate status=${res.statusCode}');
      debugPrint('practice.generate ok body: $body');

      if (res.statusCode < 200 || res.statusCode >= 300) {
        debugPrint('practice.generate http ${res.statusCode}: $body');
        return const [];
      }

      final decoded = jsonDecode(body);
      final rawQuestions = _extractQuestions(decoded);

      final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
      for (var i = 0; i < rawQuestions.length; i++) {
        final q = _parseQuestion(rawQuestions[i], filter: filter, index: i);
        if (q != null) out.add(q);
      }

      return out;
    } catch (e, st) {
      debugPrint('practice.generate failed: $e');
      debugPrint('$st');
      return const [];
    } finally {
      client.close(force: true);
    }
  }

  List<dynamic> _extractQuestions(dynamic decoded) {
    if (decoded is List) return decoded;
    if (decoded is Map<String, dynamic>) {
      final direct = decoded['questions'];
      if (direct is List) return direct;

      final data = decoded['data'];
      if (data is Map<String, dynamic>) {
        final qs = data['questions'];
        if (qs is List) return qs;
      }

      final items = decoded['items'];
      if (items is List) return items;
    }
    return const [];
  }

  PracticeQuestion? _parseQuestion(
    dynamic raw, {
    required PracticeFilter filter,
    required int index,
  }) {
    if (raw is! Map) return null;

    final map = raw.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k.toString(), v));

        _asString(map['prompt']) ??
        _asString(map['question']) ??
        _asString(map['text']) ??
        '';

        map['options'] ??
        map['choices'] ??
        map['answers'] ??
        map['answerOptions'];

        _asInt(map['correctIndex']) ??
        _asInt(map['correct_answer_index']) ??
        _asInt(map['answerIndex']) ??
        0;

    final explanation =
        _asString(map['explanation']) ??
        _asString(map['solution']) ??
        _asString(map['reasoning']) ??
        'Review the logic carefully and ask NOVA for a full walkthrough.';

    final subject = _asString(map['subject']) ?? filter.subject;
    final topicLabel =
        _asString(map['topicLabel']) ??
        _asString(map['topic']) ??
        filter.topicLabel;
    final recommendedTimeSeconds =
        _asInt(map['recommendedTimeSeconds']) ??
        _asInt(map['timeSeconds']) ??
        _asInt(map['time_limit_seconds']) ??
        (filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? 45);

    final safeOptions = options.length == 4
        ? options
        : <String>['Option A', 'Option B', 'Option C', 'Option D'];

    final safeCorrectIndex =
        correctIndex >= 0 && correctIndex < safeOptions.length
        ? correctIndex
        : 0;

      id:

import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = max(1, filter.questionCount);
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};
    final seedBase = _seedFromFilter(filter);

    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      PracticeQuestion q;
      var attempts = 0;

      do {
        final seed = seedBase + i * 977 + attempts * 131;
        q = _buildQuestion(filter, seed, i);
        attempts++;
      } while (used.contains(_fingerprint(q)) && attempts < 20);

      used.add(_fingerprint(q));
      out.add(q);
    }

    return out;
  }

  PracticeQuestion _buildQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int seed, int index) {
    final subject = _norm(filter.subject);
    final topicLabel = filter.topicLabel;
    final topic = _norm(topicLabel);
    final r = Random(seed);

    if (_hasAny(subject, ['math', 'mathematics'])) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['quadratic', 'parabola', 'trinomial'])) {
        return _mathQuadratic(filter, topicLabel, seed, index);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['linear', 'slope', 'line', 'affine', 'intercept'])) {
        return _mathLinear(filter, topicLabel, seed, index);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['probability', 'chance', 'combinatorics'])) {
        return _mathProbability(filter, topicLabel, seed, index);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['geometry', 'triangle', 'circle', 'angle'])) {
        return _mathGeometry(filter, topicLabel, seed, index);
      }
      return r.nextBool()
          ? _mathLinear(filter, topicLabel, seed, index)
          : _mathQuadratic(filter, topicLabel, seed, index);
    }

    if (_hasAny(subject, ['physics'])) {
      return _physicsForces(filter, topicLabel, seed, index);
    }

    if (_hasAny(subject, ['computer science', 'cs', 'programming'])) {
      return _csBigO(filter, topicLabel, seed, index);
    }

    return _genericQuestion(filter, topicLabel, seed, index);
  }

  PracticeQuestion _mathLinear(
    PracticeFilter filter,
    String topicLabel,
    int seed,
    int index,
  ) {
    final m = _scaledNumber(
      filter,
      seed + 1,
      easy: 2,
      medium: 4,
      hard: 7,
      olympiad: 11,
    );
    final c = _scaledNumber(
      filter,
      seed + 2,
      easy: 1,
      medium: 3,
      hard: 6,
      olympiad: 10,
    );
    final x = _scaledNumber(
      filter,
      seed + 3,
      easy: 2,
      medium: 4,
      hard: 8,
      olympiad: 12,
    );
    final y = m * x + c;

    final prompt = _modePrompt(
      filter,
      base: 'For y = ${m}x + $c, what is y when x = $x?',
      exam: 'Evaluate y = ${m}x + $c at x = $x.',
      concept: 'Substitute x = $x into y = ${m}x + $c.',
    );

    final options = _shuffledOptions(
      seed: seed + 10,
      correct: '$y',
      distractors: ['$m', '${m + x + c}', '${m * x}'],
    );

    return _q(
      filter: filter,
      subject: 'Math',
      topicLabel: topicLabel,
      prompt: prompt,
      options: options,
      correct: '$y',
      explanation: 'Substitute x = $x: y = $m($x) + $c = $y.',
      timeSeconds: _timeFor(filter, base: 16, hard: 24, olympiad: 30),
      index: index,
    );
  }

  PracticeQuestion _mathQuadratic(
    PracticeFilter filter,
    String topicLabel,
    int seed,
    int index,
  ) {
    final r1 = _scaledSignedNumber(
      filter,
      seed + 1,
      easy: 2,
      medium: 4,
      hard: 7,
      olympiad: 10,
    );
    var r2 = _scaledSignedNumber(
      filter,
      seed + 2,
      easy: 3,
      medium: 5,
      hard: 8,
      olympiad: 11,
    );
    if (r2 == r1) r2 += 1;

    final b = -(r1 + r2);
    final c = r1 * r2;

    final prompt = _modePrompt(
      filter,
      base:
          'For y = x² ${b >= 0 ? '+' : '-'} ${b.abs()}x ${c >= 0 ? '+' : '-'} ${c.abs()}, what are the roots?',
      exam:
          'Solve x² ${b >= 0 ? '+' : '-'} ${b.abs()}x ${c >= 0 ? '+' : '-'} ${c.abs()} = 0.',
      concept:
          'Factor x² ${b >= 0 ? '+' : '-'} ${b.abs()}x ${c >= 0 ? '+' : '-'} ${c.abs()} and find the zeros.',
    );

    const x2 = 'x²';
    final correct = 'x = $r1 and x = $r2';
    final options = _shuffledOptions(
      seed: seed + 9,
      correct: correct,
      distractors: [
        'x = ${r1 + r2}',
        'x = ${r1 - r2} and x = ${r2 - r1}',
        'No real roots',
      ],
    );

    return _q(
      filter: filter,
      subject: 'Math',
      topicLabel: topicLabel,
      prompt: prompt.replaceAll('x²', x2),
      options: options,
      correct: correct,
      explanation:
          'The quadratic factors to (x - $r1)(x - $r2) = 0, so the roots are $r1 and $r2.',
      timeSeconds: _timeFor(filter, base: 28, hard: 40, olympiad: 55),
      index: index,
    );
  }

  PracticeQuestion _mathProbability(
    PracticeFilter filter,
    String topicLabel,
    int seed,
    int index,
  ) {
    final total = _scaledNumber(
      filter,
      seed + 1,
      easy: 6,
      medium: 10,
      hard: 14,
      olympiad: 18,
    );
    final success = min(
      total - 1,
      _scaledNumber(filter, seed + 2, easy: 2, medium: 3, hard: 5, olympiad: 7),
    );

    final prompt = _modePrompt(
      filter,
      base:
          'A bag has $total balls, and $success are red. What is the probability of drawing a red ball?',
      exam:
          'Out of $total equally likely outcomes, $success are favorable. Find the probability.',
      concept: 'Probability = favorable outcomes / total outcomes.',
    );

    final correct = '$success/$total';
    final options = _shuffledOptions(
      seed: seed + 3,
      correct: correct,
      distractors: [
        '$total/$success',
        '${success + 1}/$total',
        '$success/${total + 1}',
      ],
    );

    return _q(
      filter: filter,
      subject: 'Math',
      topicLabel: topicLabel,
      prompt: prompt,
      options: options,
      correct: correct,
      explanation: 'Probability = favorable / total = $success / $total.',
      timeSeconds: _timeFor(filter, base: 18, hard: 26, olympiad: 34),
      index: index,
    );
  }

import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    final sessionSalt = DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.abs();
    var seed = _seedFromFilter(filter) + sessionSalt;
    var attempts = 0;
    final maxAttempts = count * 90;

    while (out.length < count && attempts < maxAttempts) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 17 + attempts * 11),
        filter,
        seed + attempts,
      );
      attempts++;
      if (used.add(_fingerprint(q))) {
        out.add(q);
      }
    }

    while (out.length < count) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 29),
        filter,
        seed + out.length * 13,
      );
      out.add(
        PracticeQuestion(
          id: '${q.id}-${out.length}-${sessionSalt % 100000}',
          subject: q.subject,
          topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
          mode: q.mode,
          difficulty: q.difficulty,
          prompt: q.prompt,
          options: q.options,
          correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
          explanation: q.explanation,
          recommendedTimeSeconds: q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
        ),
      );
    }

    return out;
  }

  PracticeQuestion _postProcessMode(
    PracticeQuestion q,
    PracticeFilter filter,
    int seed,
  ) {
    final decoratedPrompt = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards =>
        'Flashcard\nRemember first, reveal second.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Speed round\nAnswer fast.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep =>
        'Bagrut-style / exam-style\nRead carefully and choose precisely.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder =>
        'Concept builder\nUnderstand the rule, then solve.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive =>
        'Adaptive mode\nThe session can shift in pace and level.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep =>
        'Bagrut-style\nSolve like a formal school exam question.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.prompt,
    };

    final decoratedExplanation = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => 'Flashcard review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Fast review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep => 'Exam reasoning: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => 'Concept walkthrough: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive => 'Adaptive feedback: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep => 'Bagrut reasoning: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.explanation,
    };

    final adjustedTime = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 6,
      PracticeMode.speedRound => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 10,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 12,
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 8,
      PracticeMode.adaptive => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 16,
      PracticeMode.practice => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
    };

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: '${q.id}-${seed.abs() % 10000}',
      subject: q.subject,
      topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
      mode: q.mode,
      difficulty: q.difficulty,
      prompt: decoratedPrompt,
      options: q.options,
      correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
      explanation: decoratedExplanation,
      recommendedTimeSeconds: adjustedTime < 8 ? 8 : adjustedTime,
    );
  }

===== apps/classmate_mobile/lib/features/practice/data/practice_generator.dart.cleanup-1773160596.bak =====
import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    final sessionSalt = DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.abs();
    var seed = _seedFromFilter(filter) + sessionSalt;
    var attempts = 0;
    final maxAttempts = count * 90;

    while (out.length < count && attempts < maxAttempts) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 17 + attempts * 11),
        filter,
        seed + attempts,
      );
      attempts++;
      if (used.add(_fingerprint(q))) {
        out.add(q);
      }
    }

    while (out.length < count) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 29),
        filter,
        seed + out.length * 13,
      );
      out.add(
        PracticeQuestion(
          id: '${q.id}-${out.length}-${sessionSalt % 100000}',
          subject: q.subject,
          topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
          mode: q.mode,
          difficulty: q.difficulty,
          prompt: q.prompt,
          options: q.options,
          correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
          explanation: q.explanation,
          recommendedTimeSeconds: q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
        ),
      );
    }

    return out;
  }

  PracticeQuestion _postProcessMode(
    PracticeQuestion q,
    PracticeFilter filter,
    int seed,
  ) {
    final decoratedPrompt = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards =>
        'Flashcard\nRemember first, reveal second.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Speed round\nAnswer fast.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep =>
        'Bagrut-style / exam-style\nRead carefully and choose precisely.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder =>
        'Concept builder\nUnderstand the rule, then solve.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive =>
        'Adaptive mode\nThe session can shift in pace and level.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep =>
        'Bagrut-style\nSolve like a formal school exam question.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.prompt,
    };

    final decoratedExplanation = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => 'Flashcard review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Fast review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep => 'Exam reasoning: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => 'Concept walkthrough: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive => 'Adaptive feedback: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep => 'Bagrut reasoning: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.explanation,
    };

    final adjustedTime = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 6,
      PracticeMode.speedRound => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 10,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 12,
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 8,
      PracticeMode.adaptive => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 16,
      PracticeMode.practice => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
    };

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: '${q.id}-${seed.abs() % 10000}',
      subject: q.subject,
      topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
      mode: q.mode,
      difficulty: q.difficulty,
      prompt: decoratedPrompt,
      options: q.options,
      correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
      explanation: decoratedExplanation,
      recommendedTimeSeconds: adjustedTime < 8 ? 8 : adjustedTime,
    );
  }

  PracticeQuestion _buildQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int seed) {
    final subject = _norm(filter.subject);
    final topicLabel = filter.topicPath.isEmpty
        ? 'General'
        : filter.topicPath.join(' • ');
    final generatorNote = _norm('');
    final topic = _norm('$topicLabel $generatorNote');

    if (_isCS(subject) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, [
          'civics',
          'citizenship',
          'government',
          'democracy',
        ]) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, ['history']) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, ['geography']) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, ['literature', 'adab'])) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'if',
        'if statement',
        'if statements',
        'condition',
        'conditions',
        'conditional',
        'branch',
        'else',
        'boolean',
      ])) {
        return _csIfStatements(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['loop', 'loops', 'for', 'while', 'iteration'])) {
        return _csLoops(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['variable', 'variables', 'assignment', 'operator'])) {
        return _csVariables(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['big o', 'complexity', 'algorithm'])) {
        return _csComplexity(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'array',
        'arrays',
        'stack',
        'queue',
        'tree',
        'map',
      ])) {
        return _csDataStructures(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _csMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isMath(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'geometry',
        'triangle',
        'circle',
        'angle',
        'rectangle',
        'perimeter',
        'area',
      ])) {
        return _mathGeometry(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'function',
        'functions',
        'algebra',
        'equation',
        'linear',
        'quadratic',
        'slope',
      ])) {
        return _mathAlgebra(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['probability', 'chance', 'combinatorics'])) {
        return _mathProbability(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _mathAccurateFallback(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isPhysics(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['newton', 'force', 'forces', 'second law'])) {
        return _physicsNewton(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'kinematics',
        'velocity',
        'speed',
        'acceleration',
        'motion',
        'free fall',
      ])) {
        return _physicsKinematics(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['energy', 'work', 'power'])) {
        return _physicsEnergy(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _physicsMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isEnglish(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'grammar',
        'tense',
        'tenses',
        'article',
        'sentence',
      ])) {
        return _englishGrammar(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['vocabulary', 'synonym', 'antonym', 'word'])) {
        return _englishVocabulary(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['reading', 'comprehension', 'passage'])) {
        return _englishReading(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _englishMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isArabic(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'نحو',
        'اعراب',
        'إعراب',
        'syntax',
        'grammar',
        'sentence structure',
      ])) {
        return _arabicNahw(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['مفردات', 'vocabulary', 'مرادف', 'مضاد'])) {
        return _arabicVocabulary(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['قراءة', 'فهم', 'comprehension', 'passage'])) {
        return _arabicReading(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _arabicMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isHebrew(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'grammar',
        'תחביר',
        'לשון',
        'binyanim',
        'sentence structure',
      ])) {
        return _hebrewGrammar(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['vocabulary', 'אוצר מילים', 'synonym', 'antonym'])) {
        return _hebrewVocabulary(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'reading',
        'הבנת הנקרא',
        'comprehension',
        'passage',
      ])) {
        return _hebrewReading(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _hebrewMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isChemistry(subject)) {
      return _chemistryMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isBiology(subject)) {
      return _biologyMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);

===== apps/classmate_mobile/lib/features/practice/data/practice_generator.dart.cleanup.1773161007.bak =====
import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    final sessionSalt = DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.abs();
    var seed = _seedFromFilter(filter) + sessionSalt;
    var attempts = 0;
    final maxAttempts = count * 90;

    while (out.length < count && attempts < maxAttempts) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 17 + attempts * 11),
        filter,
        seed + attempts,
      );
      attempts++;
      if (used.add(_fingerprint(q))) {
        out.add(q);
      }
    }

    while (out.length < count) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 29),
        filter,
        seed + out.length * 13,
      );
      out.add(
        PracticeQuestion(
          id: '${q.id}-${out.length}-${sessionSalt % 100000}',
          subject: q.subject,
          topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
          mode: q.mode,
          difficulty: q.difficulty,
          prompt: q.prompt,
          options: q.options,
          correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
          explanation: q.explanation,
          recommendedTimeSeconds: q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
        ),
      );
    }

    return out;
  }

  PracticeQuestion _postProcessMode(
    PracticeQuestion q,
    PracticeFilter filter,
    int seed,
  ) {
    final decoratedPrompt = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards =>
        'Flashcard\nRemember first, reveal second.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Speed round\nAnswer fast.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep =>
        'Bagrut-style / exam-style\nRead carefully and choose precisely.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder =>
        'Concept builder\nUnderstand the rule, then solve.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive =>
        'Adaptive mode\nThe session can shift in pace and level.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep =>
        'Bagrut-style\nSolve like a formal school exam question.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.prompt,
    };

    final decoratedExplanation = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => 'Flashcard review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Fast review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep => 'Exam reasoning: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => 'Concept walkthrough: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive => 'Adaptive feedback: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep => 'Bagrut reasoning: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.explanation,
    };

    final adjustedTime = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 6,
      PracticeMode.speedRound => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 10,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 12,
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 8,
      PracticeMode.adaptive => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 16,
      PracticeMode.practice => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
    };

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: '${q.id}-${seed.abs() % 10000}',
      subject: q.subject,
      topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
      mode: q.mode,
      difficulty: q.difficulty,
      prompt: decoratedPrompt,
      options: q.options,
      correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
      explanation: decoratedExplanation,
      recommendedTimeSeconds: adjustedTime < 8 ? 8 : adjustedTime,
    );
  }

  PracticeQuestion _buildQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int seed) {
    final subject = _norm(filter.subject);
    final topicLabel = filter.topicPath.isEmpty
        ? 'General'
        : filter.topicPath.join(' • ');
    final topic = _norm(topicLabel);

    if (_isCS(subject) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, [
          'civics',
          'citizenship',
          'government',
          'democracy',
        ]) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, ['history']) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, ['geography']) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, ['literature', 'adab'])) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'if',
        'if statement',
        'if statements',
        'condition',
        'conditions',
        'conditional',
        'branch',
        'else',
        'boolean',
      ])) {
        return _csIfStatements(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['loop', 'loops', 'for', 'while', 'iteration'])) {
        return _csLoops(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['variable', 'variables', 'assignment', 'operator'])) {
        return _csVariables(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['big o', 'complexity', 'algorithm'])) {
        return _csComplexity(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'array',
        'arrays',
        'stack',
        'queue',
        'tree',
        'map',
      ])) {
        return _csDataStructures(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _csMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isMath(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'geometry',
        'triangle',
        'circle',
        'angle',
        'rectangle',
        'perimeter',
        'area',
      ])) {
        return _mathGeometry(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'function',
        'functions',
        'algebra',
        'equation',
        'linear',
        'quadratic',
        'slope',
      ])) {
        return _mathAlgebra(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['probability', 'chance', 'combinatorics'])) {
        return _mathProbability(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _mathAccurateFallback(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isPhysics(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['newton', 'force', 'forces', 'second law'])) {
        return _physicsNewton(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'kinematics',
        'velocity',
        'speed',
        'acceleration',
        'motion',
        'free fall',
      ])) {
        return _physicsKinematics(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['energy', 'work', 'power'])) {
        return _physicsEnergy(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _physicsMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isEnglish(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'grammar',
        'tense',
        'tenses',
        'article',
        'sentence',
      ])) {
        return _englishGrammar(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['vocabulary', 'synonym', 'antonym', 'word'])) {
        return _englishVocabulary(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['reading', 'comprehension', 'passage'])) {
        return _englishReading(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _englishMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isArabic(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'نحو',
        'اعراب',
        'إعراب',
        'syntax',
        'grammar',
        'sentence structure',
      ])) {
        return _arabicNahw(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['مفردات', 'vocabulary', 'مرادف', 'مضاد'])) {
        return _arabicVocabulary(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['قراءة', 'فهم', 'comprehension', 'passage'])) {
        return _arabicReading(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _arabicMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isHebrew(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'grammar',
        'תחביר',
        'לשון',
        'binyanim',
        'sentence structure',

        return _hebrewGrammar(filter, topicLabel, seed);

        return _hebrewVocabulary(filter, topicLabel, seed);

===== apps/classmate_mobile/lib/features/practice/data/practice_generator.dart.cleanup.1773161465.bak =====
import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    final sessionSalt = DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.abs();
    var seed = _seedFromFilter(filter) + sessionSalt;
    var attempts = 0;
    final maxAttempts = count * 90;

    while (out.length < count && attempts < maxAttempts) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 17 + attempts * 11),
        filter,
        seed + attempts,
      );
      attempts++;
      if (used.add(_fingerprint(q))) {
        out.add(q);
      }
    }

    while (out.length < count) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 29),
        filter,
        seed + out.length * 13,
      );
      out.add(
        PracticeQuestion(
          id: '${q.id}-${out.length}-${sessionSalt % 100000}',
          subject: q.subject,
          topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
          mode: q.mode,
          difficulty: q.difficulty,
          prompt: q.prompt,
          options: q.options,
          correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
          explanation: q.explanation,
          recommendedTimeSeconds: q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
        ),
      );
    }

    return out;
  }

  PracticeQuestion _postProcessMode(
    PracticeQuestion q,
    PracticeFilter filter,
    int seed,
  ) {
    final decoratedPrompt = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards =>
        'Flashcard\nRemember first, reveal second.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Speed round\nAnswer fast.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep =>
        'Bagrut-style / exam-style\nRead carefully and choose precisely.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder =>
        'Concept builder\nUnderstand the rule, then solve.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive =>
        'Adaptive mode\nThe session can shift in pace and level.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep =>
        'Bagrut-style\nSolve like a formal school exam question.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.prompt,
    };

    final decoratedExplanation = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => 'Flashcard review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Fast review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep => 'Exam reasoning: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => 'Concept walkthrough: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive => 'Adaptive feedback: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep => 'Bagrut reasoning: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.explanation,
    };

    final adjustedTime = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 6,
      PracticeMode.speedRound => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 10,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 12,
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 8,
      PracticeMode.adaptive => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 16,
      PracticeMode.practice => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
    };

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: '${q.id}-${seed.abs() % 10000}',
      subject: q.subject,
      topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
      mode: q.mode,
      difficulty: q.difficulty,
      prompt: decoratedPrompt,
      options: q.options,
      correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
      explanation: decoratedExplanation,
      recommendedTimeSeconds: adjustedTime < 8 ? 8 : adjustedTime,
    );
  }
