import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    final sessionSalt = DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.abs();
    var seed = _seedFromFilter(filter) + sessionSalt;
    var attempts = 0;
    final maxAttempts = count * 90;

    while (out.length < count && attempts < maxAttempts) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 17 + attempts * 11),
        filter,
        seed + attempts,
      );
      attempts++;
      if (used.add(_fingerprint(q))) {
        out.add(q);
      }
    }

    while (out.length < count) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 29),
        filter,
        seed + out.length * 13,
      );
      out.add(
        PracticeQuestion(
          id: '${q.id}-${out.length}-${sessionSalt % 100000}',
          subject: q.subject,
          topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
          mode: q.mode,
          difficulty: q.difficulty,
          prompt: q.prompt,
          options: q.options,
          correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
          explanation: q.explanation,
          recommendedTimeSeconds: q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
        ),
      );
    }

    return out;
  }

  PracticeQuestion _postProcessMode(
    PracticeQuestion q,
    PracticeFilter filter,
    int seed,
  ) {
    final decoratedPrompt = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards =>
        'Flashcard\nRemember first, reveal second.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Speed round\nAnswer fast.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep =>
        'Bagrut-style / exam-style\nRead carefully and choose precisely.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder =>
        'Concept builder\nUnderstand the rule, then solve.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive =>
        'Adaptive mode\nThe session can shift in pace and level.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep =>
        'Bagrut-style\nSolve like a formal school exam question.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.prompt,
    };

    final decoratedExplanation = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => 'Flashcard review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Fast review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep => 'Exam reasoning: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => 'Concept walkthrough: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive => 'Adaptive feedback: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep => 'Bagrut reasoning: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.explanation,
    };

    final adjustedTime = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 6,
      PracticeMode.speedRound => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 10,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 12,
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 8,
      PracticeMode.adaptive => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,

    );
  }

import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    final sessionSalt = DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.abs();
    var seed = _seedFromFilter(filter) + sessionSalt;
    var attempts = 0;
    final maxAttempts = count * 90;

    while (out.length < count && attempts < maxAttempts) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 17 + attempts * 11),
        filter,
        seed + attempts,
      );
      attempts++;
      if (used.add(_fingerprint(q))) {
        out.add(q);
      }
    }

    while (out.length < count) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 29),
        filter,
        seed + out.length * 13,
      );
      out.add(
        PracticeQuestion(
          id: '${q.id}-${out.length}-${sessionSalt % 100000}',
          subject: q.subject,
          topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
          mode: q.mode,
          difficulty: q.difficulty,
          prompt: q.prompt,
          options: q.options,
          correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
          explanation: q.explanation,
          recommendedTimeSeconds: q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
        ),
      );
    }

    return out;
  }

  PracticeQuestion _postProcessMode(
    PracticeQuestion q,
    PracticeFilter filter,
    int seed,
  ) {
    final decoratedPrompt = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards =>
        'Flashcard\nRemember first, reveal second.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Speed round\nAnswer fast.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep =>
        'Bagrut-style / exam-style\nRead carefully and choose precisely.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder =>
        'Concept builder\nUnderstand the rule, then solve.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive =>
        'Adaptive mode\nThe session can shift in pace and level.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.prompt,
    };

    final decoratedExplanation = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => 'Flashcard review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Fast review: ${q.explanation}',

      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => 'Concept walkthrough: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive => 'Adaptive feedback: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.explanation,

      PracticeMode.speedRound => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 10,

      PracticeMode.practice => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
    };

    return PracticeQuestion(

      topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
      mode: q.mode,
      difficulty: q.difficulty,
      prompt: decoratedPrompt,
      options: q.options,
      correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
      explanation: decoratedExplanation,
      recommendedTimeSeconds: adjustedTime < 8 ? 8 : adjustedTime,
    );
  }

import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    var seed = _seedFromFilter(filter);

    while (out.length < count) {
      final question = _buildQuestion(filter, seed++);
      final key = _fingerprint(question);
      if (used.add(key)) {
        out.add(question);
      }
    }

    return out;
  }

  int _seedFromFilter(PracticeFilter filter) {
    final text = [
      filter.subject,
      ...filter.topicPath,
      filter.mode.name,
      filter.difficulty.name,
      '${filter.questionCount}',
      '${filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? -1}',
    ].join('|');

    var total = 17;
    for (final code in text.codeUnits) {
      total = (total * 31 + code) & 0x7fffffff;
    }
    return total;
  }

  String _fingerprint(PracticeQuestion q) =>
      '${_norm(q.subject)}|${_norm(q.topicLabel)}|${_norm(q.prompt)}|${q.correctIndex}';

        ? <String>['General']
        : filter.topicPath;

    final topic = _norm(topicLabel);

      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'if',
        'if statement',
        'if statements',
        'condition',
        'conditional',
        'branch',
        'branching',
      ])) {
        return _csIfStatements(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [

  PracticeQuestion _csIfStatements(

          ),

            seed: seed,

import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = max(1, filter.questionCount);
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};
    final seedBase = _seedFromFilter(filter);

    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      PracticeQuestion q;
      var attempts = 0;

      do {
        final seed = seedBase + i * 977 + attempts * 131;
        q = _buildQuestion(filter, seed, i);
        attempts++;
      } while (used.contains(_fingerprint(q)) && attempts < 20);

      used.add(_fingerprint(q));
      out.add(q);
    }

    return out;
  }

  PracticeQuestion _buildQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int seed, int index) {
    final subject = _norm(filter.subject);
    final topicLabel = filter.topicLabel;
    final topic = _norm(topicLabel);
    final r = Random(seed);

    if (_hasAny(subject, ['math', 'mathematics'])) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['quadratic', 'parabola', 'trinomial'])) {
        return _mathQuadratic(filter, topicLabel, seed, index);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['linear', 'slope', 'line', 'affine', 'intercept'])) {
        return _mathLinear(filter, topicLabel, seed, index);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['probability', 'chance', 'combinatorics'])) {
        return _mathProbability(filter, topicLabel, seed, index);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['geometry', 'triangle', 'circle', 'angle'])) {
        return _mathGeometry(filter, topicLabel, seed, index);
      }
      return r.nextBool()
          ? _mathLinear(filter, topicLabel, seed, index)
          : _mathQuadratic(filter, topicLabel, seed, index);
    }

    if (_hasAny(subject, ['physics'])) {
      return _physicsForces(filter, topicLabel, seed, index);
    }

    if (_hasAny(subject, ['computer science', 'cs', 'programming'])) {
      return _csBigO(filter, topicLabel, seed, index);
    }

    return _genericQuestion(filter, topicLabel, seed, index);
  }

  PracticeQuestion _mathLinear(
    PracticeFilter filter,
    String topicLabel,
    int seed,
    int index,
  ) {
    final m = _scaledNumber(
      filter,
      seed + 1,
      easy: 2,
      medium: 4,
      hard: 7,
      olympiad: 11,
    );
    final c = _scaledNumber(
      filter,
      seed + 2,
      easy: 1,
      medium: 3,
      hard: 6,
      olympiad: 10,
    );
    final x = _scaledNumber(

      medium: 4,
      hard: 8,
      olympiad: 12,
    );
    final y = m * x + c;

    final prompt = _modePrompt(
      filter,
      base: 'For y = ${m}x + $c, what is y when x = $x?',
      exam: 'Evaluate y = ${m}x + $c at x = $x.',
      concept: 'Substitute x = $x into y = ${m}x + $c.',
    );

    final options = _shuffledOptions(
      seed: seed + 10,
      correct: '$y',
      distractors: ['$m', '${m + x + c}', '${m * x}'],
    );

      subject: 'Math',
      topicLabel: topicLabel,
      prompt: prompt,
      options: options,
      correct: '$y',
      explanation: 'Substitute x = $x: y = $m($x) + $c = $y.',
      timeSeconds: _timeFor(filter, base: 16, hard: 24, olympiad: 30),
      index: index,
    );
  }

  PracticeQuestion _mathQuadratic(
    PracticeFilter filter,
    String topicLabel,
    int seed,
    int index,
  ) {
    final r1 = _scaledSignedNumber(
      filter,
      seed + 1,
      easy: 2,
      medium: 4,
      hard: 7,
      olympiad: 10,
    );
    var r2 = _scaledSignedNumber(
      filter,
      seed + 2,
      easy: 3,
      medium: 5,
      hard: 8,
      olympiad: 11,
    );
    if (r2 == r1) r2 += 1;

    final b = -(r1 + r2);
    final c = r1 * r2;

    final prompt = _modePrompt(
      filter,
      base:
          'For y = x² ${b >= 0 ? '+' : '-'} ${b.abs()}x ${c >= 0 ? '+' : '-'} ${c.abs()}, what are the roots?',
      exam:
          'Solve x² ${b >= 0 ? '+' : '-'} ${b.abs()}x ${c >= 0 ? '+' : '-'} ${c.abs()} = 0.',
      concept:
          'Factor x² ${b >= 0 ? '+' : '-'} ${b.abs()}x ${c >= 0 ? '+' : '-'} ${c.abs()} and find the zeros.',
    );

    const x2 = 'x²';
    final correct = 'x = $r1 and x = $r2';
    final options = _shuffledOptions(
      seed: seed + 9,
      correct: correct,
      distractors: [
        'x = ${r1 + r2}',
        'x = ${r1 - r2} and x = ${r2 - r1}',
        'No real roots',
      ],
    );

    return _q(
      filter: filter,
      subject: 'Math',
      topicLabel: topicLabel,
      prompt: prompt.replaceAll('x²', x2),
      options: options,
      correct: correct,
      explanation:
          'The quadratic factors to (x - $r1)(x - $r2) = 0, so the roots are $r1 and $r2.',
      timeSeconds: _timeFor(filter, base: 28, hard: 40, olympiad: 55),
      index: index,
    );
  }

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';

String normalizeMathInline(String text) {
  var t = text;

  // Convert \( ... \) → $...$
  t = t.replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r'\\((.*?)\\)'), (m) => '\$${m.group(1)}\$');

  // Convert \[ ... \] → $...$
  t = t.replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r'\\[(.*?)\\]'), (m) => '\$${m.group(1)}\$');

  // Repair lost leading backslashes on common latex commands inside math/text.
  t = t.replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(
      r'(^|[^\A-Za-z])(frac|sqrt|cdot|times|leq|geq|neq|pm|mp|approx|left|right|alpha|beta|gamma|delta|theta|lambda|mu|pi|sigma)',
    ),
    (m) => '${m.group(1)}\${m.group(2)}',
  );

  // Wrap simple powers if they are still plain text.
  t = t.replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(r'(?<!\$)([a-zA-Z0-9]+\^[0-9]+)(?!\$)'),
    (m) => '\$${m.group(1)}\$',
  );

  // Convert simple fractions like x/2 → \frac{x}{2}
  t = t.replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(r'(?<![\\\$])([a-zA-Z0-9]+)/([a-zA-Z0-9]+)'),
    (m) => '\\frac{${m.group(1)!}}{${m.group(2)!}}',
  );

  return t;
}

class PracticeGenerator {
  static const _apiBase = String.fromEnvironment(
    'CM_API_BASE_URL',
    defaultValue: 'http://127.0.0.1:3001',
  );

  static const _devToken = String.fromEnvironment('CM_DEV_TOKEN');

  final BagrutRepository _bagrutRepo = BagrutRepository();

  void _log(String message) {
    debugPrint('practice.generator $message');
  }

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    _log(
      'generation_started mode=${filter.mode.name} subject=${filter.subject} topic=${filter.topicLabel} count=${filter.questionCount}',
    );

    if (filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut) {
      final bagrut = await _generateBagrutQuestion(filter);
      if (bagrut != null) {
        _log('bagrut_used count=1');
        return [bagrut];
      }

      _log('bagrut_unavailable fallback_used reason=bagrut_null');
      final fallback = await generateFallback(filter);
      _log('question_count_returned source=fallback count=${fallback.length}');
      return fallback;
    }

    final remote = await _generateFromApiWithRetry(filter);
    if (remote.isNotEmpty) {
      _log('question_count_returned source=api count=${remote.length}');
      return remote;
    }

    _log('fallback_used reason=api_empty_after_retry');
    final fallback = await generateFallback(filter);
    _log('question_count_returned source=fallback count=${fallback.length}');
    return fallback;
  }

  Future<PracticeQuestion?> _generateBagrutQuestion(
    PracticeFilter filter,
  ) async {
    final dto = await _bagrutRepo.getQuestion(
      subject: filter.subject,
      topicLabel: filter.topicLabel,
    );
    if (dto == null) return null;

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: 'bagrut-${dto.examCode}-${dto.questionIndex}-${dto.year}',
      subject: dto.subject,
      topicLabel: dto.topicLabel,
      mode: PracticeMode.bagrut,
      difficulty: _parseDifficulty(dto.difficulty) ?? filter.difficulty,
      source: PracticeQuestionSource.bagrut,
      prompt: normalizeMathInline(
        dto.promptLatex.isNotEmpty ? dto.promptLatex : 'Bagrut question',
      ),
      options: const [
        'Open with NOVA',
        'Show official solution',
        'Save for later',
        'End question',
      ].map(normalizeMathInline).toList(),
      correctIndex: 1,
      explanation: normalizeMathInline(
        dto.solutionLatex.isNotEmpty
            ? dto.solutionLatex
            : 'Official Bagrut-style solution unavailable.',
      ),
      recommendedTimeSeconds: 3600,
    );
  }

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generateFallback(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    _log(
      'fallback_used mode=${filter.mode.name} subject=${filter.subject} topic=${filter.topicLabel}',
    );
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final count = filter.questionCount < 1 ? 1 : filter.questionCount;

    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      out.add(_localQuestion(filter, i));
    }

    return out;
  }

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> _generateFromApiWithRetry(
    PracticeFilter filter,
  ) async {
    var last = const <PracticeQuestion>[];
    for (var attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
      last = await _generateFromApi(filter);
      if (last.isNotEmpty) {
        _log('api_success attempt=${attempt + 1} count=${last.length}');
        return last;
      }
      _log('api_failure attempt=${attempt + 1} reason=empty_after_parse');
      await Future<void>.delayed(
        Duration(milliseconds: attempt == 0 ? 700 : 0),
      );
    }
    return last;
  }

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> _generateFromApi(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final client = HttpClient()
      ..connectionTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 60);

    try {
      final uri = Uri.parse('$_apiBase/practice/generate');
      _log('api_request_started uri=$uri');
      _log('api_request_dev_token_len=${_devToken.length}');
      final req = await client
          .postUrl(uri)
          .timeout(
            const Duration(seconds: 90),
            onTimeout: () => throw TimeoutException(
              'practice.generate postUrl timeout after 20s',
            ),
          );

      req.headers.contentType = ContentType.json;
      req.headers.set(HttpHeaders.acceptHeader, 'application/json');
      if (_devToken.isNotEmpty) {
        req.headers.set(HttpHeaders.authorizationHeader, 'Bearer $_devToken');
      }

      final payload = <String, Object?>{
        'subject': filter.subject,
        'topicLabel': filter.topicLabel,
        'topicPath': filter.topicPath,
        'topicPathText': filter.topicPath.isEmpty
            ? filter.topicLabel
            : filter.topicPath.join(' > '),
        'mode': filter.mode.name,
        'difficulty': filter.difficulty.name,
        'questionCount': filter.questionCount,
        'timePreferenceSeconds': filter.timePreferenceSeconds,
        'useAiTiming': filter.useAiTiming,
        'maxLives': filter.maxLives,
        'strictPromptSummary': buildStrictPracticeFilterSection(filter),
      };

      _log('api_request_payload=${jsonEncode(payload)}');
      req.write(jsonEncode(payload));

      final res = await req.close().timeout(
        const Duration(seconds: 90),
        onTimeout: () =>
            throw TimeoutException('practice.generate close timeout after 90s'),
      );
      final body = await utf8
          .decodeStream(res)
          .timeout(
            const Duration(seconds: 60),
            onTimeout: () => throw TimeoutException(
              'practice.generate body timeout after 90s',
            ),
          );
      _log('api_response_status=${res.statusCode}');

      if (res.statusCode < 200 || res.statusCode >= 300) {
        _log('api_failure reason=http_${res.statusCode} body=$body');
        return const [];
      }

      final decoded = jsonDecode(body);
      final rawQuestions = _extractQuestions(decoded);

      _log('api_raw_question_count=${rawQuestions.length}');

      final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
      for (var i = 0; i < rawQuestions.length; i++) {
        final q = _parseQuestion(rawQuestions[i], filter: filter, index: i);
        if (q != null) {
          out.add(q);
        } else {
          _log('api_question_dropped index=$i reason=parse_null');
        }
      }

      _log('api_success_parsed_count=${out.length}');
      return out;
    } catch (e, st) {
      _log('api_failure reason=exception error=$e');
      debugPrint('$st');
      return const [];
    } finally {
      client.close(force: true);
    }
  }

  List<dynamic> _extractQuestions(dynamic decoded) {
    if (decoded is List) return decoded;
    if (decoded is Map<String, dynamic>) {
      final direct = decoded['questions'];
      if (direct is List) return direct;

      final data = decoded['data'];
      if (data is Map<String, dynamic>) {
        final qs = data['questions'];
        if (qs is List) return qs;
      }

      final items = decoded['items'];
      if (items is List) return items;
    }
    return const [];
  }

  PracticeQuestion? _parseQuestion(
    dynamic raw, {
    required PracticeFilter filter,
    required int index,
  }) {
    if (raw is! Map) return null;

    final map = raw.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k.toString(), v));

    final prompt =
        _asString(map['prompt']) ??
        _asString(map['question']) ??
        _asString(map['text']) ??
        '';

    if (prompt.trim().isEmpty) return null;

    final rawOptions =
        map['options'] ??
        map['choices'] ??
        map['answers'] ??

          correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
          explanation: q.explanation,
          recommendedTimeSeconds: q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
        ),
      );
    }

  }

  PracticeQuestion _postProcessMode(
    PracticeQuestion q,
    PracticeFilter filter,
    int seed,
  ) {
    final decoratedPrompt = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards =>
        'Flashcard\nRemember first, reveal second.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Speed round\nAnswer fast.\n\n${q.prompt}',

      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder =>
        'Concept builder\nUnderstand the rule, then solve.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive =>
        'Adaptive mode\nThe session can shift in pace and level.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.bagrut =>
        'Bagrut-style\nSolve like a formal school exam question.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.prompt,
    };

    final decoratedExplanation = switch (filter.mode) {

      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Fast review: ${q.explanation}',

      PracticeMode.speedRound => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 10,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 12,

      PracticeMode.bagrut => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 16,

      options: q.options,

      explanation: decoratedExplanation,
      recommendedTimeSeconds: adjustedTime < 8 ? 8 : adjustedTime,

  }

import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    var seed = _seedFromFilter(filter);
    var attempts = 0;
    final maxAttempts = count * 40;

    while (out.length < count && attempts < maxAttempts) {
      final question = _buildQuestion(filter, seed++);
      final key = _fingerprint(question);
      attempts++;

      if (used.add(key)) {
        out.add(question);
      }
    }

    while (out.length < count) {
      final base = _buildQuestion(filter, seed++);
      out.add(
        PracticeQuestion(
          id: '${base.id}-${out.length}',
          subject: base.subject,
          topicLabel: base.topicLabel,
          mode: base.mode,
          difficulty: base.difficulty,
          prompt: base.prompt,
          options: base.options,
          correctIndex: base.correctIndex,
          explanation: base.explanation,
          recommendedTimeSeconds: base.recommendedTimeSeconds,
        ),
      );
    }

    return out;
  }

  int _seedFromFilter(PracticeFilter filter) {
    final text = [
      filter.subject,
      ...filter.topicPath,
      filter.mode.name,
      filter.difficulty.name,
      '${filter.questionCount}',
      '${filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? -1}',
    ].join('|');

    var total = 17;
    for (final code in text.codeUnits) {
      total = (total * 31 + code) & 0x7fffffff;
    }
    return total;
  }

  String _fingerprint(PracticeQuestion q) =>
      '${_norm(q.subject)}|${_norm(q.topicLabel)}|${_norm(q.prompt)}|${q.correctIndex}';

  PracticeQuestion _buildQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int seed) {
    final subject = _norm(filter.subject);
    final topicPath = filter.topicPath.isEmpty
        ? <String>['General']
        : filter.topicPath;
    final topicLabel = topicPath.join(' • ');
    final topic = _norm(topicLabel);

    if (_isCS(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'if',
        'if statement',
        'if statements',
        'condition',
        'conditional',
        'branch',
        'branching',
      ])) {
        return _csIfStatements(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'loop',
        'loops',
        'for',
        'while',
        'iteration',
        'iterative',
      ])) {
        return _csLoops(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'variable',
        'variables',
        'assignment',
        'expression',
        'operator',
      ])) {
        return _csVariables(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'big o',
        'complexity',
        'time complexity',
        'space complexity',
        'algorithm analysis',
      ])) {
        return _csComplexity(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'data structure',
        'stack',
        'queue',
        'array',
        'list',
        'tree',
        'hash',
        'dictionary',
      ])) {
        return _csDataStructures(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _csMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isMath(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'geometry',
        'triangle',
        'circle',
        'angle',
        'perimeter',
        'area',
        'parallel',
        'polygon',
        'rectangle',
      ])) {
        return _mathGeometry(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'function',
        'algebra',
        'equation',
        'linear',
        'quadratic',
        'slope',
      ])) {
        return _mathAlgebra(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'probability',
        'combinatorics',
        'chance',
        'counting',
      ])) {
        return _mathProbability(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _mathMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isPhysics(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['newton', 'force', 'second law', 'dynamics'])) {
        return _physicsNewton(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'kinematics',
        'velocity',
        'speed',
        'acceleration',
        'displacement',
        'motion',
      ])) {
        return _physicsKinematics(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['energy', 'work', 'power', 'kinetic', 'potential'])) {
        return _physicsEnergy(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _physicsMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    return _generalFallback(filter, topicLabel, seed);
  }

  PracticeQuestion _csIfStatements(
    PracticeFilter filter,
    String topicLabel,
    int seed,
  ) {
    final builders = <PracticeQuestion Function()>[
      () {
        final x = _range(seed, 2, 14);
        final y = _range(seed + 1, 1, 12);
        final op = _pickOne(seed + 2, ['>', '<', '>=', '<=']);
        final condition = switch (op) {
          '>' => x > y,
          '<' => x < y,
          '>=' => x >= y,
          '<=' => x <= y,
          _ => false,
        };
        final output = condition ? 'A' : 'B';

        return _question(
          filter: filter,
          subject: 'CS',
          topicLabel: topicLabel,
          prompt: _modePrompt(
            filter,
            base:
                'What will this code print?\n\nint x = $x;\nint y = $y;\nif (x $op y) {\n  print("A");\n} else {\n  print("B");\n}',
            exam:
                'A student runs this program:\n\nint x = $x;\nint y = $y;\nif (x $op y) {\n  print("A");\n} else {\n  print("B");\n}\n\nWhich output is produced?',
            concept:
                'Focus on the condition first, then decide which branch runs:\n\nint x = $x;\nint y = $y;\nif (x $op y) {\n  print("A");\n} else {\n  print("B");\n}\n\nWhat is printed?',
          ),
          options: _shuffledOptions(
            seed: seed,
            correct: output,
            distractors: ['A and B', 'Nothing', output == 'A' ? 'B' : 'A'],
          ),
          explanation:
              'Evaluate the condition x $op y using x = $x and y = $y. That statement is ${condition ? 'true' : 'false'}, so the ${condition ? 'if' : 'else'} block runs and prints $output.',
          timeSeconds: _timeFor(filter, base: 18, hard: 28, olympiad: 35),
        );
      },
      () {
        final score = _range(seed, 40, 99);
        final threshold = _range(seed + 1, 50, 85);
        final passed = score >= threshold;
        final answer = passed ? 'Pass' : 'Retry';

        return _question(
          filter: filter,
          subject: 'CS',
          topicLabel: topicLabel,
          prompt: _modePrompt(
            filter,
            base:
                'A program checks:\n\nint score = $score;\nif (score >= $threshold) {\n  print("Pass");\n} else {\n  print("Retry");\n}\n\nWhat is printed?',
            exam:
                'An exam app labels students using this code:\n\nint score = $score;\nif (score >= $threshold) {\n  print("Pass");\n} else {\n  print("Retry");\n}\n\nWhich label appears?',
            concept:
                'Compare score with the threshold, then choose the branch:\n\nint score = $score;\nif (score >= $threshold) {\n  print("Pass");\n} else {\n  print("Retry");\n}\n\nWhat is printed?',
          ),
          options: _shuffledOptions(
            seed: seed + 17,
            correct: answer,
            distractors: ['score', '$threshold', passed ? 'Retry' : 'Pass'],
          ),
          explanation:
              'Because $score ${passed ? '>=' : '<'} $threshold, the condition is ${passed ? 'true' : 'false'}. Therefore the program prints "$answer".',
          timeSeconds: _timeFor(filter, base: 18, hard: 26, olympiad: 34),
        );
      },
      () {
        final temp = _range(seed, -2, 38);
        final low = _range(seed + 1, 5, 12);
        final high = low + _range(seed + 2, 12, 20);
        final label = temp < low
            ? 'Cold'
            : temp > high
            ? 'Hot'
            : 'Mild';

        return _question(
          filter: filter,
          subject: 'CS',
          topicLabel: topicLabel,
          prompt: _modePrompt(
            filter,
            base:
                'What will this code print when temp = $temp?\n\nif (temp < $low) {\n  print("Cold");\n} else if (temp > $high) {\n  print("Hot");\n} else {\n  print("Mild");\n}',
            exam:

import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    var seed = _seedFromFilter(filter);
    var attempts = 0;
    final maxAttempts = count * 40;

    while (out.length < count && attempts < maxAttempts) {
      final q = _buildQuestion(filter, seed++);
      attempts++;
      if (used.add(_fingerprint(q))) {
        out.add(q);
      }
    }

    while (out.length < count) {
      final q = _buildQuestion(filter, seed++);
      out.add(
        PracticeQuestion(
          id: '${q.id}-${out.length}',
          subject: q.subject,
          topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
          mode: q.mode,
          difficulty: q.difficulty,
          prompt: q.prompt,
          options: q.options,
          correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
          explanation: q.explanation,
          recommendedTimeSeconds: q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
        ),
      );
    }

    return out;
  }

  PracticeQuestion _buildQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int seed) {
    final subject = _norm(filter.subject);
    final topicLabel = filter.topicPath.isEmpty
        ? 'General'
        : filter.topicPath.join(' • ');
    final topic = _norm(topicLabel);

    if (_isCS(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'if',
        'if statement',
        'if statements',
        'condition',
        'conditions',
        'conditional',
        'branch',
        'else',
        'boolean',
      ])) {
        return _csIfStatements(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['loop', 'loops', 'for', 'while', 'iteration'])) {
        return _csLoops(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['variable', 'variables', 'assignment', 'operator'])) {
        return _csVariables(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['big o', 'complexity', 'algorithm'])) {
        return _csComplexity(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'array',
        'arrays',
        'stack',
        'queue',
        'tree',
        'map',
      ])) {
        return _csDataStructures(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _csMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isMath(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'geometry',
        'triangle',
        'circle',
        'angle',
        'rectangle',
        'perimeter',
        'area',
      ])) {
        return _mathGeometry(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'function',

        'algebra',
        'equation',
        'linear',

        'slope',
      ])) {
        return _mathAlgebra(filter, topicLabel, seed);

    }

      seed: seed,
    );

import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  final Random _rng = Random();

  static const Map<String, List<PracticeTopicNode>> topicTree =

          PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Waves'),

          PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Data Structures'),
          PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Networks'),
        ],

          PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Algebra'),
          PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Functions'),
          PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Calculus'),
          PracticeTopicNode(label: 'Probability'),
        ],
      };

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    return List<PracticeQuestion>.generate(
      filter.questionCount,
      (index) => _buildQuestion(filter, index),
      growable: false,
    );
  }

  PracticeQuestion _buildQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int index) {
    final topic = filter.topicLabel;
    if (filter.subject == 'Physics' && topic.contains('Newton Second Law')) {
      return _physicsNewtonQuestion(filter, index);
    }
    if (filter.subject == 'Computer Science' && topic.contains('Big-O')) {
      return _bigOQuestion(filter, index);
    }
    if (filter.subject == 'Math') {
      return _mathQuestion(filter, index);
    }
    return _conceptQuestion(filter, index);
  }

  PracticeQuestion _physicsNewtonQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int index) {
    final mass = 1 + _rng.nextInt(8);
    final accel = 2 + _rng.nextInt(8);
    final force = mass * accel;
    final options = <int>{
      force,
      force + mass,
      force + accel,
      max(1, force - accel),
    }.toList()..shuffle(_rng);
    final correctIndex = options.indexOf(force);

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: 'physics-newton-$index-${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}',
      subject: filter.subject,
      topicLabel: filter.topicLabel,
      mode: filter.mode,
      difficulty: filter.difficulty,
      prompt:
          'A $mass kg object accelerates at $accel m/s². What net force acts on it?',
      options: options.map((e) => '$e N').toList(growable: false),
      correctIndex: correctIndex,
      explanation:
          'Use Newton’s Second Law: F = m × a = $mass × $accel = $force N.',
      recommendedTimeSeconds: _timeFor(
        filter.difficulty,
        filter.mode,
        fallback: 15,
      ),
    );
  }

  PracticeQuestion _bigOQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int index) {
    const prompts = <Map<String, Object>>[
      <String, Object>{
        'prompt':
            'What is the time complexity of binary search in a sorted array?',
        'options': <String>['O(1)', 'O(log n)', 'O(n)', 'O(n log n)'],
        'correct': 1,
        'explanation':
            'Binary search halves the search space every step, so it runs in O(log n).',
      },
      <String, Object>{
        'prompt':
            'What is the time complexity of checking every pair in a list of n items?',
        'options': <String>['O(log n)', 'O(n)', 'O(n²)', 'O(2^n)'],
        'correct': 2,
        'explanation': 'Two nested loops over n items usually produce O(n²).',
      },
      <String, Object>{
        'prompt': 'What best describes Big-O notation?',
        'options': <String>[
          'Exact runtime in seconds',
          'Upper-bound growth rate',
          'Memory address count',
          'Compiler optimization level',
        ],
        'correct': 1,
        'explanation':
            'Big-O describes how runtime or space grows as input size grows.',
      },
    ];

    final item = prompts[index % prompts.length];
    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: 'cs-bigo-$index-${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}',
      subject: filter.subject,
      topicLabel: filter.topicLabel,
      mode: filter.mode,
      difficulty: filter.difficulty,
      prompt: item['prompt'] as String,
      options: (item['options'] as List<String>).toList(growable: false),
      correctIndex: item['correct'] as int,
      explanation: item['explanation'] as String,
      recommendedTimeSeconds: _timeFor(
        filter.difficulty,
        filter.mode,
        fallback: 12,
      ),
    );
  }

  PracticeQuestion _mathQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int index) {
    final a = 2 + _rng.nextInt(10);
    final b = 1 + _rng.nextInt(10);
    final correct = a + b;
    final options = <int>{
      correct,
      correct + 1,
      correct + 2,
      max(0, correct - 1),
    }.toList()..shuffle(_rng);
    final correctIndex = options.indexOf(correct);

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: 'math-$index-${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}',
      subject: filter.subject,
      topicLabel: filter.topicLabel,
      mode: filter.mode,
      difficulty: filter.difficulty,
      prompt: 'What is $a + $b ?',
      options: options.map((e) => '$e').toList(growable: false),
      correctIndex: correctIndex,
      explanation: 'Add the two numbers directly: $a + $b = $correct.',
      recommendedTimeSeconds: _timeFor(
        filter.difficulty,
        filter.mode,
        fallback: 8,
      ),
    );
  }

  PracticeQuestion _conceptQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int index) {
    const options = <String>[
      'Concept recall',
      'Analytical reasoning',
      'Procedural fluency',
      'All of the above',
    ];

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: 'concept-$index-${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}',
      subject: filter.subject,
      topicLabel: filter.topicLabel,
      mode: filter.mode,
      difficulty: filter.difficulty,
      prompt:
          'In ${filter.topicLabel}, which practice style helps most when building mastery?',
      options: options,
      correctIndex: 3,
      explanation:
          'Strong learning mixes recall, reasoning, and repeated procedural practice.',
      recommendedTimeSeconds: _timeFor(
        filter.difficulty,
        filter.mode,
        fallback: 10,
      ),
    );
  }

  int _timeFor(
    PracticeDifficulty difficulty,
    PracticeMode mode, {
    required int fallback,
  }) {
    if (mode == PracticeMode.speedRound) return 7;
    if (mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) return 0;
    switch (difficulty) {
      case PracticeDifficulty.easy:
        return max(6, fallback - 4);
      case PracticeDifficulty.medium:
        return fallback;
      case PracticeDifficulty.hard:
        return fallback + 7;
      case PracticeDifficulty.olympiad:
        return fallback + 15;
      case PracticeDifficulty.adaptive:
        return fallback;
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:math';

class PracticeGenerator {
  final Random _r = Random();

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];

    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      out.add(_generateQuestion(filter, i));
    }

    return out;
  }

  PracticeQuestion _generateQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int index) {
    final subject = filter.subject.trim().toLowerCase();
    final topic = filter.topicPath.isEmpty
        ? 'general'

    if (subject.contains('cs') ||
        subject.contains('computer') ||
        topic.contains('big o') ||
        topic.contains('algorithm')) {
      return _csQuestion(filter, index, topic);
    }

    if (subject.contains('physics') ||
        topic.contains('newton') ||
        topic.contains('force') ||
        topic.contains('motion')) {
      return _physicsQuestion(filter, index, topic);
    }

    if (subject.contains('math') ||
        topic.contains('algebra') ||
        topic.contains('function') ||
        topic.contains('derivative')) {
      return _mathQuestion(filter, index, topic);
    }

    return _generalQuestion(filter, index, topic);
  }

===== apps/classmate_mobile/lib/features/practice/data/practice_generator.dart.pass22.1773090737.bak =====
import 'dart:math';
import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  final Random _r = Random();

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];

    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      out.add(_question(filter, i));
    }

    return out;
  }

  PracticeQuestion _question(PracticeFilter filter, int index) {
    final a = _r.nextInt(30) + 10;
    final b = _r.nextInt(30) + 10;
    final correct = a + b;

    final options = [
      correct,
      correct + _r.nextInt(5) + 1,
      correct - (_r.nextInt(5) + 1),
      correct + _r.nextInt(8) + 2,
    ].map((e) => e.toString()).toList();

    options.shuffle();

    final correctIndex = options.indexOf(correct.toString());

    final prompt = "What is $a + $b ?";
    final explanation = "Add the numbers directly: $a + $b = $correct.";
    final topic = filter.topicPath.isEmpty
        ? "General"
        : filter.topicPath.join(" • ");
    final recommended = switch (filter.difficulty) {
      PracticeDifficulty.easy => 20,
      PracticeDifficulty.medium => 35,
      PracticeDifficulty.hard => 50,
      PracticeDifficulty.olympiad => 70,
      PracticeDifficulty.adaptive => 40,
    };

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: 'q_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}_$index',
      subject: filter.subject,
      topicLabel: topic,
      mode: filter.mode,
      difficulty: filter.difficulty,
      prompt: prompt,
      options: options,
      correctIndex: correct,
      explanation: explanation,
      recommendedTimeSeconds: recommended,
    );
  }
}

===== apps/classmate_mobile/lib/features/practice/data/practice_generator.dart.pass27.1773093426.bak =====
import 'dart:math';
import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  final Random _r = Random();

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    return List.generate(count, (i) => _buildQuestion(filter, i));
  }

  PracticeQuestion _buildQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int index) {
    final subject = filter.subject.trim().toLowerCase();
    final topicLabel = filter.topicPath.isEmpty
        ? 'General'
        : filter.topicPath.join(' • ');
    final topic = topicLabel.toLowerCase();

    late final String prompt;
    late final List<String> options;
    late final int correctIndex;
    late final String explanation;

    if (subject.contains('cs') ||
        subject.contains('computer') ||
        topic.contains('big o') ||
        topic.contains('algorithm')) {
      final bank = <Map<String, dynamic>>[
        {
          'prompt':
              'What is the worst-case time complexity of binary search on a sorted array?',
          'options': ['O(1)', 'O(log n)', 'O(n)', 'O(n log n)'],
          'correct': 1,
          'explanation':
              'Binary search halves the search space each step, so the worst-case complexity is O(log n).',
        },
        {
          'prompt':
              'Which Big-O best describes inserting one item into a binary heap?',
          'options': ['O(1)', 'O(log n)', 'O(n)', 'O(n²)'],
          'correct': 1,
          'explanation':
              'Insertion may bubble up through the heap height, so it is O(log n).',
        },
        {
          'prompt': 'Which traversal of a BST returns keys in sorted order?',
          'options': ['Preorder', 'Postorder', 'Inorder', 'Level-order'],
          'correct': 2,
          'explanation':
              'Inorder traversal of a BST returns the keys in sorted order.',
        },
        {
          'prompt':
              'If an algorithm has two full nested loops each running n times, what is the typical time complexity?',
          'options': ['O(n)', 'O(log n)', 'O(n²)', 'O(2ⁿ)'],
          'correct': 2,
          'explanation':
              'A full nested pair of n-length loops performs about n×n operations, so O(n²).',
        },
      ];
      final picked = bank[_bankIndex(filter, bank.length)];
      prompt = picked['prompt'] as String;
      options = (picked['options'] as List)
          .map((e) => e.toString())
          .toList(growable: false);
      correctIndex = picked['correct'] as int;
      explanation = picked['explanation'] as String;
    } else if (subject.contains('physics') ||
        topic.contains('newton') ||
        topic.contains('force') ||
        topic.contains('motion')) {
      final mass = _numberByDifficulty(
        filter,
        easy: 2,
        medium: 5,
        hard: 9,
        olympiad: 13,
      );
      final accel = _numberByDifficulty(
        filter,
        easy: 3,
        medium: 6,
        hard: 8,
        olympiad: 11,
      );
      final force = mass * accel;
      prompt =
          'A $mass kg object accelerates at $accel m/s². What is the net force?';
      options = [
        '${force - 2} N',
        '$force N',
        '${force + 2} N',
        '${force + 6} N',
      ];
      correctIndex = 1;
      explanation =
          'Use Newton’s second law: F = ma = $mass × $accel = $force N.';
    } else if (subject.contains('math')) {
      if (topic.contains('derivative')) {
        final a = _numberByDifficulty(
          filter,
          easy: 2,
          medium: 4,
          hard: 7,
          olympiad: 9,
        );
        final p = _numberByDifficulty(
          filter,
          easy: 2,
          medium: 3,
          hard: 4,
          olympiad: 5,
        );
        final coeff = a * p;
        final newPow = p - 1;
        prompt = "If f(x) = ${a}x^$p, what is f'(x)?";
        options = [
          '${a}x^$p',
          '${coeff}x^$newPow',
          '${p}x^${a}',
          '${coeff}x^$p',
        ];
        correctIndex = 1;
        explanation =
            "Use the power rule: d/dx(ax^n) = a·n·x^(n-1), so the derivative is $coeff x^$newPow.";
      } else if (topic.contains('function') || topic.contains('algebra')) {
        final a = _numberByDifficulty(
          filter,
          easy: 2,
          medium: 4,
          hard: 7,
          olympiad: 10,
        );
        final b = _numberByDifficulty(
          filter,
          easy: 3,
          medium: 8,
          hard: 12,
          olympiad: 20,
        );
        final x = _numberByDifficulty(
          filter,
          easy: 2,
          medium: 4,
          hard: 6,
          olympiad: 9,
        );
        final answer = a * x + b;
        prompt = 'If f(x) = $a x + $b, what is f($x)?';
        options = [
          '$answer',
          '${answer + 2}',
          '${answer - 2}',
          '${answer + 5}',
        ];
        correctIndex = 0;
        explanation =
            'Substitute x = $x into f(x) = $a x + $b, so f($x) = $a·$x + $b = $answer.';
      } else {
        final a = _numberByDifficulty(
          filter,
          easy: 8,
          medium: 17,
          hard: 29,
          olympiad: 43,
        );
        final b = _numberByDifficulty(
          filter,
          easy: 3,
          medium: 6,
          hard: 9,
          olympiad: 12,
        );
        final c = _numberByDifficulty(
          filter,
          easy: 2,
          medium: 4,
          hard: 7,
          olympiad: 11,
        );
        final answer = a + b * c;
        prompt = 'Evaluate: $a + $b × $c';
        options = ['$answer', '${(a + b) * c}', '${a * b + c}', '${a + b + c}'];
        correctIndex = 0;
        explanation =
            'Use order of operations: multiply first, then add. So $a + ($b × $c) = $answer.';
      }
    } else {
      final bank = <Map<String, dynamic>>[
        {
          'prompt':
              'Which study strategy is strongest for long-term retention?',
          'options': [
            'Passive rereading',
            'Spaced repetition',
            'Highlighting only',
            'One-night cramming',
          ],
          'correct': 1,
          'explanation':
              'Spaced repetition is one of the strongest evidence-based methods for long-term memory.',
        },
        {
          'prompt': 'What is the main goal of active recall?',
          'options': [
            'Make notes prettier',
            'Retrieve information from memory',
            'Read faster',
            'Avoid all mistakes',
          ],
          'correct': 1,
          'explanation':
              'Active recall trains your brain to retrieve information, which improves retention.',
        },
      ];
      final picked = bank[_bankIndex(filter, bank.length)];
      prompt = picked['prompt'] as String;
      options = (picked['options'] as List)
          .map((e) => e.toString())
          .toList(growable: false);
      correctIndex = picked['correct'] as int;
      explanation = picked['explanation'] as String;
    }

    final recommended = _recommendedTime(filter);

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: 'q_${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}_$index',
      subject: filter.subject,
      topicLabel: topicLabel,
      mode: filter.mode,
      difficulty: filter.difficulty,
      prompt: prompt,
      options: options,
      correctIndex: correctIndex,
      explanation: explanation,
      recommendedTimeSeconds: recommended,
    );
  }

  int _recommendedTime(PracticeFilter filter) {
    if (!filter.useAiTiming && filter.timePreferenceSeconds != null) {
      return filter.timePreferenceSeconds!;
    }

    switch (filter.difficulty) {
      case PracticeDifficulty.easy:
        return 20;
      case PracticeDifficulty.medium:
        return 35;
      case PracticeDifficulty.hard:
        return 50;
      case PracticeDifficulty.olympiad:
        return 80;
      case PracticeDifficulty.adaptive:
        return 45;
    }
  }

  int _bankIndex(PracticeFilter filter, int len) {
    if (len <= 1) return 0;
    switch (filter.difficulty) {
      case PracticeDifficulty.easy:
        return 0;
      case PracticeDifficulty.medium:
        return min(1, len - 1);
      case PracticeDifficulty.hard:
        return min(2, len - 1);
      case PracticeDifficulty.olympiad:
        return len - 1;
      case PracticeDifficulty.adaptive:
        return _r.nextInt(len);
    }
  }

    PracticeFilter filter, {
    required int easy,
    required int medium,
    required int hard,

  PracticeQuestion _buildQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int index) {

    final subjectLower = subject.toLowerCase();

      explanation = picked['explanation'] as String;

        topicLower.contains('newton') ||

      correctIndex = picked['correct'] as int;

import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  final Random _r = Random();

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final used = <String>{};
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];

    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      PracticeQuestion q;
      var tries = 0;
      do {
        q = _buildQuestion(filter, i + tries);
        tries++;
      } while (used.contains(_keyOf(q)) && tries < 30);

      used.add(_keyOf(q));
      out.add(q);
    }

    return out;
  }

  String _keyOf(PracticeQuestion q) =>
      '${q.subject}|${q.topicLabel}|${q.prompt}';

  PracticeQuestion _buildQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int seed) {
    final subject = _norm(filter.subject);
    final topicLabel = filter.topicPath.isEmpty
        ? 'General'
        : filter.topicPath.join(' • ');
    final topic = _norm(topicLabel);

    if (_isMath(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'geometry',

        'angle',
        'polygon',
        'perimeter',
        'area',
        'parallel',
      ])) {
        return _mathGeometry(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['derivative', 'differentiat', 'calculus'])) {
        return _mathDerivatives(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['function', 'algebra', 'equation', 'linear'])) {
        return _mathAlgebra(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['sequence', 'series'])) {
        return _mathSequences(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['probability', 'combinatorics', 'chance'])) {
        return _mathProbability(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _mathMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isPhysics(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['newton', 'force', 'motion', 'dynamics'])) {
        return _physicsNewton(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['kinematic', 'velocity', 'speed', 'acceleration'])) {
        return _physicsKinematics(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['energy', 'work', 'power'])) {
        return _physicsEnergy(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _physicsMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isCS(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['big o', 'complexity', 'algorithm'])) {
        return _csComplexity(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'data structure',
        'queue',
        'stack',
        'tree',
        'hash',
      ])) {
        return _csStructures(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _csMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    return _generalFallback(filter, topicLabel, seed);
  }

import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    var seed = _seedFromFilter(filter);

    while (out.length < count) {
      final question = _buildQuestion(filter, seed++);
      final key = _fingerprint(question);
      if (used.add(key)) {
        out.add(question);
      }
    }

    return out;
  }

  int _seedFromFilter(PracticeFilter filter) {
    final text = [
      filter.subject,
      ...filter.topicPath,
      filter.mode.name,
      filter.difficulty.name,
      '${filter.questionCount}',
      '${filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? -1}',
    ].join('|');

    var total = 17;
    for (final code in text.codeUnits) {
      total = (total * 31 + code) & 0x7fffffff;
    }
    return total;
  }

  String _fingerprint(PracticeQuestion q) =>
      '${_norm(q.subject)}|${_norm(q.topicLabel)}|${_norm(q.prompt)}|${q.correctIndex}';

  PracticeQuestion _buildQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int seed) {
    final subject = _norm(filter.subject);
    final topicPath = filter.topicPath.isEmpty
        ? <String>['General']
        : filter.topicPath;
    final topicLabel = topicPath.join(' • ');
    final topic = _norm(topicLabel);

    if (_isCS(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'if',
        'if statement',
        'if statements',
        'condition',
        'conditional',
        'branch',
        'branching',
      ])) {
        return _csIfStatements(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'loop',
        'loops',
        'for',
        'while',
        'iteration',
        'iterative',
      ])) {
        return _csLoops(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'variable',
        'variables',
        'assignment',
        'expression',
        'operator',
      ])) {
        return _csVariables(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'big o',
        'complexity',
        'time complexity',
        'space complexity',
        'algorithm analysis',
      ])) {
        return _csComplexity(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'data structure',
        'stack',
        'queue',
        'array',
        'list',
        'tree',
        'hash',
        'dictionary',
      ])) {
        return _csDataStructures(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _csMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isMath(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'geometry',
        'triangle',
        'circle',
        'angle',
        'perimeter',
        'area',
        'parallel',
        'polygon',
        'rectangle',
      ])) {
        return _mathGeometry(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'function',
        'algebra',
        'equation',
        'linear',
        'quadratic',
        'slope',
      ])) {
        return _mathAlgebra(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'probability',
        'combinatorics',
        'chance',
        'counting',
      ])) {
        return _mathProbability(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _mathMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isPhysics(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['newton', 'force', 'second law', 'dynamics'])) {
        return _physicsNewton(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'kinematics',
        'velocity',
        'speed',
        'acceleration',
        'displacement',
        'motion',
      ])) {
        return _physicsKinematics(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['energy', 'work', 'power', 'kinetic', 'potential'])) {
        return _physicsEnergy(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _physicsMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    return _generalFallback(filter, topicLabel, seed);
  }

  PracticeQuestion _csIfStatements(
    PracticeFilter filter,
    String topicLabel,
    int seed,
  ) {
    final builders = <PracticeQuestion Function()>[
      () {
        final x = _range(seed, 2, 14);
        final y = _range(seed + 1, 1, 12);
        final op = _pickOne(seed + 2, ['>', '<', '>=', '<=']);
        final condition = switch (op) {
          '>' => x > y,
          '<' => x < y,
          '>=' => x >= y,
          '<=' => x <= y,
          _ => false,
        };
        final output = condition ? 'A' : 'B';

        return _question(
          filter: filter,
          subject: 'CS',
          topicLabel: topicLabel,
          prompt: _modePrompt(
            filter,
            base:
                'What will this code print?\n\nint x = $x;\nint y = $y;\nif (x $op y) {\n  print("A");\n} else {\n  print("B");\n}',
            exam:
                'A student runs this program:\n\nint x = $x;\nint y = $y;\nif (x $op y) {\n  print("A");\n} else {\n  print("B");\n}\n\nWhich output is produced?',
            concept:
                'Focus on the condition first, then decide which branch runs:\n\nint x = $x;\nint y = $y;\nif (x $op y) {\n  print("A");\n} else {\n  print("B");\n}\n\nWhat is printed?',
          ),
          options: _shuffledOptions(
            seed: seed,
            correct: output,
            distractors: ['A and B', 'Nothing', output == 'A' ? 'B' : 'A'],
          ),
          explanation:
              'Evaluate the condition x $op y using x = $x and y = $y. That statement is ${condition ? 'true' : 'false'}, so the ${condition ? 'if' : 'else'} block runs and prints $output.',
          timeSeconds: _timeFor(filter, base: 18, hard: 28, olympiad: 35),
        );
      },
      () {
        final score = _range(seed, 40, 99);
        final threshold = _range(seed + 1, 50, 85);
        final passed = score >= threshold;
        final answer = passed ? 'Pass' : 'Retry';

        return _question(
          filter: filter,
          subject: 'CS',
          topicLabel: topicLabel,
          prompt: _modePrompt(
            filter,
            base:
                'A program checks:\n\nint score = $score;\nif (score >= $threshold) {\n  print("Pass");\n} else {\n  print("Retry");\n}\n\nWhat is printed?',
            exam:
                'An exam app labels students using this code:\n\nint score = $score;\nif (score >= $threshold) {\n  print("Pass");\n} else {\n  print("Retry");\n}\n\nWhich label appears?',
            concept:
                'Compare score with the threshold, then choose the branch:\n\nint score = $score;\nif (score >= $threshold) {\n  print("Pass");\n} else {\n  print("Retry");\n}\n\nWhat is printed?',
          ),
          options: _shuffledOptions(
            seed: seed + 17,
            correct: answer,
            distractors: ['score', '$threshold', passed ? 'Retry' : 'Pass'],
          ),
          explanation:
              'Because $score ${passed ? '>=' : '<'} $threshold, the condition is ${passed ? 'true' : 'false'}. Therefore the program prints "$answer".',
          timeSeconds: _timeFor(filter, base: 18, hard: 26, olympiad: 34),
        );
      },
      () {
        final temp = _range(seed, -2, 38);
        final low = _range(seed + 1, 5, 12);
        final high = low + _range(seed + 2, 12, 20);
        final label = temp < low
            ? 'Cold'
            : temp > high
            ? 'Hot'
            : 'Mild';

        return _question(
          filter: filter,
          subject: 'CS',
          topicLabel: topicLabel,
          prompt: _modePrompt(
            filter,
            base:
                'What will this code print when temp = $temp?\n\nif (temp < $low) {\n  print("Cold");\n} else if (temp > $high) {\n  print("Hot");\n} else {\n  print("Mild");\n}',
            exam:
                'A weather app uses:\n\nint temp = $temp;\nif (temp < $low) {\n  print("Cold");\n} else if (temp > $high) {\n  print("Hot");\n} else {\n  print("Mild");\n}\n\nWhich branch is taken?',
            concept:
                'Check the first condition. If it fails, move to else-if:\n\nint temp = $temp;\nif (temp < $low) {\n  print("Cold");\n} else if (temp > $high) {\n  print("Hot");\n} else {\n  print("Mild");\n}\n\nWhat is printed?',
          ),
          options: _shuffledOptions(
            seed: seed + 31,
            correct: label,
            distractors: [
              label == 'Cold' ? 'Hot' : 'Cold',
              label == 'Mild' ? 'Hot' : 'Mild',
              'The code crashes',
            ],
          ),
          explanation:
              'Test the conditions in order. temp = $temp is ${temp < low
                  ? 'less than $low'
                  : temp > high
                  ? 'greater than $high'
                  : 'between $low and $high'}, so the program prints "$label".',
          timeSeconds: _timeFor(filter, base: 22, hard: 34, olympiad: 42),
        );
      },

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

String normalizeMathInline(String text) {
  var t = text;

  // Convert \( ... \) → $...$
  t = t.replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r'\\((.*?)\\)'), (m) => '\$${m.group(1)}\$');

  // Convert \[ ... \] → $...$
  t = t.replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r'\\[(.*?)\\]'), (m) => '\$${m.group(1)}\$');

  // Repair lost leading backslashes on common latex commands inside math/text.
  t = t.replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(
      r'(^|[^\A-Za-z])(frac|sqrt|cdot|times|leq|geq|neq|pm|mp|approx|left|right|alpha|beta|gamma|delta|theta|lambda|mu|pi|sigma)',
    ),
    (m) => '${m.group(1)}\${m.group(2)}',
  );

  // Wrap simple powers if they are still plain text.
  t = t.replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(r'(?<!\$)([a-zA-Z0-9]+\^[0-9]+)(?!\$)'),
    (m) => '\$${m.group(1)}\$',
  );

  // Convert simple fractions like x/2 → \frac{x}{2}
  t = t.replaceAllMapped(
    RegExp(r'(?<![\\\$])([a-zA-Z0-9]+)/([a-zA-Z0-9]+)'),
    (m) => '\\frac{${m.group(1)!}}{${m.group(2)!}}',
  );

  return t;
}

class PracticeGenerator {
  static const _apiBase = String.fromEnvironment(
    'CM_API_BASE_URL',
    defaultValue: 'http://127.0.0.1:3001',
  );

  static const _devToken = String.fromEnvironment('CM_DEV_TOKEN');

  final BagrutRepository _bagrutRepo = BagrutRepository();

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    if (filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut) {
      final bagrut = await _generateBagrutQuestion(filter);
      if (bagrut != null) return [bagrut];
      return generateFallback(filter);
    }

    final remote = await _generateFromApiWithRetry(filter);
    if (remote.isNotEmpty) return remote;

    return generateFallback(filter);
  }

  Future<PracticeQuestion?> _generateBagrutQuestion(
    PracticeFilter filter,
  ) async {
    final dto = await _bagrutRepo.getQuestion(
      subject: filter.subject,
      topicLabel: filter.topicLabel,
    );
    if (dto == null) return null;

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: 'bagrut-${dto.examCode}-${dto.questionIndex}-${dto.year}',
      subject: dto.subject,
      topicLabel: dto.topicLabel,
      mode: PracticeMode.bagrut,
      difficulty: _parseDifficulty(dto.difficulty) ?? filter.difficulty,
      prompt: normalizeMathInline(
        dto.promptLatex.isNotEmpty ? dto.promptLatex : 'Bagrut question',
      ),
      options: const [
        'Open with NOVA',
        'Show official solution',
        'Save for later',
        'End question',
      ].map(normalizeMathInline).toList(),
      correctIndex: 1,
      explanation: normalizeMathInline(
        dto.solutionLatex.isNotEmpty
            ? dto.solutionLatex
            : 'Official Bagrut-style solution unavailable.',
      ),
      recommendedTimeSeconds: 3600,
    );
  }

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generateFallback(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final count = filter.questionCount < 1 ? 1 : filter.questionCount;

    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      out.add(_localQuestion(filter, i));
    }

    return out;
  }

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> _generateFromApiWithRetry(
    PracticeFilter filter,
  ) async {
    var last = const <PracticeQuestion>[];
    for (var attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
      last = await _generateFromApi(filter);
      if (last.isNotEmpty) return last;
      await Future<void>.delayed(
        Duration(milliseconds: attempt == 0 ? 700 : 0),
      );
    }
    return last;
  }

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> _generateFromApi(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final client = HttpClient()
      ..connectionTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 60);

    try {
      final uri = Uri.parse('$_apiBase/practice/generate');
      debugPrint('practice.generate uri=$uri');
      debugPrint('practice.generate devTokenLen=${_devToken.length}');
      final req = await client
          .postUrl(uri)
          .timeout(
            const Duration(seconds: 90),
            onTimeout: () => throw TimeoutException(
              'practice.generate postUrl timeout after 20s',
            ),
          );

      req.headers.contentType = ContentType.json;
      req.headers.set(HttpHeaders.acceptHeader, 'application/json');
      if (_devToken.isNotEmpty) {
        req.headers.set(HttpHeaders.authorizationHeader, 'Bearer $_devToken');
      }

      final payload = <String, Object?>{
        'subject': filter.subject,
        'topicLabel': filter.topicLabel,
        'topicPath': filter.topicPath,
        'topicPathText': filter.topicPath.isEmpty
            ? filter.topicLabel
            : filter.topicPath.join(' > '),
        'mode': filter.mode.name,
        'difficulty': filter.difficulty.name,
        'questionCount': filter.questionCount,
        'timePreferenceSeconds': filter.timePreferenceSeconds,
        'useAiTiming': filter.useAiTiming,
        'maxLives': filter.maxLives,
        'strictPromptSummary': buildStrictPracticeFilterSection(filter),
      };

      debugPrint('practice.generate payload=${jsonEncode(payload)}');
      req.write(jsonEncode(payload));

      final res = await req.close().timeout(
        const Duration(seconds: 90),
        onTimeout: () =>
            throw TimeoutException('practice.generate close timeout after 90s'),
      );
      final body = await utf8
          .decodeStream(res)
          .timeout(
            const Duration(seconds: 60),
            onTimeout: () => throw TimeoutException(
              'practice.generate body timeout after 90s',
            ),
          );
      debugPrint('practice.generate status=${res.statusCode}');
      debugPrint('practice.generate ok body: $body');

      if (res.statusCode < 200 || res.statusCode >= 300) {
        debugPrint('practice.generate http ${res.statusCode}: $body');
        return const [];
      }

      final decoded = jsonDecode(body);
      final rawQuestions = _extractQuestions(decoded);

      final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
      for (var i = 0; i < rawQuestions.length; i++) {
        final q = _parseQuestion(rawQuestions[i], filter: filter, index: i);
        if (q != null) out.add(q);
      }

      return out;
    } catch (e, st) {
      debugPrint('practice.generate failed: $e');
      debugPrint('$st');
      return const [];
    } finally {
      client.close(force: true);
    }
  }

  List<dynamic> _extractQuestions(dynamic decoded) {
    if (decoded is List) return decoded;
    if (decoded is Map<String, dynamic>) {
      final direct = decoded['questions'];
      if (direct is List) return direct;

      final data = decoded['data'];
      if (data is Map<String, dynamic>) {
        final qs = data['questions'];
        if (qs is List) return qs;
      }

      final items = decoded['items'];
      if (items is List) return items;
    }
    return const [];
  }

  PracticeQuestion? _parseQuestion(
    dynamic raw, {
    required PracticeFilter filter,
    required int index,
  }) {
    if (raw is! Map) return null;

    final map = raw.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k.toString(), v));

    final prompt =
        _asString(map['prompt']) ??
        _asString(map['question']) ??
        _asString(map['text']) ??
        '';

    if (prompt.trim().isEmpty) return null;

    final rawOptions =
        map['options'] ??
        map['choices'] ??
        map['answers'] ??
        map['answerOptions'];
    final options = _asStringList(rawOptions);

    final correctIndex =
        _asInt(map['correctIndex']) ??
        _asInt(map['correct_answer_index']) ??
        _asInt(map['answerIndex']) ??
        0;

    final explanation =
        _asString(map['explanation']) ??
        _asString(map['solution']) ??
        _asString(map['reasoning']) ??
        'Review the logic carefully and ask NOVA for a full walkthrough.';

    final subject = _asString(map['subject']) ?? filter.subject;
    final topicLabel =
        _asString(map['topicLabel']) ??
        _asString(map['topic']) ??
        filter.topicLabel;
    final recommendedTimeSeconds =
        _asInt(map['recommendedTimeSeconds']) ??
        _asInt(map['timeSeconds']) ??
        _asInt(map['time_limit_seconds']) ??
        (filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? 45);

    final safeOptions = options.length == 4
        ? options
        : <String>['Option A', 'Option B', 'Option C', 'Option D'];

    final safeCorrectIndex =
        correctIndex >= 0 && correctIndex < safeOptions.length
        ? correctIndex
        : 0;

import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    final sessionSalt = DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.abs();
    var seed = _seedFromFilter(filter) + sessionSalt;
    var attempts = 0;
    final maxAttempts = count * 90;

    while (out.length < count && attempts < maxAttempts) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 17 + attempts * 11),
        filter,
        seed + attempts,
      );
      attempts++;
      if (used.add(_fingerprint(q))) {
        out.add(q);
      }
    }

    while (out.length < count) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 29),
        filter,
        seed + out.length * 13,
      );
      out.add(
        PracticeQuestion(
          id: '${q.id}-${out.length}-${sessionSalt % 100000}',
          subject: q.subject,
          topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
          mode: q.mode,
          difficulty: q.difficulty,
          prompt: q.prompt,
          options: q.options,
          correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
          explanation: q.explanation,
          recommendedTimeSeconds: q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
        ),
      );
    }

    return out;
  }

import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  final Random _r = Random();

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    var seed = _seedFromFilter(filter);

    while (out.length < count) {
      final question = _buildQuestion(filter, seed++);
      final key = _fingerprint(question);
      if (used.add(key)) {
        out.add(question);
      }
    }

    return out;
  }

  int _seedFromFilter(PracticeFilter filter) {
    final text = [
      filter.subject,
      ...filter.topicPath,
      filter.mode.name,
      filter.difficulty.name,
      '${filter.questionCount}',
      '${filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? -1}',
    ].join('|');

    var total = 17;
    for (final code in text.codeUnits) {
      total = (total * 31 + code) & 0x7fffffff;
    }
    return total;
  }

  String _fingerprint(PracticeQuestion q) =>
      '${_norm(q.subject)}|${_norm(q.topicLabel)}|${_norm(q.prompt)}|${q.correctIndex}';

import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final seedBase =
        DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch ^
        Object.hash(
          filter.subject,
          filter.topicLabel,
          filter.mode,
          filter.difficulty,
          filter.questionCount,
          filter.note,
        );

    final questions = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    final count = filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut
        ? max(1, min(5, filter.questionCount))
        : max(1, filter.questionCount);

    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      var attempts = 0;
      PracticeQuestion? q;
      while (attempts < 24 && q == null) {
        attempts++;
        final seed = seedBase + i * 9973 + attempts * 131;
        q = _generateOne(filter, seed, i);
        final fp =
            '${_norm(q.subject)}|${_norm(q.topicLabel)}|${_norm(q.prompt)}';
        if (used.contains(fp)) {
          q = null;
          continue;
        }
        used.add(fp);
      }
      if (q != null) questions.add(q);
    }

    return questions;
  }

  PracticeQuestion _generateOne(PracticeFilter filter, int seed, int index) {
    if (filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut) {
      return _bagrutQuestion(filter, seed, index);
    }

    final subject = _norm(filter.subject);
    final topic = _norm(filter.topicLabel);

    if (_hasAny(subject, ['math', 'mathematics'])) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['quadratic', 'parabola', 'trinomial'])) {
        return _mathQuadratic(filter, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['linear', 'line', 'slope', 'affine', 'y = mx'])) {
        return _mathLinear(filter, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['probability', 'chance'])) {
        return _mathProbability(filter, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['geometry', 'triangle', 'circle', 'angle'])) {
        return _mathGeometry(filter, seed);
      }
      return _mathAlgebra(filter, seed);
    }

    if (_hasAny(subject, ['physics'])) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['kinematic', 'velocity', 'acceleration', 'motion'])) {
        return _physicsKinematics(filter, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['force', 'newton'])) {
        return _physicsForces(filter, seed);
      }
      return _physicsEnergy(filter, seed);
    }

    if (_hasAny(subject, ['cs', 'computer science', 'programming'])) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['big o', 'complexity'])) {
        return _csBigO(filter, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['if', 'condition', 'branch', 'conditional'])) {
        return _csConditions(filter, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['loop', 'iteration', 'for', 'while'])) {
        return _csLoops(filter, seed);
      }
      return _csVariables(filter, seed);
    }

    if (_hasAny(subject, ['arabic', 'عربي', 'العربية'])) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['نحو', 'nahw', 'grammar'])) {
        return _arabicNahw(filter, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['مفردات', 'vocabulary', 'vocab'])) {
        return _arabicVocabulary(filter, seed);
      }
      return _arabicReading(filter, seed);
    }

    if (_hasAny(subject, ['english'])) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['grammar', 'tenses', 'articles'])) {
        return _englishGrammar(filter, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['vocabulary', 'vocab'])) {
        return _englishVocabulary(filter, seed);
      }
      return _englishReading(filter, seed);
    }

    if (_hasAny(subject, [
      'civics',
      'citizenship',
      'government',
      'democracy',
    ])) {
      return _civicsQuestion(filter, seed);
    }

    if (_hasAny(subject, ['history'])) {
      return _historyQuestion(filter, seed);
    }

      return _geographyQuestion(filter, seed);
    }

    if (_hasAny(subject, ['literature', 'adab'])) {
      return _literatureQuestion(filter, seed);
    }

    return _genericQuestion(filter, seed);
  }

  PracticeQuestion _mathQuadratic(PracticeFilter filter, int seed) {
    final a = 1;

        concept:
            'Factor x² ${b >= 0 ? '+' : '-'} ${b.abs()}x ${c >= 0 ? '+' : '-'} ${c.abs()} and find the zeros.',
      ),
      correct: 'x = $r1 and x = $r2',
      distractors: [

        'No real roots',
