import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    var seed = _seedFromFilter(filter);

    while (out.length < count) {
      final question = _buildQuestion(filter, seed++);
      final key = _fingerprint(question);
      if (used.add(key)) {
        out.add(question);
      }
    }

    return out;
  }

  int _seedFromFilter(PracticeFilter filter) {
    final text = [
      filter.subject,
      ...filter.topicPath,
      filter.mode.name,
      filter.difficulty.name,
      '${filter.questionCount}',
      '${filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? -1}',
    ].join('|');

    var total = 17;
    for (final code in text.codeUnits) {
      total = (total * 31 + code) & 0x7fffffff;
    }
    return total;
  }

                'A student runs this program:\n\nint x = $x;\nint y = $y;\nif (x $op y) {\n  print("A");\n} else {\n  print("B");\n}\n\nWhich output is produced?',
            concept:
                'Focus on the condition first, then decide which branch runs:\n\nint x = $x;\nint y = $y;\nif (x $op y) {\n  print("A");\n} else {\n  print("B");\n}\n\nWhat is printed?',
          ),
          options: _shuffledOptions(
            seed: seed,
            correct: output,
            distractors: ['A and B', 'Nothing', output == 'A' ? 'B' : 'A'],
          ),
          explanation:
              'Evaluate the condition x $op y using x = $x and y = $y. That statement is ${condition ? 'true' : 'false'}, so the ${condition ? 'if' : 'else'} block runs and prints $output.',
          timeSeconds: _timeFor(filter, base: 18, hard: 28, olympiad: 35),
        );
      },
      () {
        final score = _range(seed, 40, 99);
        final threshold = _range(seed + 1, 50, 85);
        final passed = score >= threshold;
        final answer = passed ? 'Pass' : 'Retry';

        return _question(
          filter: filter,
          subject: 'CS',
          topicLabel: topicLabel,
          prompt: _modePrompt(

            : 'Mild';

        return _question(

          ),
          options: _shuffledOptions(

          timeSeconds: _timeFor(filter, base: 22, hard: 34, olympiad: 42),

import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    var seed = _seedFromFilter(filter);
    var attempts = 0;
    final maxAttempts = count * 40;

    while (out.length < count && attempts < maxAttempts) {
      final question = _buildQuestion(filter, seed++);
      final key = _fingerprint(question);
      attempts++;

      if (used.add(key)) {

          options: base.options,
          correctIndex: base.correctIndex,
          explanation: base.explanation,
          recommendedTimeSeconds: base.recommendedTimeSeconds,
        ),
      );
    }

    return out;
  }

import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    final sessionSalt = DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.abs();
    var seed = _seedFromFilter(filter) + sessionSalt;
    var attempts = 0;
    final maxAttempts = count * 90;

    while (out.length < count && attempts < maxAttempts) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 17 + attempts * 11),
        filter,
        seed + attempts,
      );
      attempts++;
      if (used.add(_fingerprint(q))) {
        out.add(q);
      }
    }

    while (out.length < count) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 29),
        filter,
        seed + out.length * 13,
      );
      out.add(
        PracticeQuestion(
          id: '${q.id}-${out.length}-${sessionSalt % 100000}',
          subject: q.subject,
          topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
          mode: q.mode,
          difficulty: q.difficulty,
          prompt: q.prompt,
          options: q.options,
          correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
          explanation: q.explanation,
          recommendedTimeSeconds: q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
        ),
      );
    }

    return out;
  }

  PracticeQuestion _postProcessMode(
    PracticeQuestion q,
    PracticeFilter filter,
    int seed,
  ) {
    final decoratedPrompt = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards =>
        'Flashcard\nRemember first, reveal second.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Speed round\nAnswer fast.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep =>
        'Bagrut-style / exam-style\nRead carefully and choose precisely.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder =>
        'Concept builder\nUnderstand the rule, then solve.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive =>
        'Adaptive mode\nThe session can shift in pace and level.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.prompt,
    };

    final decoratedExplanation = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => 'Flashcard review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Fast review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep => 'Exam reasoning: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => 'Concept walkthrough: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive => 'Adaptive feedback: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.explanation,
    };

    final adjustedTime = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 6,
      PracticeMode.speedRound => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 10,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 12,
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 8,
      PracticeMode.adaptive => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
      PracticeMode.practice => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
    };

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: '${q.id}-${seed.abs() % 10000}',
      subject: q.subject,
      topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
      mode: q.mode,
      difficulty: q.difficulty,
      prompt: decoratedPrompt,
      options: q.options,
      correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
      explanation: decoratedExplanation,
      recommendedTimeSeconds: adjustedTime < 8 ? 8 : adjustedTime,
    );
  }

import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    final sessionSalt = DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.abs();
    var seed = _seedFromFilter(filter) + sessionSalt;
    var attempts = 0;
    final maxAttempts = count * 90;

    while (out.length < count && attempts < maxAttempts) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 17 + attempts * 11),
        filter,
        seed + attempts,
      );
      attempts++;
      if (used.add(_fingerprint(q))) {
        out.add(q);
      }
    }

    while (out.length < count) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 29),
        filter,
        seed + out.length * 13,
      );
      out.add(
        PracticeQuestion(
          id: '${q.id}-${out.length}-${sessionSalt % 100000}',
          subject: q.subject,
          topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
          mode: q.mode,
          difficulty: q.difficulty,
          prompt: q.prompt,
          options: q.options,
          correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
          explanation: q.explanation,
          recommendedTimeSeconds: q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
        ),
      );
    }

    return out;
  }

  PracticeQuestion _postProcessMode(
    PracticeQuestion q,
    PracticeFilter filter,
    int seed,
  ) {
    final decoratedPrompt = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards =>
        'Flashcard\nRemember first, reveal second.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Speed round\nAnswer fast.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep =>
        'Bagrut-style / exam-style\nRead carefully and choose precisely.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder =>
        'Concept builder\nUnderstand the rule, then solve.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive =>
        'Adaptive mode\nThe session can shift in pace and level.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep =>
        'Bagrut-style\nSolve like a formal school exam question.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.prompt,
    };

    final decoratedExplanation = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => 'Flashcard review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Fast review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep => 'Exam reasoning: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => 'Concept walkthrough: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive => 'Adaptive feedback: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep => 'Bagrut reasoning: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.explanation,
    };

    final adjustedTime = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 6,
      PracticeMode.speedRound => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 10,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 12,
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 8,
      PracticeMode.adaptive => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 16,
      PracticeMode.practice => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
    };

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: '${q.id}-${seed.abs() % 10000}',
      subject: q.subject,
      topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
      mode: q.mode,
      difficulty: q.difficulty,
      prompt: decoratedPrompt,
      options: q.options,
      correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
      explanation: decoratedExplanation,
      recommendedTimeSeconds: adjustedTime < 8 ? 8 : adjustedTime,
    );
  }

  PracticeQuestion _buildQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int seed) {
    final subject = _norm(filter.subject);
    final topicLabel = filter.topicPath.isEmpty
        ? 'General'
        : filter.topicPath.join(' • ');
    final topic = _norm(topicLabel);

    if (_isCS(subject) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, [
          'civics',

          'government',
          'democracy',
        ]) &&

        !_hasAny(subject, ['geography']) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, ['literature', 'adab'])) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'if',
        'if statement',
        'if statements',
        'condition',
        'conditions',
        'conditional',
        'branch',
        'else',
        'boolean',
      ])) {
        return _csIfStatements(filter, topicLabel, seed);

        return _csLoops(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['variable', 'variables', 'assignment', 'operator'])) {
        return _csVariables(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }

        return _csComplexity(filter, topicLabel, seed);

      ])) {
        return _csDataStructures(filter, topicLabel, seed);

  PracticeQuestion _csIfStatements(
    PracticeFilter filter,
    String topicLabel,
    int seed,
  ) {
    final x = _scaledNumber(
      filter,
      seed,
      easy: 2,
      medium: 4,
      hard: 7,
      olympiad: 11,
    );
    final y = _scaledNumber(
      filter,
      seed + 1,
      easy: 5,
      medium: 8,
      hard: 10,
      olympiad: 13,
    );
    final cond = x < y;
    return _makeQuestion(
      filter: filter,
      subject: 'CS',
      topicLabel: topicLabel,
      prompt: _modePrompt(
        filter,
        base:
            'What will this print?\n\nif ($x < $y) print("YES"); else print("NO");',
        exam:
            'Determine the exact output of the following conditional:\n\nif ($x < $y) print("YES"); else print("NO");',
        concept:
            'First evaluate the condition $x < $y, then follow the correct branch. What is printed?',
      ),
      correct: cond ? 'YES' : 'NO',
      distractors: [cond ? 'NO' : 'YES', 'Both YES and NO', 'Nothing'],
      explanation: _decorateExplanation(
        filter,
        'Since $x < $y is ${cond ? 'true' : 'false'}, the program prints "${cond ? 'YES' : 'NO'}".',
      ),
      timeSeconds: _timeFor(filter, base: 16, hard: 24, olympiad: 32),
      seed: seed,
    );
  }

  PracticeQuestion _csLoops(
    PracticeFilter filter,
    String topicLabel,
    int seed,
  ) {
    final start = _scaledNumber(
      filter,
      seed,
      easy: 1,
      medium: 2,
      hard: 3,
      olympiad: 4,
    );
    final end =
        start +
        _scaledNumber(
          filter,
          seed + 1,
          easy: 2,
          medium: 3,
          hard: 5,
          olympiad: 7,
        );
    final count = end - start;
    return _makeQuestion(

===== apps/classmate_mobile/lib/features/practice/data/practice_generator.dart.strict-route-fix.1773153382.bak =====
import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    final sessionSalt = DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.abs();
    var seed = _seedFromFilter(filter) + sessionSalt;
    var attempts = 0;
    final maxAttempts = count * 90;

    while (out.length < count && attempts < maxAttempts) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 17 + attempts * 11),
        filter,
        seed + attempts,
      );
      attempts++;
      if (used.add(_fingerprint(q))) {
        out.add(q);
      }
    }

    while (out.length < count) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 29),
        filter,
        seed + out.length * 13,
      );
      out.add(
        PracticeQuestion(
          id: '${q.id}-${out.length}-${sessionSalt % 100000}',
          subject: q.subject,
          topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
          mode: q.mode,
          difficulty: q.difficulty,
          prompt: q.prompt,
          options: q.options,
          correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
          explanation: q.explanation,
          recommendedTimeSeconds: q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
        ),
      );
    }

    return out;
  }

  PracticeQuestion _postProcessMode(
    PracticeQuestion q,
    PracticeFilter filter,
    int seed,
  ) {
    final decoratedPrompt = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards =>
        'Flashcard\nRemember first, reveal second.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Speed round\nAnswer fast.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep =>
        'Bagrut-style / exam-style\nRead carefully and choose precisely.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder =>
        'Concept builder\nUnderstand the rule, then solve.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive =>
        'Adaptive mode\nThe session can shift in pace and level.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.bagrut =>
        'Bagrut-style\nSolve like a formal school exam question.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.prompt,
    };

    final decoratedExplanation = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => 'Flashcard review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Fast review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep => 'Exam reasoning: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => 'Concept walkthrough: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive => 'Adaptive feedback: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.bagrut => 'Bagrut reasoning: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.explanation,
    };

    final adjustedTime = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 6,
      PracticeMode.speedRound => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 10,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 12,
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 8,
      PracticeMode.adaptive => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
      PracticeMode.bagrut => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 16,
      PracticeMode.practice => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
    };

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: '${q.id}-${seed.abs() % 10000}',
      subject: q.subject,
      topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
      mode: q.mode,
      difficulty: q.difficulty,
      prompt: decoratedPrompt,
      options: q.options,
      correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
      explanation: decoratedExplanation,
      recommendedTimeSeconds: adjustedTime < 8 ? 8 : adjustedTime,
    );
  }

===== apps/classmate_mobile/lib/features/practice/data/practice_generator.dart.subtopic-rebuild.1773136375.bak =====
import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  final Random _r = Random();

  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final used = <String>{};
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];

    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      PracticeQuestion q;
      var tries = 0;
      do {
        q = _buildQuestion(filter, i + tries);
        tries++;
      } while (used.contains(_keyOf(q)) && tries < 30);

      used.add(_keyOf(q));
      out.add(q);
    }

    return out;
  }

  String _keyOf(PracticeQuestion q) =>
      '${q.subject}|${q.topicLabel}|${q.prompt}';

  PracticeQuestion _buildQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int seed) {
    final subject = _norm(filter.subject);
    final topicLabel = filter.topicPath.isEmpty
        ? 'General'
        : filter.topicPath.join(' • ');
    final topic = _norm(topicLabel);

    if (_isMath(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'geometry',
        'triangle',
        'circle',
        'angle',
        'polygon',
        'perimeter',
        'area',
        'parallel',
      ])) {
        return _mathGeometry(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['derivative', 'differentiat', 'calculus'])) {
        return _mathDerivatives(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['function', 'algebra', 'equation', 'linear'])) {
        return _mathAlgebra(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['sequence', 'series'])) {
        return _mathSequences(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['probability', 'combinatorics', 'chance'])) {
        return _mathProbability(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['geometry']) &&
          !_hasAny(topic, [
            'algebra',
            'function',
            'equation',
            'derivative',
            'calculus',
          ])) {
        return _mathGeometry(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _mathMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isPhysics(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['newton', 'force', 'motion', 'dynamics'])) {
        return _physicsNewton(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['kinematic', 'velocity', 'speed', 'acceleration'])) {
        return _physicsKinematics(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['energy', 'work', 'power'])) {
        return _physicsEnergy(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _physicsMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isCS(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['big o', 'complexity', 'algorithm'])) {
        return _csComplexity(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'data structure',
        'queue',
        'stack',
        'tree',
        'hash',
      ])) {
        return _csStructures(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _csMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    return _generalFallback(filter, topicLabel, seed);
  }

  // =========================
  // MATH — GEOMETRY
  // =========================

  PracticeQuestion _mathGeometry(
    PracticeFilter filter,
    String topicLabel,
    int seed,
  ) {
    final bank = <PracticeQuestion Function()>[
      () {
        final a = _pick(
          filter,
          easy: [30, 35, 40, 50],
          medium: [58, 64, 72, 78],
          hard: [93, 108, 117, 126],
          olympiad: [132, 141, 148, 156],
          seed: seed,
        );
        final ans = 180 - a;
        return _q(
          filter: filter,
          subject: 'Math',
          topicLabel: 'Geometry',
          prompt:
              'Two adjacent angles form a straight line. One angle is $a°. What is the other angle?',
          options: ['$ans°', '${ans + 6}°', '${ans - 8}°', '$a°'],
          correct: '$ans°',
          explanation:
              'Angles on a straight line sum to 180°, so the missing angle is 180 - $a = $ans°.',
        );
      },
      () {

===== apps/classmate_mobile/lib/features/practice/data/practice_generator.dart.warn-clean.1773159959.bak =====
import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

class PracticeGenerator {
  Future<List<PracticeQuestion>> generate(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    final count = filter.questionCount <= 0 ? 10 : filter.questionCount;
    final out = <PracticeQuestion>[];
    final used = <String>{};

    final sessionSalt = DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.abs();
    var seed = _seedFromFilter(filter) + sessionSalt;
    var attempts = 0;
    final maxAttempts = count * 90;

    while (out.length < count && attempts < maxAttempts) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 17 + attempts * 11),
        filter,
        seed + attempts,
      );
      attempts++;
      if (used.add(_fingerprint(q))) {
        out.add(q);
      }
    }

    while (out.length < count) {
      final q = _postProcessMode(
        _buildQuestion(filter, seed + out.length * 29),
        filter,
        seed + out.length * 13,
      );
      out.add(
        PracticeQuestion(
          id: '${q.id}-${out.length}-${sessionSalt % 100000}',
          subject: q.subject,
          topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
          mode: q.mode,
          difficulty: q.difficulty,
          prompt: q.prompt,
          options: q.options,
          correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
          explanation: q.explanation,
          recommendedTimeSeconds: q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
        ),
      );
    }

    return out;
  }

  PracticeQuestion _postProcessMode(
    PracticeQuestion q,
    PracticeFilter filter,
    int seed,
  ) {
    final decoratedPrompt = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards =>
        'Flashcard\nRemember first, reveal second.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Speed round\nAnswer fast.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep =>
        'Bagrut-style / exam-style\nRead carefully and choose precisely.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder =>
        'Concept builder\nUnderstand the rule, then solve.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive =>
        'Adaptive mode\nThe session can shift in pace and level.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep =>
        'Bagrut-style\nSolve like a formal school exam question.\n\n${q.prompt}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.prompt,
    };

    final decoratedExplanation = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => 'Flashcard review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.speedRound => 'Fast review: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep => 'Exam reasoning: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => 'Concept walkthrough: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.adaptive => 'Adaptive feedback: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.examPrep => 'Bagrut reasoning: ${q.explanation}',
      PracticeMode.practice => q.explanation,
    };

    final adjustedTime = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 6,
      PracticeMode.speedRound => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 10,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 12,
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 8,
      PracticeMode.adaptive => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 16,
      PracticeMode.practice => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
    };

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: '${q.id}-${seed.abs() % 10000}',
      subject: q.subject,
      topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
      mode: q.mode,
      difficulty: q.difficulty,
      prompt: decoratedPrompt,
      options: q.options,
      correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
      explanation: decoratedExplanation,
      recommendedTimeSeconds: adjustedTime < 8 ? 8 : adjustedTime,
    );
  }

  PracticeQuestion _buildQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int seed) {
    final subject = _norm(filter.subject);
    final topicLabel = filter.topicPath.isEmpty
        ? 'General'
        : filter.topicPath.join(' • ');
    final generatorNote = _norm('');
    final topic = _norm('$topicLabel $generatorNote');

    if (_isCS(subject) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, [
          'civics',
          'citizenship',
          'government',
          'democracy',
        ]) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, ['history']) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, ['geography']) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, ['literature', 'adab'])) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'if',
        'if statement',
        'if statements',
        'condition',
        'conditions',
        'conditional',
        'branch',
        'else',
        'boolean',
      ])) {
        return _csIfStatements(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['loop', 'loops', 'for', 'while', 'iteration'])) {
        return _csLoops(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['variable', 'variables', 'assignment', 'operator'])) {
        return _csVariables(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['big o', 'complexity', 'algorithm'])) {
        return _csComplexity(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'array',
        'arrays',
        'stack',
        'queue',
        'tree',
        'map',
      ])) {
        return _csDataStructures(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _csMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isMath(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'geometry',
        'triangle',
        'circle',
        'angle',
        'rectangle',
        'perimeter',
        'area',
      ])) {
        return _mathGeometry(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'function',
        'functions',
        'algebra',
        'equation',
        'linear',
        'quadratic',
        'slope',
      ])) {
        return _mathAlgebra(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['probability', 'chance', 'combinatorics'])) {
        return _mathProbability(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _mathAccurateFallback(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isPhysics(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['newton', 'force', 'forces', 'second law'])) {
        return _physicsNewton(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'kinematics',
        'velocity',
        'speed',
        'acceleration',
        'motion',
        'free fall',
      ])) {
        return _physicsKinematics(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['energy', 'work', 'power'])) {
        return _physicsEnergy(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _physicsMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isEnglish(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'grammar',
        'tense',
        'tenses',
        'article',
        'sentence',
      ])) {
        return _englishGrammar(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['vocabulary', 'synonym', 'antonym', 'word'])) {
        return _englishVocabulary(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['reading', 'comprehension', 'passage'])) {
        return _englishReading(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _englishMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isArabic(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'نحو',
        'اعراب',
        'إعراب',
        'syntax',
        'grammar',
        'sentence structure',
      ])) {
        return _arabicNahw(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['مفردات', 'vocabulary', 'مرادف', 'مضاد'])) {
        return _arabicVocabulary(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['قراءة', 'فهم', 'comprehension', 'passage'])) {
        return _arabicReading(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _arabicMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isHebrew(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'grammar',
        'תחביר',
        'לשון',
        'binyanim',
        'sentence structure',
      ])) {
        return _hebrewGrammar(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['vocabulary', 'אוצר מילים', 'synonym', 'antonym'])) {
        return _hebrewVocabulary(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'reading',
        'הבנת הנקרא',
        'comprehension',
        'passage',
      ])) {
        return _hebrewReading(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _hebrewMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isChemistry(subject)) {
      return _chemistryMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isBiology(subject)) {
      return _biologyMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    return _generalKnowledge(filter, topicLabel, seed);

      PracticeMode.speedRound => q.recommendedTimeSeconds - 10,

      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 8,
      PracticeMode.adaptive => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => q.recommendedTimeSeconds + 16,
      PracticeMode.practice => q.recommendedTimeSeconds,
    };

    return PracticeQuestion(
      id: '${q.id}-${seed.abs() % 10000}',
      subject: q.subject,
      topicLabel: q.topicLabel,
      mode: q.mode,
      difficulty: q.difficulty,
      prompt: decoratedPrompt,
      options: q.options,
      correctIndex: q.correctIndex,
      explanation: decoratedExplanation,
      recommendedTimeSeconds: adjustedTime < 8 ? 8 : adjustedTime,
    );
  }

  PracticeQuestion _buildQuestion(PracticeFilter filter, int seed) {
    final subject = _norm(filter.subject);
    final topicLabel = filter.topicPath.isEmpty
        ? 'General'
        : filter.topicPath.join(' • ');
    final generatorNote = _norm('');
    final topic = _norm('$topicLabel $generatorNote');

    if (_isCS(subject) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, [
          'civics',
          'citizenship',
          'government',
          'democracy',
        ]) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, ['history']) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, ['geography']) &&
        !_hasAny(subject, ['literature', 'adab'])) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'if',
        'if statement',
        'if statements',
        'condition',
        'conditions',
        'conditional',
        'branch',
        'else',
        'boolean',
      ])) {
        return _csIfStatements(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['loop', 'loops', 'for', 'while', 'iteration'])) {
        return _csLoops(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['variable', 'variables', 'assignment', 'operator'])) {
        return _csVariables(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['big o', 'complexity', 'algorithm'])) {
        return _csComplexity(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'array',
        'arrays',
        'stack',
        'queue',
        'tree',
        'map',
      ])) {
        return _csDataStructures(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _csMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isMath(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'geometry',
        'triangle',
        'circle',
        'angle',
        'rectangle',
        'perimeter',
        'area',
      ])) {
        return _mathGeometry(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'function',
        'functions',
        'algebra',
        'equation',
        'linear',
        'quadratic',
        'slope',
      ])) {
        return _mathAlgebra(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['probability', 'chance', 'combinatorics'])) {
        return _mathProbability(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _mathAccurateFallback(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isPhysics(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['newton', 'force', 'forces', 'second law'])) {
        return _physicsNewton(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'kinematics',
        'velocity',
        'speed',
        'acceleration',
        'motion',
        'free fall',
      ])) {
        return _physicsKinematics(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['energy', 'work', 'power'])) {
        return _physicsEnergy(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _physicsMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isEnglish(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'grammar',
        'tense',
        'tenses',
        'article',
        'sentence',
      ])) {
        return _englishGrammar(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['vocabulary', 'synonym', 'antonym', 'word'])) {
        return _englishVocabulary(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['reading', 'comprehension', 'passage'])) {
        return _englishReading(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _englishMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isArabic(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'نحو',
        'اعراب',
        'إعراب',
        'syntax',
        'grammar',
        'sentence structure',
      ])) {
        return _arabicNahw(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['مفردات', 'vocabulary', 'مرادف', 'مضاد'])) {
        return _arabicVocabulary(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['قراءة', 'فهم', 'comprehension', 'passage'])) {
        return _arabicReading(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _arabicMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isHebrew(subject)) {
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'grammar',
        'תחביר',
        'לשון',
        'binyanim',
        'sentence structure',
      ])) {
        return _hebrewGrammar(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, ['vocabulary', 'אוצר מילים', 'synonym', 'antonym'])) {
        return _hebrewVocabulary(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      if (_hasAny(topic, [
        'reading',
        'הבנת הנקרא',
        'comprehension',
        'passage',
      ])) {
        return _hebrewReading(filter, topicLabel, seed);
      }
      return _hebrewMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isChemistry(subject)) {
      return _chemistryMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    if (_isBiology(subject)) {
      return _biologyMixed(filter, topicLabel, seed);
    }

    return _generalKnowledge(filter, topicLabel, seed);

===== apps/classmate_mobile/lib/features/practice/data/practice_history_repository.dart =====
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

import '../domain/practice_history_models.dart';

class PracticeHistoryRepository {
  static const String _storageKey = 'practice_history_sessions_v1';
  static const int _maxSessions = 60;

  Future<List<PracticeHistorySession>> loadSessions() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final raw = prefs.getString(_storageKey);
    if (raw == null || raw.trim().isEmpty) return const [];

    try {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
      if (decoded is! List) return const [];

      return decoded
          .whereType<Map>()
          .map(
            (x) => PracticeHistorySession.fromJson(
              x.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k.toString(), v)),
            ),
          )
          .toList(growable: false);
    } catch (_) {
      return const [];
    }
  }

  Future<void> saveSession(PracticeHistorySession session) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final existing = await loadSessions();

    final next = <PracticeHistorySession>[
      session,
      ...existing.where((x) => x.id != session.id),
    ];

    final trimmed = next.take(_maxSessions).toList();

    await prefs.setString(
      _storageKey,
      jsonEncode(trimmed.map((x) => x.toJson()).toList(growable: false)),
    );
  }

  Future<void> clearAll() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.remove(_storageKey);
  }
}

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

String buildStrictPracticeFilterSection(PracticeFilter filter) {
  final topic = filter.topicPath.isEmpty
      ? filter.topicLabel
      : filter.topicPath.join(' > ');
  final timing = filter.useAiTiming
      ? 'AI timing'
      : '${filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? 15}s per question';

  return '''
STRICT_FILTER_SECTION_DO_NOT_IGNORE

Subject: ${filter.subject}
Topic: $topic
Mode: ${filter.mode.name}
Difficulty: ${filter.difficulty.name}
Question count: ${filter.questionCount}
Timing: $timing
Lives: ${filter.hasInfiniteLives ? "infinite" : filter.maxLives.toString()}

HARD RULES:
1. Every generated question MUST stay inside the exact Subject above.
2. Every generated question MUST stay inside the exact Topic above.
3. Do NOT drift to a neighboring topic.
4. Do NOT produce mixed-subject trivia unless the subject is exactly General Knowledge.
5. Explanations must stay inside the same subject/topic.
6. Respect the selected mode style.
''';
}

String buildPracticePromptSummary(PracticeFilter filter) {
  final timing = filter.useAiTiming
      ? 'AI timing'
      : '${filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? 15}s';

  return [
    'Subject: ${filter.subject}',
    'Topic: ${filter.topicLabel}',
    'Mode: ${filter.mode.name}',
    'Difficulty: ${filter.difficulty.name}',
    'Questions: ${filter.questionCount}',
    'Timing: $timing',
    'Lives: ${filter.hasInfiniteLives ? "infinite" : "${filter.maxLives} lives"}',
  ].join(' • ');
}

String buildPracticeGenerationPrompt(PracticeFilter filter) {

      : '${filter.maxLives} lives';
  final timing =
      !filter.useAiTiming &&
          filter.timePreferenceSeconds != null &&
          filter.timePreferenceSeconds! > 0
      ? false
      : true
      ? 'no timer'
      : (filter.useAiTiming
            ? 'AI-adjusted timing'
            : '${filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? 0} seconds per question');

  final modeInstruction = switch (filter.mode) {
    PracticeMode.practice =>
      'Balanced practice. Multiple-choice. Good explanations.',

      'Memory-first flashcards. Short recall prompts. Answer should be revealed clearly.',
    PracticeMode.speedRound =>
      'Fast pressure drill. Short prompts, clean options, quick solving.',
    PracticeMode.examPrep =>
      'Formal exam-prep style. Slightly longer wording and test-like distractors.',
    PracticeMode.conceptBuilder =>
      'Teach-first flow. Include a concept hint before the question.',
    PracticeMode.adaptive =>
      'Adaptive flow. Vary question difficulty and style across the set.',
  };

  return '''
Generate ${filter.questionCount} ${filter.mode.name} questions for ClassMate.

Subject: ${filter.subject}
Topic/Subtopic: ${filter.topicLabel}
Difficulty: ${filter.difficulty.name}
Timing: $timing
Lives: $lives
Mode behavior: $modeInstruction
User note: ${''.trim().isEmpty ? 'None' : ''.trim()}

Rules:
- Match the subject and topic strictly.
- Do not drift to another topic.
- Difficulty must be noticeable.
- Questions must differ from each other.
- If mode is bagrut, output long-form official-style school-exam questions, not tiny MCQs.
- If concept builder, include a concept hint.
- Keep explanations accurate and student-friendly.
''';
}

import 'practice_history_models.dart';
import 'practice_models.dart';

class PracticeTopicStat {
  final String topicLabel;
  final int totalQuestions;
  final int correct;
  final int wrong;
  final int accuracyPercent;

  const PracticeTopicStat({
    required this.topicLabel,
    required this.totalQuestions,
    required this.correct,
    required this.wrong,
    required this.accuracyPercent,
  });
}

class PracticeModeStat {
  final PracticeMode mode;
  final int sessions;
  final int answered;
  final int correct;
  final int accuracyPercent;
  final int xp;

  const PracticeModeStat({
    required this.mode,
    required this.sessions,
    required this.answered,
    required this.correct,
    required this.accuracyPercent,
    required this.xp,
  });
}

class PracticeRecentSummary {
  final int sessions;
  final int answered;
  final int correct;
  final int wrong;
  final int accuracyPercent;
  final int xp;

  const PracticeRecentSummary({
    required this.sessions,
    required this.answered,
    required this.correct,
    required this.wrong,
    required this.accuracyPercent,
    required this.xp,
  });
}

class PracticeAnalyticsSnapshot {
  final PracticeRecentSummary overall;
  final List<PracticeTopicStat> weakestTopics;
  final List<PracticeTopicStat> strongestTopics;
  final List<PracticeModeStat> modeStats;

  const PracticeAnalyticsSnapshot({
    required this.overall,
    required this.weakestTopics,
    required this.strongestTopics,
    required this.modeStats,
  });
}

class PracticeAnalyticsBuilder {
  const PracticeAnalyticsBuilder();

  PracticeAnalyticsSnapshot build(
    List<PracticeHistorySession> sessions, {
    int recentSessionWindow = 12,
    int topicMinQuestions = 2,
    int topTopicCount = 5,
  }) {
    final recent = sessions.take(recentSessionWindow).toList(growable: false);

    final overallAnswered = recent.fold<int>(0, (sum, s) => sum + s.answered);
    final overallCorrect = recent.fold<int>(0, (sum, s) => sum + s.correct);
    final overallWrong = recent.fold<int>(0, (sum, s) => sum + s.wrong);
    final overallXp = recent.fold<int>(0, (sum, s) => sum + s.xp);
    final overallAccuracy = overallAnswered == 0
        ? 0
        : ((overallCorrect / overallAnswered) * 100).round();

    final topicBuckets = <String, List<PracticeHistoryQuestion>>{};
    for (final session in sessions) {
      for (final q in session.questions) {
        topicBuckets
            .putIfAbsent(q.topicLabel, () => <PracticeHistoryQuestion>[])
            .add(q);
      }
    }

    final topicStats = topicBuckets.entries
        .map((entry) {
          final total = entry.value.length;
          final correct = entry.value.where((q) => q.isCorrect).length;
          final wrong = total - correct;
          final accuracy = total == 0 ? 0 : ((correct / total) * 100).round();

          return PracticeTopicStat(
            topicLabel: entry.key,
            totalQuestions: total,
            correct: correct,
            wrong: wrong,
            accuracyPercent: accuracy,
          );
        })
        .where((x) => x.totalQuestions >= topicMinQuestions)
        .toList(growable: false);

    final weakestTopics = [...topicStats]
      ..sort((a, b) {
        final byAccuracy = a.accuracyPercent.compareTo(b.accuracyPercent);
        if (byAccuracy != 0) return byAccuracy;
        return b.totalQuestions.compareTo(a.totalQuestions);
      });

    final strongestTopics = [...topicStats]
      ..sort((a, b) {
        final byAccuracy = b.accuracyPercent.compareTo(a.accuracyPercent);
        if (byAccuracy != 0) return byAccuracy;
        return b.totalQuestions.compareTo(a.totalQuestions);
      });

    final modeBuckets = <PracticeMode, List<PracticeHistorySession>>{};
    for (final session in sessions) {
      modeBuckets
          .putIfAbsent(session.mode, () => <PracticeHistorySession>[])
          .add(session);
    }

    final modeStats =
        modeBuckets.entries
            .map((entry) {
              final answered = entry.value.fold<int>(
                0,
                (sum, s) => sum + s.answered,
              );
              final correct = entry.value.fold<int>(
                0,
                (sum, s) => sum + s.correct,
              );
              final xp = entry.value.fold<int>(0, (sum, s) => sum + s.xp);
              final accuracy = answered == 0
                  ? 0
                  : ((correct / answered) * 100).round();

              return PracticeModeStat(
                mode: entry.key,
                sessions: entry.value.length,
                answered: answered,
                correct: correct,
                accuracyPercent: accuracy,
                xp: xp,
              );
            })
            .toList(growable: false)
          ..sort((a, b) => b.sessions.compareTo(a.sessions));

    return PracticeAnalyticsSnapshot(
      overall: PracticeRecentSummary(
        sessions: recent.length,
        answered: overallAnswered,
        correct: overallCorrect,
        wrong: overallWrong,
        accuracyPercent: overallAccuracy,
        xp: overallXp,
      ),
      weakestTopics: weakestTopics.take(topTopicCount).toList(growable: false),
      strongestTopics: strongestTopics
          .take(topTopicCount)
          .toList(growable: false),
      modeStats: modeStats,
    );
  }
}

===== apps/classmate_mobile/lib/features/practice/domain/practice_history_models.dart =====
import 'practice_models.dart';

class PracticeHistorySession {
  final String id;
  final DateTime completedAt;
  final String subject;
  final String topicLabel;
  final PracticeMode mode;
  final PracticeDifficulty difficulty;
  final int totalQuestions;
  final int answered;
  final int correct;
  final int wrong;
  final int xp;
  final int streak;
  final int accuracyPercent;
  final List<PracticeHistoryQuestion> questions;

  const PracticeHistorySession({
    required this.id,
    required this.completedAt,
    required this.subject,
    required this.topicLabel,
    required this.mode,
    required this.difficulty,
    required this.totalQuestions,
    required this.answered,
    required this.correct,
    required this.wrong,
    required this.xp,
    required this.streak,
    required this.accuracyPercent,
    required this.questions,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'id': id,
    'completedAt': completedAt.toIso8601String(),
    'subject': subject,
    'topicLabel': topicLabel,
    'mode': mode.name,
    'difficulty': difficulty.name,
    'totalQuestions': totalQuestions,
    'answered': answered,
    'correct': correct,
    'wrong': wrong,
    'xp': xp,
    'streak': streak,
    'accuracyPercent': accuracyPercent,
    'questions': questions.map((q) => q.toJson()).toList(),
  };

  factory PracticeHistorySession.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    return PracticeHistorySession(
      id: (json['id'] ?? '').toString(),
      completedAt:
          DateTime.tryParse((json['completedAt'] ?? '').toString()) ??
          DateTime.now(),
      subject: (json['subject'] ?? '').toString(),
      topicLabel: (json['topicLabel'] ?? '').toString(),
      mode: PracticeMode.values.firstWhere(
        (x) => x.name == (json['mode'] ?? '').toString(),
        orElse: () => PracticeMode.practice,
      ),
      difficulty: PracticeDifficulty.values.firstWhere(
        (x) => x.name == (json['difficulty'] ?? '').toString(),
        orElse: () => PracticeDifficulty.medium,
      ),
      totalQuestions: _asInt(json['totalQuestions']),
      answered: _asInt(json['answered']),
      correct: _asInt(json['correct']),
      wrong: _asInt(json['wrong']),
      xp: _asInt(json['xp']),
      streak: _asInt(json['streak']),
      accuracyPercent: _asInt(json['accuracyPercent']),
      questions: ((json['questions'] as List?) ?? const [])
          .whereType<Map>()
          .map(
            (x) => PracticeHistoryQuestion.fromJson(
              x.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k.toString(), v)),
            ),
          )
          .toList(growable: false),
    );
  }

  static int _asInt(Object? value) {
    if (value is int) return value;
    if (value is num) return value.toInt();
    return int.tryParse((value ?? '').toString()) ?? 0;
  }
}

class PracticeHistoryQuestion {
  final String id;
  final String prompt;
  final List<String> options;
  final int correctIndex;
  final int? selectedIndex;
  final bool isCorrect;
  final String explanation;
  final String topicLabel;

  const PracticeHistoryQuestion({
    required this.id,
    required this.prompt,
    required this.options,
    required this.correctIndex,
    required this.selectedIndex,
    required this.isCorrect,
    required this.explanation,
    required this.topicLabel,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'id': id,
    'prompt': prompt,
    'options': options,
    'correctIndex': correctIndex,
    'selectedIndex': selectedIndex,
    'isCorrect': isCorrect,
    'explanation': explanation,
    'topicLabel': topicLabel,
  };

  factory PracticeHistoryQuestion.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    return PracticeHistoryQuestion(
      id: (json['id'] ?? '').toString(),
      prompt: (json['prompt'] ?? '').toString(),
      options: ((json['options'] as List?) ?? const [])
          .map((x) => x.toString())
          .toList(growable: false),
      correctIndex: _asInt(json['correctIndex']),
      selectedIndex: json['selectedIndex'] == null
          ? null
          : _asInt(json['selectedIndex']),
      isCorrect: json['isCorrect'] == true,
      explanation: (json['explanation'] ?? '').toString(),
      topicLabel: (json['topicLabel'] ?? '').toString(),
    );
  }

  static int _asInt(Object? value) {
    if (value is int) return value;
    if (value is num) return value.toInt();
    return int.tryParse((value ?? '').toString()) ?? 0;
  }
}

  });

  final bool allowTimer;

  final bool aiTiming;
  final bool perQuestionTimingOnly;
  final bool perQuizTimingOnly;

  PracticeMode.practice: const PracticeModeBehavior(
    allowTimer: true,
    allowLives: true,
    aiTiming: false,
    perQuestionTimingOnly: false,
    perQuizTimingOnly: false,

  PracticeMode.speedRound: const PracticeModeBehavior(
    allowTimer: true,
    allowLives: true,
    aiTiming: false,
    perQuestionTimingOnly: true,
    perQuizTimingOnly: false,
  ),

  PracticeMode.examPrep: const PracticeModeBehavior(
    allowTimer: true,
    allowLives: false,
    aiTiming: false,
    perQuestionTimingOnly: false,
    perQuizTimingOnly: true,
  ),

  PracticeMode.bagrut: const PracticeModeBehavior(
    allowTimer: true,
    allowLives: false,
    aiTiming: false,
    perQuestionTimingOnly: false,
    perQuizTimingOnly: true,
  ),

  PracticeMode.flashcards: const PracticeModeBehavior(
    allowTimer: false,
    allowLives: false,
    aiTiming: false,
    perQuestionTimingOnly: false,
    perQuizTimingOnly: false,
  ),

  PracticeMode.conceptBuilder: const PracticeModeBehavior(
    allowTimer: false,
    allowLives: false,
    aiTiming: false,
    perQuestionTimingOnly: false,
    perQuizTimingOnly: false,
  ),

  PracticeMode.adaptive: const PracticeModeBehavior(
    allowTimer: true,
    allowLives: true,
    aiTiming: true,
    perQuestionTimingOnly: false,
    perQuizTimingOnly: false,
  ),
};

PracticeModeBehavior behaviorForMode(PracticeMode mode) {
  return practiceModeBehaviors[mode]!;
}

enum PracticeMode {
  practice,
  flashcards,
  speedRound,
  examPrep,
  conceptBuilder,
  adaptive,
  bagrut,
}

enum PracticeDifficulty { easy, medium, hard, olympiad, adaptive }

enum FlashcardReflection { again, hard, good, easy }

class PracticeTopicNode {
  const PracticeTopicNode({
    required this.label,
    this.children = const <PracticeTopicNode>[],
  });

  final String label;
  final List<PracticeTopicNode> children;
}

class PracticeFilter {
  const PracticeFilter({
    required this.subject,
    required this.mode,
    required this.difficulty,
    required this.topicPath,
    required this.questionCount,
    required this.timePreferenceSeconds,
    required this.useAiTiming,
    required this.maxLives,
    required this.hasInfiniteLives,
  });

  final String subject;
  final PracticeMode mode;
  final PracticeDifficulty difficulty;
  final List<String> topicPath;
  final int questionCount;
  final int? timePreferenceSeconds;
  final bool useAiTiming;
  final int maxLives;
  final bool hasInfiniteLives;

  String get topicLabel =>
      topicPath.isEmpty ? 'All topics' : topicPath.join(' · ');

  PracticeFilter copyWith({
    String? subject,
    PracticeMode? mode,
    PracticeDifficulty? difficulty,
    List<String>? topicPath,
    int? questionCount,
    int? timePreferenceSeconds,
    bool? useAiTiming,
    int? maxLives,
    bool? hasInfiniteLives,
  }) {
    return PracticeFilter(
      subject: subject ?? this.subject,

enum PracticeMode {
  practice,
  flashcards,
  speedRound,
  examPrep,
  conceptBuilder,
  adaptive,
  bagrut,
}

enum PracticeDifficulty { easy, medium, hard, olympiad, adaptive }

class PracticeFilter {
  const PracticeFilter({
    required this.subject,
    required this.mode,
    required this.difficulty,
    required this.topicPath,
    required this.questionCount,
    required this.timePreferenceSeconds,
    required this.useAiTiming,
    required this.maxLives,
    required this.note,
  });

  final String subject;
  final PracticeMode mode;
  final PracticeDifficulty difficulty;
  final List<String> topicPath;
  final int questionCount;
  final int? timePreferenceSeconds;
  final bool useAiTiming;
  final int maxLives; // -1 => infinite
  final String note;

  String get topicLabel =>
      topicPath.isEmpty ? 'General' : topicPath.join(' • ');
  bool get hasInfiniteLives => maxLives < 0;
  bool get hasNoTime =>
      mode == PracticeMode.bagrut ||
      (!useAiTiming &&
          (timePreferenceSeconds == null || timePreferenceSeconds == 0));

  PracticeFilter copyWith({
    String? subject,
    PracticeMode? mode,

class PracticeSessionState {
  const PracticeSessionState({
    required this.filter,
    required this.questions,
    required this.currentIndex,
    required this.secondsRemaining,
    required this.isComplete,
    required this.stats,
    required this.answersByQuestionId,
    required this.lastResult,
    required this.livesLeft,
  });

  factory PracticeSessionState.initial(PracticeFilter filter) {
    return PracticeSessionState(
      filter: filter,
      questions: const [],
      currentIndex: 0,
      secondsRemaining: filter.hasNoTime
          ? 0
          : (filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? 0),
      isComplete: false,
      stats: const PracticeStats(answered: 0, correct: 0, xp: 0, streak: 0),
      answersByQuestionId: const {},
      lastResult: null,
      livesLeft: filter.hasInfiniteLives || filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut
          ? -1
          : filter.maxLives,
    );
  }

  final PracticeFilter filter;
  final List<PracticeQuestion> questions;
  final int currentIndex;
  final int secondsRemaining;
  final bool isComplete;
  final PracticeStats stats;
  final Map<String, PracticeAnswerResult> answersByQuestionId;
  final PracticeAnswerResult? lastResult;
  final int livesLeft;

  PracticeQuestion? get currentQuestion {
    if (currentIndex < 0 || currentIndex >= questions.length) return null;
    return questions[currentIndex];
  }

  PracticeSessionState copyWith({
    PracticeFilter? filter,
    List<PracticeQuestion>? questions,
    int? currentIndex,
    int? secondsRemaining,
    bool? isComplete,
    PracticeStats? stats,
    Map<String, PracticeAnswerResult>? answersByQuestionId,
    PracticeAnswerResult? lastResult,
    int? livesLeft,
    bool clearLastResult = false,
  }) {
    return PracticeSessionState(
      filter: filter ?? this.filter,
      questions: questions ?? this.questions,
      currentIndex: currentIndex ?? this.currentIndex,
      secondsRemaining: secondsRemaining ?? this.secondsRemaining,
      isComplete: isComplete ?? this.isComplete,
      stats: stats ?? this.stats,
      answersByQuestionId: answersByQuestionId ?? this.answersByQuestionId,
      lastResult: clearLastResult ? null : (lastResult ?? this.lastResult),
      livesLeft: livesLeft ?? this.livesLeft,
    );
  }

class PracticeSessionLoadingController extends Notifier<bool> {

class PracticeFilterController extends Notifier<PracticeFilter> {
  @override
  PracticeFilter build() => _defaultFilter();

  void setFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    state = next;
  }

  void patch({
    String? subject,
    PracticeMode? mode,
    PracticeDifficulty? difficulty,
    List<String>? topicPath,
    int? questionCount,
    int? timePreferenceSeconds,
    bool? useAiTiming,
    int? maxLives,
    bool? hasInfiniteLives,
  }) {
    state = state.copyWith(
      subject: subject ?? state.subject,
      mode: mode ?? state.mode,
      difficulty: difficulty ?? state.difficulty,
      topicPath: topicPath ?? state.topicPath,
      questionCount: questionCount ?? state.questionCount,
      timePreferenceSeconds:
          timePreferenceSeconds ?? state.timePreferenceSeconds,
      useAiTiming: useAiTiming ?? state.useAiTiming,
      maxLives: maxLives ?? state.maxLives,
      hasInfiniteLives: hasInfiniteLives ?? state.hasInfiniteLives,
    );
  }

  void reset() {
    state = _defaultFilter();
  }
}

final practiceSessionProvider =

class PracticeSessionController extends Notifier<PracticeSessionState> {
  Future<void> cancelGeneration() async {
    _generationEpoch++;
    _timer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    ref.read(practiceSessionLoadingProvider.notifier).setLoading(false);
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  final PracticeGenerator _generator = PracticeGenerator();
  final PracticeHistoryRepository _historyRepo = PracticeHistoryRepository();
  int _generationEpoch = 0;
  Timer? _timer;
  Timer? _autoAdvanceTimer;

  @override
  PracticeSessionState build() {
    ref.onDispose(() {
      _timer?.cancel();
      _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    });
    return PracticeSessionState.initial(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  void selectOnlyFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    ref.read(practiceFilterProvider.notifier).setFilter(next);
    _timer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(next);
  }

  Future<void> start([PracticeFilter? override]) async {
    final requestEpoch = ++_generationEpoch;

    final PracticeFilter base = override ?? ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);
    final PracticeFilter filter = base.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut
        ? base.copyWith(
            questionCount: 1,
            useAiTiming: false,
            timePreferenceSeconds: null,
            hasInfiniteLives: true,
            maxLives: 9999,
          )
        : base;

    ref.read(practiceSessionLoadingProvider.notifier).setLoading(true);
    _timer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(filter);

    try {
      final behavior = behaviorForMode(filter.mode);
      final normalizedFilter = !behavior.allowTimer
          ? filter.copyWith(
              timePreferenceSeconds: null,
              useAiTiming: false,
              hasInfiniteLives: true,
            )
          : filter;

      final questions = await _generator.generate(normalizedFilter);
      final firstQuestion = questions.isEmpty ? null : questions.first;

      state = state.copyWith(
        filter: normalizedFilter,
        questions: questions,
        currentIndex: 0,
        secondsRemaining: behavior.allowTimer
            ? _resolveTime(normalizedFilter, firstQuestion)
            : 0,
        isComplete: questions.isEmpty,
        stats: PracticeStats.zero,
      );

      if (questions.isNotEmpty &&
          normalizedFilter.mode != PracticeMode.bagrut &&
          behavior.allowTimer) {
        _startTimer();
      }
    } finally {
      if (requestEpoch == _generationEpoch) {
        ref.read(practiceSessionLoadingProvider.notifier).setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }

  void submit(int answerIndex) {
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null || state.isComplete) return;
    if (state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(q.id)) return;

    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();

    final isCorrect = answerIndex == q.correctIndex;
    const timeTaken = 0;

    final nextAnswers = {
      ...state.answersByQuestionId,
      q.id: PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: answerIndex,
        isCorrect: isCorrect,
        timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
      ),
    };

    final outOfHearts = state.filter.hasInfiniteLives
        ? false
        : (_wrongAnswersCount(nextAnswers) >= state.filter.maxLives);

    state = state.copyWith(
      answersByQuestionId: nextAnswers,
      stats: state.stats.copyWith(
        answered: state.stats.answered + 1,
        correct: state.stats.correct + (isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
        streak: isCorrect ? state.stats.streak + 1 : 0,
        xp: state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut
            ? state.stats.xp
            : state.stats.xp + (isCorrect ? _xpFor(q, state.filter) : 0),
      ),
      lastResult: PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: answerIndex,
        isCorrect: isCorrect,
        timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
      ),
      isComplete: state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut ? true : outOfHearts,
    );

    if (state.isComplete) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
      _saveCompletedSession();
      return;
    }

    if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.speedRound) {
      _queueAutoAdvance(const Duration(milliseconds: 350));
    }
  }

  void previousQuestion() {
    if (state.currentIndex <= 0) return;
    state = state.copyWith(currentIndex: state.currentIndex - 1);
  }

  void nextQuestion() {
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    final nextIndex = state.currentIndex + 1;

    if (nextIndex >= state.questions.length) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true);
      return;
    }

    final q = state.questions[nextIndex];
    state = state.copyWith(
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(state.filter, q),
      clearLastResult: true,
    );
    if (state.filter.mode != PracticeMode.bagrut) {
      _startTimer();
    }
  }

  void skip() {
    if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards ||
        state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut) {
      return;
    }
    nextQuestion();
  }

  void endWithoutRewards() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true, stats: PracticeStats.zero);
    _saveCompletedSession();

class PracticeFilterController extends Notifier<PracticeFilter> {
  @override
  PracticeFilter build() => _defaultFilter();

  void setFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    state = next;
  }

  void patch({
    String? subject,
    PracticeMode? mode,
    PracticeDifficulty? difficulty,
    List<String>? topicPath,
    int? questionCount,
    int? timePreferenceSeconds,
    bool? useAiTiming,
    int? maxLives,
    bool? hasInfiniteLives,
  }) {
    state = state.copyWith(
      subject: subject ?? state.subject,
      mode: mode ?? state.mode,
      difficulty: difficulty ?? state.difficulty,
      topicPath: topicPath ?? state.topicPath,
      questionCount: questionCount ?? state.questionCount,
      timePreferenceSeconds:
          timePreferenceSeconds ?? state.timePreferenceSeconds,
      useAiTiming: useAiTiming ?? state.useAiTiming,
      maxLives: maxLives ?? state.maxLives,
      hasInfiniteLives: hasInfiniteLives ?? state.hasInfiniteLives,
    );
  }

  void reset() {
    state = _defaultFilter();
  }
}

class PracticeSessionController extends Notifier<PracticeSessionState> {
  final PracticeGenerator _generator = PracticeGenerator();
  Timer? _timer;
  Timer? _autoAdvanceTimer;

  @override
  PracticeSessionState build() {
    ref.onDispose(() {
      _timer?.cancel();
      _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    });
    return PracticeSessionState.initial(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  void selectOnlyFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    ref.read(practiceFilterProvider.notifier).setFilter(next);
    _timer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(next);
  }

  Future<void> start([PracticeFilter? override]) async {
    final PracticeFilter filter = override ?? ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);

    ref.read(practiceSessionLoadingProvider.notifier).setLoading(true);
    _timer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(filter);

    try {
      final questions = await _generator.generate(filter);
      final firstQuestion = questions.isEmpty ? null : questions.first;

      state = state.copyWith(
        filter: filter,
        questions: questions,
        currentIndex: 0,
        secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(filter, firstQuestion),
        isComplete: questions.isEmpty,
        stats: PracticeStats.zero,
      );

      if (questions.isNotEmpty) {
        _startTimer();
      }
    } catch (e, st) {
      final fallback = await _generator.generateFallback(filter);
      final firstQuestion = fallback.isEmpty ? null : fallback.first;

      state = state.copyWith(
        filter: filter,
        questions: fallback,
        currentIndex: 0,
        secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(filter, firstQuestion),
        isComplete: fallback.isEmpty,
        stats: PracticeStats.zero,
      );

      if (fallback.isNotEmpty) {
        _startTimer();
      }

      // ignore: avoid_print
      print('practice.start failed: $e');
      // ignore: avoid_print
      print(st);
    } finally {
      ref.read(practiceSessionLoadingProvider.notifier).setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  void submit(int answerIndex) {
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null || state.isComplete) return;
    if (state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(q.id)) return;

    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();

    final isCorrect = answerIndex == q.correctIndex;
    const timeTaken = 0;

    final nextAnswers = {
      ...state.answersByQuestionId,
      q.id: PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: answerIndex,
        isCorrect: isCorrect,
        timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
      ),
    };

    final outOfHearts = state.filter.hasInfiniteLives
        ? false
        : (_wrongAnswersCount(nextAnswers) >= state.filter.maxLives);

    state = state.copyWith(
      answersByQuestionId: nextAnswers,
      stats: state.stats.copyWith(
        answered: state.stats.answered + 1,
        correct: state.stats.correct + (isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
        streak: isCorrect ? state.stats.streak + 1 : 0,
        xp: state.stats.xp + (isCorrect ? _xpFor(q, state.filter) : 0),
      ),
      lastResult: PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: answerIndex,
        isCorrect: isCorrect,
        timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
      ),
      isComplete: outOfHearts,
    );

    if (outOfHearts) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
      return;
    }

    if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.speedRound) {
      _queueAutoAdvance(const Duration(milliseconds: 700));
    } else if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) {
      _queueAutoAdvance(const Duration(milliseconds: 950));
    }
  }

  void nextQuestion() {
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    final nextIndex = state.currentIndex + 1;

    if (nextIndex >= state.questions.length) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true);
      return;
    }

    final q = state.questions[nextIndex];
    state = state.copyWith(
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(state.filter, q),
      clearLastResult: true,
    );
    _startTimer();
  }

  void skip() {
    if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) return;
    nextQuestion();
  }

  void reset() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  void _queueAutoAdvance(Duration delay) {
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer = Timer(delay, () {
      if (!state.isComplete && state.lastResult != null) {
        nextQuestion();
      }
    });
  }

  void _startTimer() {
    _timer?.cancel();

    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null) return;

    final total = _resolveTime(state.filter, q);
    if (total <= 0) return;

    state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: total);

    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (state.secondsRemaining <= 1) {
        timer.cancel();

        if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) {
          submit(state.currentQuestion!.correctIndex);
          return;
        }

        nextQuestion();
        return;
      }

      state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: state.secondsRemaining - 1);
    });
  }

  int _wrongAnswersCount(Map<String, PracticeAnswerResult> answers) {
    return answers.values.where((x) => !x.isCorrect).length;
  }

  int _resolveTime(PracticeFilter filter, PracticeQuestion? q) {
    if (q == null) {
      return filter.useAiTiming ? 15 : (filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? 15);

import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

final practiceFilterProvider =
    StateNotifierProvider<PracticeFilterController, PracticeFilter>(
      (ref) => PracticeFilterController(),
    );

class PracticeFilterController extends StateNotifier<PracticeFilter> {
  PracticeFilterController() : super(PracticeFilter.initial());

  void patch({
    String? subject,
    List<String>? topicPath,
    PracticeMode? mode,
    PracticeDifficulty? difficulty,
    int? questionCount,
    bool? useAiTiming,
  }) {
    state = state.copyWith(
      subject: subject ?? state.subject,
      topicPath: topicPath ?? state.topicPath,
      mode: mode ?? state.mode,
      difficulty: difficulty ?? state.difficulty,
      questionCount: questionCount ?? state.questionCount,
      useAiTiming: useAiTiming ?? state.useAiTiming,
    );
  }

  void reset() {
    state = PracticeFilter.initial();
  }
}

final practiceSessionProvider =
    StateNotifierProvider<PracticeSessionController, PracticeSessionState>(
      (ref) => PracticeSessionController(ref),
    );

class PracticeSessionController extends StateNotifier<PracticeSessionState> {
  final Ref ref;
  final PracticeGenerator _generator = PracticeGenerator();
  Timer? _timer;

  PracticeSessionController(this.ref)
    : super(PracticeSessionState.initial(PracticeFilter.initial()));

  Future<void> start() async {
    final filter = ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);

    final questions = await _generator.generate(filter);
    if (questions.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }

    final first = questions.first;

    state = PracticeSessionState(
      filter: filter,
      questions: questions,
      currentIndex: 0,
      answersByQuestionId: {},
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(filter, first),
      isComplete: false,
      stats: const PracticeStats(),
      lastResult: null,
    );

    _startTimer();
  }

  void submit(int answerIndex) {
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null) return;

    final correct = answerIndex == q.correctIndex;

    final newAnswers = Map<String, int>.from(state.answersByQuestionId);
    newAnswers[q.id] = answerIndex;

    final newStats = state.stats.copyWith(
      correct: correct ? state.stats.correct + 1 : state.stats.correct,
      completed: state.stats.completed + 1,
    );

    state = state.copyWith(
      answersByQuestionId: newAnswers,
      stats: newStats,
      lastResult: correct,
    );
  }

  void nextQuestion() {
    final nextIndex = state.currentIndex + 1;

    if (nextIndex >= state.questions.length) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true);
      return;
    }

    final q = state.questions[nextIndex];

    state = state.copyWith(
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(state.filter, q),
      clearLastResult: true,
    );

    _startTimer();
  }

  void skip() {
    submit(-1);
    nextQuestion();
  }

  void reset() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    final filter = ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(filter);
  }

  void _startTimer() {
    _timer?.cancel();

    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null) return;

    final total = _resolveTime(state.filter, q);
    if (total <= 0) return;

    state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: total);

    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (state.secondsRemaining <= 1) {
        timer.cancel();
        submit(-1);
        nextQuestion();
        return;
      }

      state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: state.secondsRemaining - 1);
    });
  }

  int _resolveTime(PracticeFilter filter, PracticeQuestion q) {
    if (!filter.useAiTiming) return 20;

    switch (filter.difficulty) {
      case PracticeDifficulty.easy:
        return 20;
      case PracticeDifficulty.medium:
        return 30;
      case PracticeDifficulty.hard:
        return 45;
    }
  }
}

        secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(filter, firstQuestion),
        isComplete: questions.isEmpty,
        stats: PracticeStats.zero,
      );

      if (questions.isNotEmpty && filter.mode != PracticeMode.bagrut) {
        _startTimer();
      }
    } finally {
      ref.read(practiceSessionLoadingProvider.notifier).setLoading(false);
    }
  }

    if (state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(q.id)) return;

    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();

    final isCorrect = answerIndex == q.correctIndex;
    final total = _resolveTime(state.filter, q);
    final spent = total > 0
        ? ((total - state.secondsRemaining).clamp(0, total))
        : 0;
    final timeTaken = spent;

    final nextAnswers = {
      ...state.answersByQuestionId,
      q.id: PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: answerIndex,
        isCorrect: isCorrect,
        timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
      ),
    };

    final outOfHearts = state.filter.hasInfiniteLives
        ? false
        : (_wrongAnswersCount(nextAnswers) >= state.filter.maxLives);

      stats: state.stats.copyWith(
        answered: state.stats.answered + 1,
        correct: state.stats.correct + (isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
        streak: isCorrect ? state.stats.streak + 1 : 0,
        xp: state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut
            ? state.stats.xp
            : state.stats.xp + (isCorrect ? _xpFor(q, state.filter) : 0),
      ),
      lastResult: PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: answerIndex,
        isCorrect: isCorrect,
        timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
      ),
      isComplete: state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut ? true : outOfHearts,
    );

    if (state.isComplete) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
      return;
    }

    if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.speedRound) {

      _queueAutoAdvance(const Duration(milliseconds: 950));
    }
  }

  void nextQuestion() {
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    final nextIndex = state.currentIndex + 1;

    if (nextIndex >= state.questions.length) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true);
      return;
    }

    final q = state.questions[nextIndex];
    state = state.copyWith(
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(state.filter, q),
      clearLastResult: true,
    );
    if (state.filter.mode != PracticeMode.bagrut) {
      _startTimer();
    }
  }

  void skip() {
    if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards ||
        state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut) {
      return;
    }
    nextQuestion();
  }

  void endWithoutRewards() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true, stats: PracticeStats.zero);
  }

  void reset() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  void _queueAutoAdvance(Duration delay) {
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer = Timer(delay, () {
      if (!state.isComplete && state.lastResult != null) {
        nextQuestion();
      }
    });
  }

  void _startTimer() {
    _timer?.cancel();

    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null) return;

    final total = _resolveTime(state.filter, q);
    if (total <= 0) return;

    state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: total);

    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (state.secondsRemaining <= 1) {
        timer.cancel();

        if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) {
          submit(state.currentQuestion!.correctIndex);
          return;
        }

        nextQuestion();
        return;
      }

      state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: state.secondsRemaining - 1);
    });
