class PracticeSessionController extends Notifier<PracticeSessionState> {
  final PracticeGenerator _generator = PracticeGenerator();
  Timer? _timer;
  Timer? _autoAdvanceTimer;

  @override
  PracticeSessionState build() {
    ref.onDispose(() {
      _timer?.cancel();
      _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    });
    final PracticeFilter filter = ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);
    return _sessionInitial(filter);
  }

  void selectOnlyFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    ref.read(practiceFilterProvider.notifier).setFilter(next);
    _timer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    state = _sessionInitial(next);
  }

  Future<void> start([PracticeFilter? override]) async {
    final PracticeFilter filter = override ?? ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);

    ref.read(practiceSessionLoadingProvider.notifier).setLoading(true);
    _timer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    state = _sessionInitial(filter);

    try {
      final questions = await _generator.generate(filter);
      final firstQuestion = questions.isEmpty ? null : questions.first;

      state = state.copyWith(
        filter: filter,
        questions: questions,
        currentIndex: 0,
        secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(filter, firstQuestion),
        isComplete: questions.isEmpty,
        stats: _statsZero(),
      );

      if (questions.isNotEmpty) {
        _startTimer();
      }
    } finally {
      ref.read(practiceSessionLoadingProvider.notifier).setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  void submit(int answerIndex) {
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null || state.isComplete) return;
    if (state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(q.id)) return;

    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();

    final isCorrect = answerIndex == q.correctIndex;
    const timeTaken = 0;

    final nextAnswers = {
      ...state.answersByQuestionId,
      q.id: PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: answerIndex,
        isCorrect: isCorrect,
        timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
      ),
    };

    final outOfHearts =
        _wrongAnswersCount(nextAnswers) >= state.filter.maxLives;

    state = state.copyWith(
      answersByQuestionId: nextAnswers,
      stats: state.stats.copyWith(
        answered: state.stats.answered + 1,
        correct: state.stats.correct + (isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
        streak: isCorrect ? state.stats.streak + 1 : 0,
        xp: state.stats.xp + (isCorrect ? _xpFor(q, state.filter) : 0),
      ),
      lastResult: PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: answerIndex,
        isCorrect: isCorrect,
        timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
      ),
      isComplete: outOfHearts,
    );

    if (outOfHearts) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
      return;
    }

    if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.speedRound) {
      _queueAutoAdvance(const Duration(milliseconds: 700));
    } else if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) {
      _queueAutoAdvance(const Duration(milliseconds: 950));
    }
  }

  void nextQuestion() {
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    final nextIndex = state.currentIndex + 1;

    if (nextIndex >= state.questions.length) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true);
      return;
    }

    final q = state.questions[nextIndex];
    state = state.copyWith(
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(state.filter, q),
      clearLastResult: true,
    );
    _startTimer();
  }

  void skip() {
    if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) return;
    nextQuestion();
  }

  void reset() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    state = _sessionInitial(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  void _queueAutoAdvance(Duration delay) {
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer = Timer(delay, () {
      if (!state.isComplete && state.lastResult != null) {
        nextQuestion();
      }
    });
  }

  void _startTimer() {
    _timer?.cancel();

    if (q == null) return;

    final total = _resolveTime(state.filter, q);
    if (total <= 0) return;

    state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: total);

          return;
        }

        nextQuestion();
        return;
      }

      state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: state.secondsRemaining - 1);
    });
  }

  int _wrongAnswersCount(Map<String, PracticeAnswerResult> answers) {
    return answers.values.where((x) => !x.isCorrect).length;
  }

  int _resolveTime(PracticeFilter filter, PracticeQuestion? q) {

      PracticeMode.adaptive => raw,
      PracticeMode.practice => raw,
    };

    return adjusted < 8 ? 8 : adjusted;
  }

class PracticeSessionController extends Notifier<PracticeSessionState> {
  final PracticeGenerator _generator = PracticeGenerator();
  Timer? _timer;
  bool _isLoading = false;

  @override
  PracticeSessionState build() {
    ref.onDispose(() {
      _timer?.cancel();
    });
    final filter = ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);
    return _sessionInitial(filter);
  }

  void selectOnlyFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    ref.read(practiceFilterProvider.notifier).setFilter(next);
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = _sessionInitial(next);
  }

  Future<void> start([PracticeFilter? override]) async {
    final PracticeFilter filter = override ?? ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);

    _isLoading = true;
    ref.notifyListeners();

    _timer?.cancel();
    state = _sessionInitial(filter);

    try {
      final questions = await _generator.generate(filter);
      final firstQuestion = questions.isEmpty ? null : questions.first;

      state = state.copyWith(
        filter: filter,
        questions: questions,
        currentIndex: 0,
        secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(filter, firstQuestion),
        isComplete: questions.isEmpty,
        stats: _statsZero(),
        clearLastResult: true,
      );

      if (questions.isNotEmpty) {
        _startTimer();
      }
    } finally {
      _isLoading = false;
      ref.notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  void submit(int answerIndex) {
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null || state.isComplete || state.lastResult != null) {
      return;
    }

    final isCorrect = answerIndex == q.correctIndex;
    final timeTaken = 0;

    state = state.copyWith(
      answersByQuestionId: {
        ...state.answersByQuestionId,
        q.id: PracticeAnswerResult(
          selectedIndex: answerIndex,
          isCorrect: isCorrect,
          timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
        ),
      },
      stats: state.stats.copyWith(
        answered: state.stats.answered + 1,
        correct: state.stats.correct + (isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
        streak: isCorrect ? state.stats.streak + 1 : 0,
        xp: state.stats.xp + (isCorrect ? _xpFor(q) : 0),
      ),
      lastResult: PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: answerIndex,
        isCorrect: isCorrect,
        timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
      ),
    );

    if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.speedRound) {
      Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 650), () {
        if (state.isComplete) return;
        nextQuestion();
      });
    }
  }

  void nextQuestion() {
    final nextIndex = state.currentIndex + 1;

    if (nextIndex >= state.questions.length) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true);
      return;
    }

    final q = state.questions[nextIndex];
    state = state.copyWith(
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(state.filter, q),
      clearLastResult: true,
    );
    _startTimer();
  }

  void skip() {
    nextQuestion();
  }

  void reset() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = _sessionInitial(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  void _startTimer() {
    _timer?.cancel();

    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null) {
      return;
    }

    final total = _resolveTime(state.filter, q);
    if (total <= 0) {
      return;
    }

    state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: total);

    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (state.secondsRemaining <= 1) {
        timer.cancel();

        if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards ||
            state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.conceptBuilder) {
          state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: 0);
          return;
        }

        nextQuestion();
        return;
      }

      state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: state.secondsRemaining - 1);
    });
  }

  int _resolveTime(PracticeFilter filter, PracticeQuestion? q) {
    if (!filter.useAiTiming) {
      final base = filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? 20;
      return switch (filter.mode) {
        PracticeMode.flashcards => base,
        PracticeMode.speedRound => base < 8 ? base : 8,
        PracticeMode.examPrep => base + 20,
        PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => base + 10,
        PracticeMode.adaptive => base,
        PracticeMode.practice => base,
      };
    }

    final recommended = q?.recommendedTimeSeconds;
    final base = (recommended != null && recommended > 0)
        ? recommended
        : switch (filter.difficulty) {
            PracticeDifficulty.easy => 20,
            PracticeDifficulty.medium => 30,
            PracticeDifficulty.hard => 45,
            PracticeDifficulty.olympiad => 60,
            PracticeDifficulty.adaptive => 30,
          };

    return switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => base < 14 ? base : 14,
      PracticeMode.speedRound => base < 9 ? base : 9,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => base + 20,
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => base + 12,
      PracticeMode.adaptive => base,
      PracticeMode.practice => base,
    };
  }

  int _xpFor(PracticeQuestion q) {
    final base = switch (q.difficulty) {
      PracticeDifficulty.easy => 8,
      PracticeDifficulty.medium => 10,
      PracticeDifficulty.hard => 14,
      PracticeDifficulty.olympiad => 20,
      PracticeDifficulty.adaptive => 10,
    };

    return switch (q.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => base - 2,
      PracticeMode.speedRound => base + 2,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => base + 4,
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => base + 1,
      PracticeMode.adaptive => base + 2,
      PracticeMode.practice => base,
    };
  }

    NotifierProvider<PracticeFilterController, PracticeFilter>(
      PracticeFilterController.new,
    );

class PracticeFilterController extends Notifier<PracticeFilter> {
  @override
  PracticeFilter build() => _defaultFilter();

  void setFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    state = _normalize(next);
  }

  void patch({
    String? subject,
    PracticeMode? mode,
    PracticeDifficulty? difficulty,
    List<String>? topicPath,
    int? questionCount,
    int? timePreferenceSeconds,
    bool? useAiTiming,
    int? maxLives,
    String? note,
  }) {
    state = _normalize(
      state.copyWith(
        subject: subject ?? state.subject,
        mode: mode ?? state.mode,
        difficulty: difficulty ?? state.difficulty,
        topicPath: topicPath ?? state.topicPath,
        questionCount: questionCount ?? state.questionCount,
        timePreferenceSeconds:
            timePreferenceSeconds ?? state.timePreferenceSeconds,
        useAiTiming: useAiTiming ?? state.useAiTiming,
        maxLives: maxLives ?? state.maxLives,
        note: note ?? state.note,
      ),
    );
  }

  void reset() {
    state = _defaultFilter();
  }

  PracticeFilter _normalize(PracticeFilter filter) {
    if (filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut) {
      return filter.copyWith(
        questionCount: filter.questionCount < 1 ? 1 : filter.questionCount,
        useAiTiming: false,
        timePreferenceSeconds: 0,
        maxLives: -1,
      );
    }

    return filter;
  }
}

final practiceSessionProvider =
    NotifierProvider<PracticeSessionController, PracticeSessionState>(
      PracticeSessionController.new,
    );

class PracticeSessionController extends Notifier<PracticeSessionState> {
  final PracticeGenerator _generator = PracticeGenerator();
  Timer? _timer;

  @override
  PracticeSessionState build() {
    ref.onDispose(() {
      _timer?.cancel();
    });
    return PracticeSessionState.initial(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  void selectOnlyFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    ref.read(practiceFilterProvider.notifier).setFilter(next);
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(next);
  }

  Future<void> start([PracticeFilter? override]) async {
    final filter = override ?? ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);
    ref.read(practiceSessionLoadingProvider.notifier).state = true;
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(filter);

    try {
      final questions = await _generator.generate(filter);
      final first = questions.isEmpty ? null : questions.first;
      state = state.copyWith(
        filter: filter,
        questions: questions,
        currentIndex: 0,
        secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(filter, first),
        isComplete: questions.isEmpty,
        livesLeft: filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut || filter.maxLives < 0
            ? -1
            : filter.maxLives,
      );
      if (first != null && !filter.hasNoTime) {
        _startTimer();
      }
    } finally {
      ref.read(practiceSessionLoadingProvider.notifier).state = false;
    }
  }

  void submit(int answerIndex) {
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null || state.isComplete) return;
    if (state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(q.id)) return;

    final isCorrect = answerIndex == q.correctIndex;
    final nextLives = state.livesLeft < 0
        ? -1
        : (isCorrect ? state.livesLeft : state.livesLeft - 1);

    state = state.copyWith(
      answersByQuestionId: {
        ...state.answersByQuestionId,
        q.id: PracticeAnswerResult(
          selectedIndex: answerIndex,
          isCorrect: isCorrect,
          timeTakenSeconds: 0,
        ),
      },
      stats: state.stats.copyWith(
        answered: state.stats.answered + 1,
        correct: state.stats.correct + (isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
        streak: isCorrect ? state.stats.streak + 1 : 0,
        xp: state.stats.xp + (isCorrect ? _xpFor(q) : 0),
      ),
      lastResult: PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: answerIndex,
        isCorrect: isCorrect,
        timeTakenSeconds: 0,
      ),
      livesLeft: nextLives,
      isComplete: nextLives == 0 ? true : state.isComplete,
    );

    if (nextLives == 0) {
      _timer?.cancel();
    }
  }

  void markBagrutDone() {
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null || state.isComplete) return;

    state = state.copyWith(
      answersByQuestionId: {
        ...state.answersByQuestionId,
        q.id: const PracticeAnswerResult(
          selectedIndex: 0,
          isCorrect: true,
          timeTakenSeconds: 0,
        ),
      },
      stats: state.stats.copyWith(
        answered: state.stats.answered + 1,
        correct: state.stats.correct + 1,
        streak: state.stats.streak + 1,
        xp: state.stats.xp + 20,
      ),
      lastResult: const PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: 0,
        isCorrect: true,
        timeTakenSeconds: 0,
      ),
    );
  }

  void nextQuestion() {
    final nextIndex = state.currentIndex + 1;
    if (nextIndex >= state.questions.length) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true);
      return;
    }

    final q = state.questions[nextIndex];
    state = state.copyWith(
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(state.filter, q),
      clearLastResult: true,
    );

    if (!state.filter.hasNoTime) {
      _startTimer();
    } else {
      _timer?.cancel();
    }
  }

  void skip() {
    nextQuestion();
  }

  void reset() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  void _startTimer() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null) return;

    final total = _resolveTime(state.filter, q);
    if (total <= 0) {
      state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: 0);
      return;
    }

    state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: total);

    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (state.secondsRemaining <= 1) {
        timer.cancel();
        if (state.filter.mode != PracticeMode.bagrut) {
          skip();
        }
        return;
      }
      state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: state.secondsRemaining - 1);
    });
  }

  int _resolveTime(PracticeFilter filter, PracticeQuestion? q) {
    if (filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut) return 0;
    if (!filter.useAiTiming) return filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? 0;
    return q?.recommendedTimeSeconds ?? 0;
  }

  int _xpFor(PracticeQuestion q) {
    return switch (q.difficulty) {
      PracticeDifficulty.easy => 8,
      PracticeDifficulty.medium => 12,
      PracticeDifficulty.hard => 18,
      PracticeDifficulty.olympiad => 26,
      PracticeDifficulty.adaptive => 16,
    };
  }
}

final practiceSessionProvider =
    NotifierProvider<PracticeSessionController, PracticeSessionState>(
      PracticeSessionController.new,

class PracticeSessionController extends Notifier<PracticeSessionState> {
  final PracticeGenerator _generator = PracticeGenerator();
  Timer? _timer;
  Timer? _autoAdvanceTimer;

  @override
  PracticeSessionState build() {
    ref.onDispose(() {
      _timer?.cancel();
      _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    });
    return PracticeSessionState.initial(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  void selectOnlyFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    ref.read(practiceFilterProvider.notifier).setFilter(next);
    _timer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(next);
  }

  Future<void> start([PracticeFilter? override]) async {
    final PracticeFilter filter = override ?? ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);

    ref.read(practiceSessionLoadingProvider.notifier).setLoading(true);
    _timer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(filter);

    try {
      final questions = await _generator.generate(filter);
      final firstQuestion = questions.isEmpty ? null : questions.first;

      state = state.copyWith(
        filter: filter,
        questions: questions,
        currentIndex: 0,
        secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(filter, firstQuestion),
        isComplete: questions.isEmpty,
        stats: PracticeStats.zero,
      );

      if (questions.isNotEmpty) {
        _startTimer();
      }
    } catch (e, st) {
      // ignore: avoid_print
      print('practice.start failed: $e');
      // ignore: avoid_print
      print(st);
      rethrow;
    } finally {
      ref.read(practiceSessionLoadingProvider.notifier).setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  void submit(int answerIndex) {
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null || state.isComplete) return;
    if (state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(q.id)) return;

    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();

    final isCorrect = answerIndex == q.correctIndex;
    const timeTaken = 0;

    final nextAnswers = {
      ...state.answersByQuestionId,
      q.id: PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: answerIndex,
        isCorrect: isCorrect,
        timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
      ),
    };

    final outOfHearts =
        _wrongAnswersCount(nextAnswers) >= state.filter.maxLives;

    state = state.copyWith(
      answersByQuestionId: nextAnswers,
      stats: state.stats.copyWith(
        answered: state.stats.answered + 1,
        correct: state.stats.correct + (isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
        streak: isCorrect ? state.stats.streak + 1 : 0,
        xp: state.stats.xp + (isCorrect ? _xpFor(q, state.filter) : 0),
      ),
      lastResult: PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: answerIndex,
        isCorrect: isCorrect,
        timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
      ),
      isComplete: outOfHearts,
    );

    if (outOfHearts) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
      return;
    }

    if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.speedRound) {
      _queueAutoAdvance(const Duration(milliseconds: 700));
    } else if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) {
      _queueAutoAdvance(const Duration(milliseconds: 950));
    }
  }

  void nextQuestion() {
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    final nextIndex = state.currentIndex + 1;

    if (nextIndex >= state.questions.length) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true);
      return;
    }

    final q = state.questions[nextIndex];
    state = state.copyWith(
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(state.filter, q),
      clearLastResult: true,
    );
    _startTimer();
  }

  void skip() {
    if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) return;
    nextQuestion();
  }

  void reset() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  void _queueAutoAdvance(Duration delay) {
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer = Timer(delay, () {
      if (!state.isComplete && state.lastResult != null) {
        nextQuestion();
      }
    });
  }

  void _startTimer() {
    _timer?.cancel();

    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null) return;

    final total = _resolveTime(state.filter, q);
    if (total <= 0) return;

    state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: total);

    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (state.secondsRemaining <= 1) {
        timer.cancel();

        if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) {
          submit(state.currentQuestion!.correctIndex);
          return;
        }

        nextQuestion();
        return;
      }

      state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: state.secondsRemaining - 1);
    });
  }

  int _wrongAnswersCount(Map<String, PracticeAnswerResult> answers) {
    return answers.values.where((x) => !x.isCorrect).length;
  }

  int _resolveTime(PracticeFilter filter, PracticeQuestion? q) {
    if (q == null) {
      return filter.useAiTiming ? 15 : (filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? 15);
    }
    return filter.useAiTiming
        ? q.recommendedTimeSeconds
        : (filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? q.recommendedTimeSeconds);
  }

  int _xpFor(PracticeQuestion q, PracticeFilter filter) {
    final difficultyBoost = switch (filter.difficulty) {
      PracticeDifficulty.easy => 6,
      PracticeDifficulty.medium => 10,
      PracticeDifficulty.hard => 16,
      PracticeDifficulty.olympiad => 24,
      PracticeDifficulty.adaptive => 14,
    };
    return difficultyBoost + (q.recommendedTimeSeconds ~/ 12);
  }
}

import 'package:state_notifier/state_notifier.dart';
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:riverpod/riverpod.dart';

import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

final practiceGeneratorProvider = Provider<PracticeGenerator>((ref) {
  return PracticeGenerator();
});

final practiceFilterProvider = StateProvider<PracticeFilter>((ref) {
  return PracticeFilter.defaults;

final practiceSessionProvider =
    StateNotifierProvider.autoDispose<
      PracticeSessionController,
      PracticeSessionState
    >((ref) {
      final generator = ref.watch(practiceGeneratorProvider);
      final filter = ref.watch(practiceFilterProvider);
      return PracticeSessionController(
        generator: generator,
        initialFilter: filter,
      );
    });

class PracticeSessionController extends StateNotifier<PracticeSessionState> {
  PracticeSessionController({
    required PracticeGenerator generator,
    required PracticeFilter initialFilter,
  }) : _generator = generator,
       super(PracticeSessionState.initial(initialFilter));

  final PracticeGenerator _generator;
  Timer? _timer;

  Future<void> start(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    _timer?.cancel();
    final questions = await _generator.generate(filter);
    final firstTime = _resolveTime(
      filter,
      questions.isEmpty ? null : questions.first,
    );
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(filter).copyWith(
      filter: filter,
      questions: questions,
      currentIndex: 0,
      secondsRemaining: firstTime,
      clearLastResult: true,
    );
    _startTimerForCurrent();
  }

  void updateFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    state = state.copyWith(filter: next);
  }

  void selectOnlyFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(next);
  }

  void submit(int selectedIndex) {
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null || state.isComplete) return;
    if (state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(q.id)) return;

    final timeTaken = (q.recommendedTimeSeconds <= 0)
        ? 0
        : (q.recommendedTimeSeconds - state.secondsRemaining).clamp(0, 9999);

    final result = PracticeAnswerResult(
      selectedIndex: selectedIndex,
      isCorrect: selectedIndex == q.correctIndex,
      timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
    );

    final answers = <String, PracticeAnswerResult>{
      ...state.answersByQuestionId,
      q.id: result,
    };
    final gainedXp = result.isCorrect ? _xpFor(q) : 2;
    final nextStats = state.stats.copyWith(
      answered: state.stats.answered + 1,
      correct: state.stats.correct + (result.isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
      xp: state.stats.xp + gainedXp,
      streak: result.isCorrect ? state.stats.streak + 1 : 0,
    );

    state = state.copyWith(
      answersByQuestionId: answers,
      stats: nextStats,
      lastResult: result,
    );
    _timer?.cancel();
  }

  void nextQuestion() {
    if (state.isComplete) return;
    final nextIndex = state.currentIndex + 1;
    if (nextIndex >= state.questions.length) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true, clearLastResult: false);
      return;
    }

    final nextQuestion = state.questions[nextIndex];
    state = state.copyWith(
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(state.filter, nextQuestion),
      clearLastResult: true,
    );
    _startTimerForCurrent();
  }

  void skip() {
    submit(-1);
    nextQuestion();
  }

  void reset() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(state.filter);
  }

  void _startTimerForCurrent() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null) return;
    if (_resolveTime(state.filter, q) <= 0) return;

    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (state.secondsRemaining <= 1) {
        timer.cancel();
        if (state.currentQuestion != null &&
            !state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(state.currentQuestion!.id)) {
          submit(-1);
        }
        return;
      }
      state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: state.secondsRemaining - 1);
    });
  }

  int _resolveTime(PracticeFilter filter, PracticeQuestion? q) {
    if (filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) return 0;
    if (filter.useAiTiming) return q?.recommendedTimeSeconds ?? 15;
    return filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? q?.recommendedTimeSeconds ?? 15;
  }

  int _xpFor(PracticeQuestion q) {
    switch (q.difficulty) {
      case PracticeDifficulty.easy:
        return 8;
      case PracticeDifficulty.medium:
        return 10;
      case PracticeDifficulty.hard:
        return 14;

        return 20;

      PracticeSessionController.new,

class PracticeSessionController extends Notifier<PracticeSessionState> {
  final PracticeGenerator _generator = PracticeGenerator();
  Timer? _timer;

  @override
  PracticeSessionState build() {
    ref.onDispose(() {
      _timer?.cancel();
    });
    final filter = ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);
    return _sessionInitial(filter);
  }

  void selectOnlyFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    ref.read(practiceFilterProvider.notifier).setFilter(next);
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = _sessionInitial(next);
  }

  Future<void> start([PracticeFilter? override]) async {
    final PracticeFilter filter = override ?? ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);

    ref.read(practiceSessionLoadingProvider.notifier).state = true;
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = _sessionInitial(filter);

    try {
      final questions = await _generator.generate(filter);
      final firstQuestion = questions.isEmpty ? null : questions.first;

      state = state.copyWith(
        filter: filter,
        questions: questions,
        currentIndex: 0,
        secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(filter, firstQuestion),
        isComplete: questions.isEmpty,
        stats: _statsZero(),
      );

      if (questions.isNotEmpty) {
        _startTimer();
      }
    } finally {
      ref.read(practiceSessionLoadingProvider.notifier).state = false;
    }
  }

  void submit(int answerIndex) {
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null || state.isComplete) {
      return;
    }

    final isCorrect = answerIndex == q.correctIndex;
    final timeTaken = 0;

    state = state.copyWith(
      answersByQuestionId: {
        ...state.answersByQuestionId,
        q.id: PracticeAnswerResult(
          selectedIndex: answerIndex,
          isCorrect: isCorrect,
          timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
        ),
      },
      stats: state.stats.copyWith(
        answered: state.stats.answered + 1,
        correct: state.stats.correct + (isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
        streak: isCorrect ? state.stats.streak + 1 : 0,
        xp: state.stats.xp + (isCorrect ? _xpFor(q) : 0),
      ),
      lastResult: PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: answerIndex,
        isCorrect: isCorrect,
        timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
      ),
    );
  }

  void nextQuestion() {
    final nextIndex = state.currentIndex + 1;

    if (nextIndex >= state.questions.length) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true);
      return;
    }

    final q = state.questions[nextIndex];
    state = state.copyWith(
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(state.filter, q),
      clearLastResult: true,
    );
    _startTimer();
  }

  void skip() {
    nextQuestion();
  }

  void reset() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = _sessionInitial(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  void _startTimer() {
    _timer?.cancel();

    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null) {
      return;
    }

    final total = _resolveTime(state.filter, q);
    if (total <= 0) {
      return;
    }

    state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: total);

    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (state.secondsRemaining <= 1) {
        timer.cancel();
        nextQuestion();
        return;
      }

      state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: state.secondsRemaining - 1);
    });
  }

  int _resolveTime(PracticeFilter filter, dynamic q) {
    if (!filter.useAiTiming) {
      return filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? 20;
    }

    if (q == null) {
      return 20;
    }

    try {
      final recommended = q.recommendedTimeSeconds as int?;
      if (recommended != null && recommended > 0) {
        return recommended;
      }
    } catch (_) {
      return switch (filter.difficulty) {
        PracticeDifficulty.easy => 20,
        PracticeDifficulty.medium => 30,
        PracticeDifficulty.hard => 45,
        PracticeDifficulty.olympiad => 60,
        PracticeDifficulty.adaptive => 30,
      };
    }

    return switch (filter.difficulty) {
      PracticeDifficulty.easy => 20,
      PracticeDifficulty.medium => 30,
      PracticeDifficulty.hard => 45,
      PracticeDifficulty.olympiad => 60,
      PracticeDifficulty.adaptive => 30,
    };
  }

  int _xpFor(dynamic q) {
    return switch (q.difficulty) {
      PracticeDifficulty.easy => 8,
      PracticeDifficulty.medium => 10,
      PracticeDifficulty.hard => 14,
      PracticeDifficulty.olympiad => 20,
      PracticeDifficulty.adaptive => 10,
      _ => 10,
    };
  }
}

===== apps/classmate_mobile/lib/features/practice/providers/practice_providers.dart.full_fix.1773082107.bak =====
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'dart:async';

import '../data/practice_generator.dart';
import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

final practiceGeneratorProvider = Provider<PracticeGenerator>((ref) {
  return PracticeGenerator();
});

final practiceFilterProvider = StateProvider<PracticeFilter>((ref) {
  return PracticeFilter.defaults;
});

final practiceSessionProvider =
    StateNotifierProvider.autoDispose<
      PracticeSessionController,
      PracticeSessionState
    >((ref) {
      final generator = ref.watch(practiceGeneratorProvider);
      final filter = ref.watch(practiceFilterProvider);
      return PracticeSessionController(
        generator: generator,
        initialFilter: filter,
      );
    });

class PracticeSessionController extends StateNotifier<PracticeSessionState> {
  PracticeSessionController({
    required PracticeGenerator generator,
    required PracticeFilter initialFilter,
  }) : _generator = generator,
       super(PracticeSessionState.initial(initialFilter));

  final PracticeGenerator _generator;
  Timer? _timer;

  Future<void> start(PracticeFilter filter) async {
    _timer?.cancel();
    final questions = await _generator.generate(filter);
    final firstTime = _resolveTime(
      filter,
      questions.isEmpty ? null : questions.first,
    );
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(filter).copyWith(
      filter: filter,
      questions: questions,
      currentIndex: 0,
      secondsRemaining: firstTime,
      clearLastResult: true,
    );
    _startTimerForCurrent();
  }

  void updateFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    state = state.copyWith(filter: next);
  }

  void selectOnlyFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(next);
  }

  void submit(int selectedIndex) {
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null || state.isComplete) return;
    if (state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(q.id)) return;

    final timeTaken = (q.recommendedTimeSeconds <= 0)
        ? 0
        : (q.recommendedTimeSeconds - state.secondsRemaining).clamp(0, 9999);

    final result = PracticeAnswerResult(
      selectedIndex: selectedIndex,
      isCorrect: selectedIndex == q.correctIndex,
      timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
    );

    final answers = <String, PracticeAnswerResult>{
      ...state.answersByQuestionId,
      q.id: result,
    };
    final gainedXp = result.isCorrect ? _xpFor(q) : 2;
    final nextStats = state.stats.copyWith(
      answered: state.stats.answered + 1,
      correct: state.stats.correct + (result.isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
      xp: state.stats.xp + gainedXp,
      streak: result.isCorrect ? state.stats.streak + 1 : 0,
    );

    state = state.copyWith(
      answersByQuestionId: answers,
      stats: nextStats,
      lastResult: result,
    );
    _timer?.cancel();
  }

  void nextQuestion() {
    if (state.isComplete) return;
    final nextIndex = state.currentIndex + 1;
    if (nextIndex >= state.questions.length) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true, clearLastResult: false);
      return;
    }

    final nextQuestion = state.questions[nextIndex];
    state = state.copyWith(
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(state.filter, nextQuestion),
      clearLastResult: true,
    );
    _startTimerForCurrent();
  }

  void skip() {
    submit(-1);
    nextQuestion();
  }

  void reset() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(state.filter);
  }

  void _startTimerForCurrent() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null) return;
    if (_resolveTime(state.filter, q) <= 0) return;

    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (state.secondsRemaining <= 1) {
        timer.cancel();
        if (state.currentQuestion != null &&
            !state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(state.currentQuestion!.id)) {
          submit(-1);
        }
        return;
      }
      state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: state.secondsRemaining - 1);
    });
  }

  int _resolveTime(PracticeFilter filter, PracticeQuestion? q) {
    if (filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) return 0;
    if (filter.useAiTiming) return q?.recommendedTimeSeconds ?? 15;
    return filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? q?.recommendedTimeSeconds ?? 15;
  }

  int _xpFor(PracticeQuestion q) {
    switch (q.difficulty) {
      case PracticeDifficulty.easy:
        return 8;
      case PracticeDifficulty.medium:
        return 10;
      case PracticeDifficulty.hard:
        return 14;
      case PracticeDifficulty.olympiad:
        return 20;
      case PracticeDifficulty.adaptive:
        return 10;
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }
}

final practiceFilterProvider =
    NotifierProvider<PracticeFilterController, PracticeFilter>(

class PracticeFilterController extends Notifier<PracticeFilter> {
  @override
  PracticeFilter build() => _defaultFilter();

  void setFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    state = _normalize(next);
  }

  void patch({
    String? subject,
    PracticeMode? mode,
    PracticeDifficulty? difficulty,
    List<String>? topicPath,
    int? questionCount,
    int? timePreferenceSeconds,
    bool? useAiTiming,
    int? maxLives,
    String? note,
  }) {
    state = _normalize(
      state.copyWith(
        subject: subject ?? state.subject,
        mode: mode ?? state.mode,
        difficulty: difficulty ?? state.difficulty,
        topicPath: topicPath ?? state.topicPath,
        questionCount: questionCount ?? state.questionCount,
        timePreferenceSeconds:
            timePreferenceSeconds ?? state.timePreferenceSeconds,
        useAiTiming: useAiTiming ?? state.useAiTiming,
        maxLives: maxLives ?? state.maxLives,
        note: note ?? state.note,
      ),
    );
  }

  void reset() {
    state = _defaultFilter();
  }

  PracticeFilter _normalize(PracticeFilter filter) {
    if (filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut) {
      return filter.copyWith(
        questionCount: filter.questionCount < 1 ? 1 : filter.questionCount,
        useAiTiming: false,
        timePreferenceSeconds: 0,
        maxLives: -1,
      );
    }

    return filter;
  }
}

final practiceSessionProvider =
    NotifierProvider<PracticeSessionController, PracticeSessionState>(
      PracticeSessionController.new,

class PracticeSessionController extends Notifier<PracticeSessionState> {
  final PracticeGenerator _generator = PracticeGenerator();
  Timer? _timer;

  @override
  PracticeSessionState build() {
    ref.onDispose(() {
      _timer?.cancel();
    });
    return PracticeSessionState.initial(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  void selectOnlyFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    ref.read(practiceFilterProvider.notifier).setFilter(next);
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(next);
  }

  Future<void> start([PracticeFilter? override]) async {
    final PracticeFilter filter = override ?? ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);
    ref.read(practiceSessionLoadingProvider.notifier).setLoading(true);
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(filter);

    try {
      final questions = await _generator.generate(filter);
      final first = questions.isEmpty ? null : questions.first;
      state = state.copyWith(
        filter: filter,
        questions: questions,
        currentIndex: 0,
        secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(filter, first),
        isComplete: questions.isEmpty,
        livesLeft: filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut || filter.maxLives < 0
            ? -1
            : filter.maxLives,
      );
      if (first != null && !filter.hasNoTime) {
        _startTimer();
      }
    } finally {
      ref.read(practiceSessionLoadingProvider.notifier).setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  void submit(int answerIndex) {
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null || state.isComplete) return;
    if (state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(q.id)) return;

    final isCorrect = answerIndex == q.correctIndex;
    final nextLives = state.livesLeft < 0
        ? -1
        : (isCorrect ? state.livesLeft : state.livesLeft - 1);

    state = state.copyWith(
      answersByQuestionId: {
        ...state.answersByQuestionId,
        q.id: PracticeAnswerResult(
          selectedIndex: answerIndex,
          isCorrect: isCorrect,
          timeTakenSeconds: 0,
        ),
      },
      stats: state.stats.copyWith(
        answered: state.stats.answered + 1,
        correct: state.stats.correct + (isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
        streak: isCorrect ? state.stats.streak + 1 : 0,
        xp: state.stats.xp + (isCorrect ? _xpFor(q) : 0),
      ),
      lastResult: PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: answerIndex,
        isCorrect: isCorrect,
        timeTakenSeconds: 0,
      ),
      livesLeft: nextLives,
      isComplete: nextLives == 0 ? true : state.isComplete,
    );

    if (nextLives == 0) {
      _timer?.cancel();
    }
  }

  void markBagrutDone() {
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null || state.isComplete) return;

    state = state.copyWith(
      answersByQuestionId: {
        ...state.answersByQuestionId,
        q.id: const PracticeAnswerResult(
          selectedIndex: 0,
          isCorrect: true,
          timeTakenSeconds: 0,
        ),
      },
      stats: state.stats.copyWith(
        answered: state.stats.answered + 1,
        correct: state.stats.correct + 1,
        streak: state.stats.streak + 1,
        xp: state.stats.xp + 20,
      ),
      lastResult: const PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: 0,
        isCorrect: true,
        timeTakenSeconds: 0,
      ),
    );
  }

  void nextQuestion() {
    final nextIndex = state.currentIndex + 1;
    if (nextIndex >= state.questions.length) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true);
      return;
    }

    final q = state.questions[nextIndex];
    state = state.copyWith(
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(state.filter, q),
      clearLastResult: true,
    );

    if (!state.filter.hasNoTime) {
      _startTimer();
    } else {
      _timer?.cancel();
    }
  }

  void skip() {
    nextQuestion();
  }

  void reset() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  void _startTimer() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null) return;

    final total = _resolveTime(state.filter, q);
    if (total <= 0) {
      state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: 0);
      return;
    }

    state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: total);

    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (state.secondsRemaining <= 1) {
        timer.cancel();
        if (state.filter.mode != PracticeMode.bagrut) {
          skip();
        }
        return;
      }
      state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: state.secondsRemaining - 1);
    });
  }

  int _resolveTime(PracticeFilter filter, PracticeQuestion? q) {
    if (filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut) return 0;
    if (!filter.useAiTiming) return filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? 0;
    return q?.recommendedTimeSeconds ?? 0;
  }

  int _xpFor(PracticeQuestion q) {
    return switch (q.difficulty) {
      PracticeDifficulty.easy => 8,
      PracticeDifficulty.medium => 12,
      PracticeDifficulty.hard => 18,
      PracticeDifficulty.olympiad => 26,
      PracticeDifficulty.adaptive => 16,
    };
  }

class PracticeSessionController extends Notifier<PracticeSessionState> {
  final PracticeGenerator _generator = PracticeGenerator();
  Timer? _timer;
  Timer? _autoAdvanceTimer;

  @override
  PracticeSessionState build() {
    ref.onDispose(() {
      _timer?.cancel();
      _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    });
    final filter = ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);
    return _sessionInitial(filter);
  }

  void selectOnlyFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    ref.read(practiceFilterProvider.notifier).setFilter(next);
    _timer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    state = _sessionInitial(next);
  }

  Future<void> start([PracticeFilter? override]) async {
    final PracticeFilter filter = override ?? ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);

    ref.read(practiceSessionLoadingProvider.notifier).setLoading(true);
    _timer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    state = _sessionInitial(filter);

    try {
      final questions = await _generator.generate(filter);
      final firstQuestion = questions.isEmpty ? null : questions.first;

      state = state.copyWith(
        filter: filter,
        questions: questions,
        currentIndex: 0,
        secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(filter, firstQuestion),
        isComplete: questions.isEmpty,
        stats: _statsZero(),
      );

      if (questions.isNotEmpty) {
        _startTimer();
      }
    } finally {
      ref.read(practiceSessionLoadingProvider.notifier).setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  void submit(int answerIndex) {
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null || state.isComplete) return;
    if (state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(q.id)) return;

    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();

    final isCorrect = answerIndex == q.correctIndex;
    const timeTaken = 0;

    final nextAnswers = {
      ...state.answersByQuestionId,
      q.id: PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: answerIndex,
        isCorrect: isCorrect,
        timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
      ),
    };

    final outOfHearts = _wrongAnswersCount(nextAnswers) >= 3;

    state = state.copyWith(
      answersByQuestionId: nextAnswers,
      stats: state.stats.copyWith(
        answered: state.stats.answered + 1,
        correct: state.stats.correct + (isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
        streak: isCorrect ? state.stats.streak + 1 : 0,
        xp: state.stats.xp + (isCorrect ? _xpFor(q, state.filter) : 0),
      ),
      lastResult: PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: answerIndex,
        isCorrect: isCorrect,
        timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
      ),
      isComplete: outOfHearts,
    );

    if (outOfHearts) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
      return;
    }

    if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.speedRound) {
      _queueAutoAdvance(const Duration(milliseconds: 700));
    } else if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) {
      _queueAutoAdvance(const Duration(milliseconds: 950));
    }
  }

  void nextQuestion() {
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    final nextIndex = state.currentIndex + 1;

    if (nextIndex >= state.questions.length) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true);
      return;
    }

    final q = state.questions[nextIndex];
    state = state.copyWith(
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(state.filter, q),
      clearLastResult: true,
    );
    _startTimer();
  }

  void skip() {
    if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) return;
    nextQuestion();
  }

  void reset() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    state = _sessionInitial(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  void _queueAutoAdvance(Duration delay) {
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer = Timer(delay, () {
      if (!state.isComplete && state.lastResult != null) {
        nextQuestion();
      }
    });
  }

  void _startTimer() {
    _timer?.cancel();

    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null) return;

    final total = _resolveTime(state.filter, q);
    if (total <= 0) return;

    state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: total);

    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (state.secondsRemaining <= 1) {
        timer.cancel();

        if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) {
          submit(state.currentQuestion?.correctIndex ?? 0);
          return;
        }

        nextQuestion();
        return;
      }

      state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: state.secondsRemaining - 1);
    });
  }

  int _wrongAnswersCount(Map<String, PracticeAnswerResult> answers) {
    return answers.values.where((x) => !x.isCorrect).length;
  }

  int _resolveTime(PracticeFilter filter, PracticeQuestion? q) {
    final raw = filter.useAiTiming
        ? (q?.recommendedTimeSeconds ?? 20)
        : (filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? 20);

    final adjusted = switch (filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => raw - 6,
      PracticeMode.speedRound => raw - 10,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => raw + 15,
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => raw + 10,
      PracticeMode.adaptive => raw,
      PracticeMode.practice => raw,
    };

    return adjusted < 8 ? 8 : adjusted;
  }

  int _xpFor(PracticeQuestion q, PracticeFilter filter) {
    final base = switch (q.difficulty) {
      PracticeDifficulty.easy => 8,
      PracticeDifficulty.medium => 10,
      PracticeDifficulty.hard => 14,
      PracticeDifficulty.olympiad => 20,
      PracticeDifficulty.adaptive => 10,

class PracticeSessionController extends Notifier<PracticeSessionState> {
  final PracticeGenerator _generator = PracticeGenerator();
  Timer? _timer;
  bool _isLoading = false;

  bool get isLoading => _isLoading;

  @override
  PracticeSessionState build() {
    ref.onDispose(() {
      _timer?.cancel();
    });
    final filter = ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);
    return _sessionInitial(filter);
  }

  void selectOnlyFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    ref.read(practiceFilterProvider.notifier).setFilter(next);
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = _sessionInitial(next);
  }

  Future<void> start([PracticeFilter? override]) async {
    final PracticeFilter filter = override ?? ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);

    _isLoading = true;
    ref.notifyListeners();
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = _sessionInitial(filter);

    try {
      final questions = await _generator.generate(filter);
      final firstQuestion = questions.isEmpty ? null : questions.first;

      state = state.copyWith(
        filter: filter,
        questions: questions,
        currentIndex: 0,
        secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(filter, firstQuestion),
        isComplete: questions.isEmpty,
        stats: _statsZero(),
      );

      if (questions.isNotEmpty) {
        _startTimer();
      }
    } finally {
      _isLoading = false;
      ref.notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  void submit(int answerIndex) {
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null || state.isComplete) {
      return;
    }

    final isCorrect = answerIndex == q.correctIndex;
    final timeTaken = 0;

    state = state.copyWith(
      answersByQuestionId: {
        ...state.answersByQuestionId,
        q.id: PracticeAnswerResult(
          selectedIndex: answerIndex,
          isCorrect: isCorrect,
          timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
        ),
      },
      stats: state.stats.copyWith(
        answered: state.stats.answered + 1,
        correct: state.stats.correct + (isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
        streak: isCorrect ? state.stats.streak + 1 : 0,
        xp: state.stats.xp + (isCorrect ? _xpFor(q) : 0),
      ),
      lastResult: PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: answerIndex,
        isCorrect: isCorrect,
        timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
      ),
    );
  }

  void nextQuestion() {
    final nextIndex = state.currentIndex + 1;

    if (nextIndex >= state.questions.length) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true);
      return;
    }

    final q = state.questions[nextIndex];
    state = state.copyWith(
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(state.filter, q),
      clearLastResult: true,
    );
    _startTimer();
  }

  void skip() {
    nextQuestion();
  }

  void reset() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = _sessionInitial(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  void _startTimer() {
    _timer?.cancel();

    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null) {
      return;
    }

    final total = _resolveTime(state.filter, q);
    if (total <= 0) {
      return;
    }

    state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: total);

    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (state.secondsRemaining <= 1) {
        timer.cancel();
        nextQuestion();
        return;
      }

      state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: state.secondsRemaining - 1);
    });
  }

  int _resolveTime(PracticeFilter filter, dynamic q) {
    if (!filter.useAiTiming) {
      return filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? 20;
    }

    if (q == null) {
      return 20;
    }

    try {
      final recommended = q.recommendedTimeSeconds as int?;
      if (recommended != null && recommended > 0) {
        return recommended;
      }
    } catch (_) {
      return switch (filter.difficulty) {
        PracticeDifficulty.easy => 20,
        PracticeDifficulty.medium => 30,
        PracticeDifficulty.hard => 45,
        PracticeDifficulty.olympiad => 60,
        PracticeDifficulty.adaptive => 30,
      };
    }

    return switch (filter.difficulty) {
      PracticeDifficulty.easy => 20,
      PracticeDifficulty.medium => 30,
      PracticeDifficulty.hard => 45,
      PracticeDifficulty.olympiad => 60,
      PracticeDifficulty.adaptive => 30,
    };
  }

  int _xpFor(dynamic q) {
    return switch (q.difficulty) {
      PracticeDifficulty.easy => 8,
      PracticeDifficulty.medium => 10,
      PracticeDifficulty.hard => 14,
      PracticeDifficulty.olympiad => 20,
      PracticeDifficulty.adaptive => 10,
      _ => 10,
    };
  }
}

  }

  void submit(int answerIndex) {
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null || state.isComplete) return;
    if (state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(q.id)) return;

    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();

    final isCorrect = answerIndex == q.correctIndex;
    final timeTaken = 0;

    final nextAnswers = {
      ...state.answersByQuestionId,
      q.id: PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: answerIndex,
        isCorrect: isCorrect,
        timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
      ),
    };

    final wrongCount = _wrongAnswersCount(nextAnswers);
    final outOfHearts = wrongCount >= 3;

    state = state.copyWith(
      answersByQuestionId: nextAnswers,
      stats: state.stats.copyWith(
        answered: state.stats.answered + 1,
        correct: state.stats.correct + (isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
        streak: isCorrect ? state.stats.streak + 1 : 0,
        xp: state.stats.xp + (isCorrect ? _xpFor(q, state.filter) : 0),
      ),
      lastResult: PracticeAnswerResult(
        selectedIndex: answerIndex,
        isCorrect: isCorrect,
        timeTakenSeconds: timeTaken,
      ),
      isComplete: outOfHearts,
    );

    if (outOfHearts) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
      return;
    }

    if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.speedRound) {
      _queueAutoAdvance(const Duration(milliseconds: 850));
    } else if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) {
      _queueAutoAdvance(const Duration(milliseconds: 1100));
    }
  }

  void nextQuestion() {
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    final nextIndex = state.currentIndex + 1;

    if (nextIndex >= state.questions.length) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true);
      return;
    }

    final q = state.questions[nextIndex];
    state = state.copyWith(
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(state.filter, q),
      clearLastResult: true,
    );
    _startTimer();
  }

  void skip() {
    if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) return;
    nextQuestion();
  }

  void reset() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    state = _sessionInitial(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  void _queueAutoAdvance(Duration delay) {
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer = Timer(delay, () {
      if (!state.isComplete) {
        nextQuestion();
      }
    });
  }

  void _startTimer() {
    _timer?.cancel();

    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null) return;

    final total = _resolveTime(state.filter, q);
    if (total <= 0) return;

    state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: total);

    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (state.secondsRemaining <= 1) {
        timer.cancel();

        if (state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) {
          submit(state.currentQuestion?.correctIndex ?? 0);
          return;
        }

        nextQuestion();
        return;
      }

      state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: state.secondsRemaining - 1);
    });
  }

  int _wrongAnswersCount(Map<String, PracticeAnswerResult> answers) {
    return answers.values.where((x) => !x.isCorrect).length;
  }

  int _resolveTime(PracticeFilter filter, PracticeQuestion? q) {
    if (!filter.useAiTiming) {
      final manual = filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? 20;
      return _modeAdjustedTime(filter.mode, manual);
    }

    final recommended = q?.recommendedTimeSeconds ?? 20;
    return _modeAdjustedTime(filter.mode, recommended);
  }

  int _modeAdjustedTime(PracticeMode mode, int raw) {
    final adjusted = switch (mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards => raw - 5,
      PracticeMode.speedRound => raw - 10,
      PracticeMode.examPrep => raw + 15,
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder => raw + 10,
      PracticeMode.adaptive => raw,
      PracticeMode.practice => raw,
    };
    return adjusted < 8 ? 8 : adjusted;
  }

  int _xpFor(PracticeQuestion q, PracticeFilter filter) {

class PracticeSessionController extends StateNotifier<PracticeSessionState?> {
  PracticeSessionController() : super(null);

  void start(PracticeConfig config) {
    final questions = PracticeGenerator.generate(config);

    state = PracticeSessionState(
      config: config,
      questions: questions,
      currentIndex: 0,
      correct: 0,
      completed: false,
    );
  }

  void answer(int index) {
    final s = state;
    if (s == null) return;

    final q = s.questions[s.currentIndex];
    final isCorrect = index == q.correctIndex;

    final nextIndex = s.currentIndex + 1;

    state = s.copyWith(
      correct: isCorrect ? s.correct + 1 : s.correct,
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      completed: nextIndex >= s.questions.length,
    );
  }

  void reset() {
    state = null;
  }

class PracticeSessionController extends Notifier<PracticeSessionState> {
  Timer? _timer;

  PracticeGenerator get _generator => ref.read(practiceGeneratorProvider);

  @override
  PracticeSessionState build() {
    ref.onDispose(() {
      _timer?.cancel();
    });
    return PracticeSessionState.initial(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  Future<void> start([PracticeFilter? override]) async {
    _timer?.cancel();

    final resolvedFilter = (override ?? ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));

    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(resolvedFilter);

    final questions = await _generator.generate(resolvedFilter);
    final firstQuestion = questions.isEmpty ? null : questions.first;
    final seconds = _resolveTime(resolvedFilter, firstQuestion);

    state = state.copyWith(
      filter: resolvedFilter,
      questions: questions,
      currentIndex: 0,
      secondsRemaining: seconds,
      clearLastResult: true,
      answersByQuestionId: const <String, PracticeAnswerResult>{},
      stats: const PracticeStats(answered: 0, correct: 0, xp: 0, streak: 0),
      isComplete: questions.isEmpty,
    );

    if (questions.isNotEmpty) {
      _startTimerForCurrent();
    }
  }

  void updateFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    ref.read(practiceFilterProvider.notifier).setFilter(next);
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(next);
  }

  void selectOnlyFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    ref.read(practiceFilterProvider.notifier).setFilter(next);
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(next);
  }

  void submit(int selectedIndex) {
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null || state.isComplete) {
      return;
    }
    if (state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(q.id)) {
      return;
    }

    final recommended = q.recommendedTimeSeconds <= 0
        ? _resolveTime(state.filter, q)
        : q.recommendedTimeSeconds;

    final taken = recommended <= 0
        ? 0
        : (recommended - state.secondsRemaining).clamp(0, 9999);

    final result = PracticeAnswerResult(
      selectedIndex: selectedIndex,
      isCorrect: selectedIndex == q.correctIndex,
      timeTakenSeconds: taken,
    );

    final answers = <String, PracticeAnswerResult>{
      ...state.answersByQuestionId,
      q.id: result,
    };

    final gainedXp = result.isCorrect ? _xpFor(q) : 2;

    final nextStats = state.stats.copyWith(
      answered: state.stats.answered + 1,
      correct: state.stats.correct + (result.isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
      xp: state.stats.xp + gainedXp,
      streak: result.isCorrect ? state.stats.streak + 1 : 0,
    );

    _timer?.cancel();

    state = state.copyWith(
      answersByQuestionId: answers,
      stats: nextStats,
      lastResult: result,
    );
  }

  void nextQuestion() {
    if (state.isComplete) {
      return;
    }

    final nextIndex = state.currentIndex + 1;
    if (nextIndex >= state.questions.length) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true, clearLastResult: false);
      return;
    }

    final nextQuestion = state.questions[nextIndex];

    state = state.copyWith(
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(state.filter, nextQuestion),
      clearLastResult: true,
    );

    _startTimerForCurrent();
  }

  void skip() {
    submit(-1);
    nextQuestion();
  }

  void reset() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  void _startTimerForCurrent() {
    _timer?.cancel();

    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null) {
      return;
    }

    final total = _resolveTime(state.filter, q);
    if (total <= 0) {
      return;
    }

    state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: total);

    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (state.secondsRemaining <= 1) {
        timer.cancel();
        final current = state.currentQuestion;
        if (current != null &&
            !state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(current.id)) {
          submit(-1);
        }
        return;
      }

      state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: state.secondsRemaining - 1);
    });
  }

  int _resolveTime(PracticeFilter filter, PracticeQuestion? q) {
    if (filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) {
      return 0;
    }
    if (!filter.useAiTiming && filter.timePreferenceSeconds != null) {
      return filter.timePreferenceSeconds!;
    }
    return q?.recommendedTimeSeconds ?? 15;
  }

  int _xpFor(PracticeQuestion q) {
    switch (q.difficulty) {
      case PracticeDifficulty.easy:
        return 8;
      case PracticeDifficulty.medium:
        return 10;
      case PracticeDifficulty.hard:
        return 14;
      case PracticeDifficulty.olympiad:
        return 20;
      case PracticeDifficulty.adaptive:
        return 10;
    }
  }
}

      topicPath: topicPath ?? state.topicPath,
      questionCount: questionCount ?? state.questionCount,
      timePreferenceSeconds:
          timePreferenceSeconds ?? state.timePreferenceSeconds,
      useAiTiming: useAiTiming ?? state.useAiTiming,
    );
  }

  void reset() {
    state = _defaultFilter();
  }
}

final practiceSessionProvider =
    NotifierProvider<PracticeSessionController, PracticeSessionState>(
      PracticeSessionController.new,
    );

class PracticeSessionController extends Notifier<PracticeSessionState> {
  final PracticeGenerator _generator = PracticeGenerator();
  Timer? _timer;

  @override
  PracticeSessionState build() {
    ref.onDispose(() {
      _timer?.cancel();
    });
    return _initialSession(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  void selectOnlyFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    ref.read(practiceFilterProvider.notifier).setFilter(next);
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = _initialSession(next);
  }

  Future<void> start([PracticeFilter? override]) async {
    final PracticeFilter filter = (override ?? ref.read(practiceFilterProvider))!;

    _timer?.cancel();
    state = _initialSession(filter);

    final questions = await _generator.generate(filter);
    final firstQuestion = questions.isEmpty ? null : questions.first;

    state = state.copyWith(
      filter: filter,
      questions: questions,
      currentIndex: 0,
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(filter, firstQuestion),
      isComplete: questions.isEmpty,
      stats: _defaultStats(),
    );

    if (questions.isNotEmpty) {
      _startTimer();
    }
  }

  void submit(int answerIndex) {
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null || state.isComplete) return;

    final isCorrect = answerIndex == q.correctIndex;

    state = state.copyWith(
      stats: state.stats.copyWith(
        answered: state.stats.answered + 1,
        correct: state.stats.correct + (isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
        streak: isCorrect ? state.stats.streak + 1 : 0,
        xp: state.stats.xp + (isCorrect ? _xpFor(q) : 0),
      ),
    );
  }

  void nextQuestion() {
    final nextIndex = state.currentIndex + 1;
    if (nextIndex >= state.questions.length) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true);
      return;
    }

    final q = state.questions[nextIndex];
    state = state.copyWith(
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(state.filter, q),
      clearLastResult: true,
    );
    _startTimer();
  }

  void skip() {
    nextQuestion();
  }

  void reset() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = _initialSession(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider)!);
  }

  void _startTimer() {
    _timer?.cancel();

    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null) return;

    final total = _resolveTime(state.filter, q);
    if (total <= 0) return;

    state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: total);

    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (state.secondsRemaining <= 1) {
        timer.cancel();
        nextQuestion();
        return;
      }

      state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: state.secondsRemaining - 1);
    });
  }

  int _resolveTime(PracticeFilter filter, dynamic q) {
    if (filter.useAiTiming == false) {
      return filter.timePreferenceSeconds ?? 20;
    }

    if (q == null) {
      return 20;
    }

    try {
      final recommended = q.recommendedTimeSeconds as int?;
      if (recommended != null && recommended > 0) {
        return recommended;
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    switch (filter.difficulty) {
      case PracticeDifficulty.easy:
        return 20;
      case PracticeDifficulty.medium:
        return 30;
      case PracticeDifficulty.hard:
        return 45;
      case PracticeDifficulty.olympiad:
        return 60;
      case PracticeDifficulty.adaptive:
        return 30;
    }
  }

    if (q == null) return 20;

    try {
      final recommended = q.recommendedTimeSeconds as int?;
      if (recommended != null && recommended > 0) return recommended;
    } catch (_) {}

    switch (filter.difficulty) {
      case PracticeDifficulty.easy:
        return 20;
      case PracticeDifficulty.medium:
        return 30;
      case PracticeDifficulty.hard:
        return 45;
      case PracticeDifficulty.olympiad:
        return 60;
      case PracticeDifficulty.adaptive:
        return 30;
    }
  }

  int _xpFor(dynamic q) {
    switch (q.difficulty) {
      case PracticeDifficulty.easy:
        return 8;
      case PracticeDifficulty.medium:
        return 10;
      case PracticeDifficulty.hard:
        return 14;
      case PracticeDifficulty.olympiad:
        return 20;
      case PracticeDifficulty.adaptive:
        return 10;
    }
  }
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

import '../data/practice_generator.dart';
import '../domain/practice_models.dart';

final practiceGeneratorProvider = Provider<PracticeGenerator>((ref) {
  return PracticeGenerator();
});

final practiceFilterProvider =
    NotifierProvider<PracticeFilterController, PracticeFilter>(
      PracticeFilterController.new,
    );

final practiceSessionProvider =
    NotifierProvider<PracticeSessionController, PracticeSessionState>(
      PracticeSessionController.new,
    );

class PracticeFilterController extends Notifier<PracticeFilter> {
  @override
  PracticeFilter build() => PracticeFilter.defaults;

  void setFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    state = next;
  }

  void patch({
    String? subject,
    String? topic,
    PracticeMode? mode,
    PracticeDifficulty? difficulty,
    bool? useAiTiming,
    int? timePreferenceSeconds,
    bool clearTimePreference = false,
  }) {
    state = state.copyWith(
      subject: subject,
      topic: topic,
      mode: mode,
      difficulty: difficulty,
      useAiTiming: useAiTiming,
      timePreferenceSeconds: clearTimePreference
          ? null
          : (timePreferenceSeconds ?? state.timePreferenceSeconds),
    );
  }

  void reset() {
    state = PracticeFilter.defaults;
  }
}

class PracticeSessionController extends Notifier<PracticeSessionState> {
  Timer? _timer;

  PracticeGenerator get _generator => ref.read(practiceGeneratorProvider);

  @override
  PracticeSessionState build() {
    ref.onDispose(() {
      _timer?.cancel();
    });
    final filter = ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);
    return PracticeSessionState.initial(filter);
  }

  Future<void> start([PracticeFilter? override]) async {
    _timer?.cancel();

    final filter = override ?? ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);

    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(filter);

    final questions = await _generator.generate(filter);
    final firstQuestion = questions.isEmpty ? null : questions.first;
    final seconds = _resolveTime(filter, firstQuestion);

    state = state.copyWith(
      filter: filter,
      questions: questions,
      currentIndex: 0,
      secondsRemaining: seconds,
      clearLastResult: true,
      answersByQuestionId: const <String, PracticeAnswerResult>{},
      stats: const PracticeStats(answered: 0, correct: 0, xp: 0, streak: 0),
      isComplete: questions.isEmpty,
    );

    if (questions.isNotEmpty) {
      _startTimerForCurrent();
    }
  }

  void updateFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    ref.read(practiceFilterProvider.notifier).setFilter(next);
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(next);
  }

  void selectOnlyFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    ref.read(practiceFilterProvider.notifier).setFilter(next);
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(next);
  }

  void submit(int selectedIndex) {
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null || state.isComplete) {
      return;
    }
    if (state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(q.id)) {
      return;
    }

    final recommended = q.recommendedTimeSeconds <= 0
        ? _resolveTime(state.filter, q)
        : q.recommendedTimeSeconds;

    final taken = recommended <= 0
        ? 0
        : (recommended - state.secondsRemaining).clamp(0, 9999);

    final result = PracticeAnswerResult(
      selectedIndex: selectedIndex,
      isCorrect: selectedIndex == q.correctIndex,
      timeTakenSeconds: taken,
    );

    final answers = <String, PracticeAnswerResult>{
      ...state.answersByQuestionId,
      q.id: result,
    };

    final gainedXp = result.isCorrect ? _xpFor(q) : 2;

    final nextStats = state.stats.copyWith(
      answered: state.stats.answered + 1,
      correct: state.stats.correct + (result.isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
      xp: state.stats.xp + gainedXp,
      streak: result.isCorrect ? state.stats.streak + 1 : 0,
    );

    _timer?.cancel();

    state = state.copyWith(
      answersByQuestionId: answers,
      stats: nextStats,
      lastResult: result,
    );
  }

  void nextQuestion() {
    if (state.isComplete) {
      return;
    }

    final nextIndex = state.currentIndex + 1;
    if (nextIndex >= state.questions.length) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true, clearLastResult: false);
      return;
    }

    final nextQuestion = state.questions[nextIndex];

    state = state.copyWith(
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(state.filter, nextQuestion),
      clearLastResult: true,
    );

    _startTimerForCurrent();
  }

  void skip() {
    submit(-1);
    nextQuestion();
  }

  void reset() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    final filter = ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(filter);
  }

  void _startTimerForCurrent() {
    _timer?.cancel();

    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null) {
      return;
    }

    final total = _resolveTime(state.filter, q);
    if (total <= 0) {
      return;
    }

    state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: total);

    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (state.secondsRemaining <= 1) {
        timer.cancel();
        final current = state.currentQuestion;
        if (current != null &&
            !state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(current.id)) {
          submit(-1);
        }
        return;
      }

      state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: state.secondsRemaining - 1);
    });
  }

  int _resolveTime(PracticeFilter filter, PracticeQuestion? q) {
    if (filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) {
      return 0;
    }
    if (!filter.useAiTiming && filter.timePreferenceSeconds != null) {
      return filter.timePreferenceSeconds!;
    }
    return q?.recommendedTimeSeconds ?? 15;
  }

  int _xpFor(PracticeQuestion q) {
    switch (q.difficulty) {
      case PracticeDifficulty.easy:
        return 8;
      case PracticeDifficulty.medium:
        return 10;
      case PracticeDifficulty.hard:
        return 14;
      case PracticeDifficulty.olympiad:
        return 20;
      case PracticeDifficulty.adaptive:
        return 10;
    }
  }
}

    final seconds = _resolveTime(resolvedFilter, firstQuestion);

    state = state.copyWith(
      filter: resolvedFilter,
      questions: questions,
      currentIndex: 0,
      secondsRemaining: seconds,
      clearLastResult: true,
      answersByQuestionId: const <String, PracticeAnswerResult>{},
      stats: const PracticeStats(answered: 0, correct: 0, xp: 0, streak: 0),
      isComplete: questions.isEmpty,
    );

    if (questions.isNotEmpty) {
      _startTimerForCurrent();
    }
  }

  void updateFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    ref.read(practiceFilterProvider.notifier).setFilter(next);
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(next);
  }

  void selectOnlyFilter(PracticeFilter next) {
    ref.read(practiceFilterProvider.notifier).setFilter(next);
    _timer?.cancel();
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(next);
  }

  void submit(int selectedIndex) {
    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null || state.isComplete) {
      return;
    }
    if (state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(q.id)) {
      return;
    }

    final recommended = q.recommendedTimeSeconds <= 0
        ? _resolveTime(state.filter, q)
        : q.recommendedTimeSeconds;

    final taken = recommended <= 0
        ? 0
        : (recommended - state.secondsRemaining).clamp(0, 9999);

    final result = PracticeAnswerResult(
      selectedIndex: selectedIndex,
      isCorrect: selectedIndex == q.correctIndex,
      timeTakenSeconds: taken,
    );

    final answers = <String, PracticeAnswerResult>{
      ...state.answersByQuestionId,
      q.id: result,
    };

    final gainedXp = result.isCorrect ? _xpFor(q) : 2;

    final nextStats = state.stats.copyWith(
      answered: state.stats.answered + 1,
      correct: state.stats.correct + (result.isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
      xp: state.stats.xp + gainedXp,
      streak: result.isCorrect ? state.stats.streak + 1 : 0,
    );

    _timer?.cancel();

    state = state.copyWith(
      answersByQuestionId: answers,
      stats: nextStats,
      lastResult: result,
    );
  }

  void nextQuestion() {
    if (state.isComplete) {
      return;
    }

    final nextIndex = state.currentIndex + 1;
    if (nextIndex >= state.questions.length) {
      _timer?.cancel();
      state = state.copyWith(isComplete: true, clearLastResult: false);
      return;
    }

    final nextQuestion = state.questions[nextIndex];

    state = state.copyWith(
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      secondsRemaining: _resolveTime(state.filter, nextQuestion),
      clearLastResult: true,
    );

    _startTimerForCurrent();
  }

  void skip() {
    submit(-1);
    nextQuestion();
  }

  void reset() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    final filter = ref.read(practiceFilterProvider);
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(filter);
  }

  void _startTimerForCurrent() {
    _timer?.cancel();

    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    if (q == null) {
      return;
    }

    final total = _resolveTime(state.filter, q);
    if (total <= 0) {
      return;
    }

    state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: total);

    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (state.secondsRemaining <= 1) {
        timer.cancel();
        final current = state.currentQuestion;
        if (current != null &&
            !state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(current.id)) {
          submit(-1);
        }
        return;
      }

      state = state.copyWith(secondsRemaining: state.secondsRemaining - 1);
    });
  }

  int _resolveTime(PracticeFilter filter, PracticeQuestion? q) {
    if (filter.mode == PracticeMode.flashcards) {
      return 0;
    }
    if (!filter.useAiTiming && filter.timePreferenceSeconds != null) {
      return filter.timePreferenceSeconds!;
    }
    return q?.recommendedTimeSeconds ?? 15;
  }

  int _xpFor(PracticeQuestion q) {
    switch (q.difficulty) {
      case PracticeDifficulty.easy:
        return 8;
      case PracticeDifficulty.medium:
        return 10;
      case PracticeDifficulty.hard:
        return 14;
      case PracticeDifficulty.olympiad:
        return 20;
      case PracticeDifficulty.adaptive:
        return 10;
    }
  }

    if (q == null || state.isComplete) {
      return;
    }
    if (state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(q.id)) {
      return;
    }

    final recommended = q.recommendedTimeSeconds <= 0
        ? _resolveTime(state.filter, q)
        : q.recommendedTimeSeconds;

    final taken = recommended <= 0
        ? 0
        : (recommended - state.secondsRemaining).clamp(0, 9999);

    final result = PracticeAnswerResult(
      selectedIndex: selectedIndex,
      isCorrect: selectedIndex == q.correctIndex,

      q.id: result,

      xp: state.stats.xp + gainedXp,

    submit(-1);
    nextQuestion();

class PracticeSessionController extends Notifier<PracticeSessionState> {
  Future<void> cancelGeneration() async {
    _generationEpoch++;
    _timer?.cancel();
    _autoAdvanceTimer?.cancel();
    ref.read(practiceSessionLoadingProvider.notifier).setLoading(false);
    state = PracticeSessionState.initial(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));
  }

  final PracticeHistoryRepository _historyRepo = PracticeHistoryRepository();
  int _generationEpoch = 0;
