import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

import '../providers/practice_providers.dart';
import 'practice_setup_screen.dart';

class PracticeSessionScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const PracticeSessionScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<PracticeSessionScreen> createState() =>
      _PracticeSessionScreenState();
}

class _PracticeSessionScreenState extends ConsumerState<PracticeSessionScreen> {
  int? _selectedIndex;
  bool _showExplanation = false;

  String _promptOf(dynamic q) {
    final v1 = q.prompt;
    if (v1 is String && v1.trim().isNotEmpty) return v1.trim();
    final v2 = q.question;
    if (v2 is String && v2.trim().isNotEmpty) return v2.trim();
    return 'Question';
  }

  String _explanationOf(dynamic q) {
    final v = q.explanation;
    if (v is String && v.trim().isNotEmpty) return v.trim();
    return 'No explanation available yet.';
  }

  List<String> _optionsOf(dynamic q) {
    final raw = q.options ?? q.choices ?? const [];
    if (raw is List) {
      return raw.map((e) => e.toString()).toList(growable: false);
    }
    return const <String>[];
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = ref.watch(practiceSessionProvider);
    final sessionCtl = ref.read(practiceSessionProvider.notifier);
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final cs = theme.colorScheme;

    if (state.questions.isEmpty && !state.isComplete) {
      return Scaffold(
        body: SafeArea(
          child: Center(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(22),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: cs.surfaceContainerLow.withValues(alpha: 0.92),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(28),
                  border: Border.all(
                    color: cs.outlineVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.35),
                  ),
                ),
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    Icon(Icons.bolt_rounded, size: 44, color: cs.primary),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    Text(
                      'Preparing your practice...',
                      style: theme.textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
                    const CircularProgressIndicator(),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

class _PracticeSessionScreenState extends ConsumerState<PracticeSessionScreen> {
  int? _selectedIndex;

      ((q?.prompt ?? q?.question ?? 'Question').toString());

  String _explanationOf(dynamic q) {
    final txt = (q?.explanation ?? '').toString().trim();
    return txt.isEmpty ? 'No explanation available yet.' : txt;
  }

  List<String> _optionsOf(dynamic q) {
    final raw = q?.options ?? q?.choices ?? const [];
    if (raw is List) {
      return raw.map((e) => e.toString()).toList(growable: false);
    }
    return const <String>[];
  }

  Future<void> _openNova(BuildContext context, dynamic q, dynamic state) async {

    final isSaved = savedCtl.isSaved(q.id);

        '''
You are helping with a ClassMate practice question.

Subject: ${state.filter.subject}
Topic: ${state.filter.topicPath.isEmpty ? 'General' : state.filter.topicPath.join(' • ')}
Mode: ${state.filter.mode.name}
Difficulty: ${state.filter.difficulty.name}

Solve this question step by step.
Explain why the correct answer is correct.
Also explain why the wrong options are wrong.
Keep the explanation aligned to the user's current level and the selected topic.

Question:
${_promptOf(q)}

Options:
${options.asMap().entries.map((e) => "${String.fromCharCode(65 + e.key)}. ${e.value}").join("
")}

Reference explanation:

    context.push(
      '/tutor?subject=${Uri.encodeComponent(state.filter.subject)}'
      '&title=${Uri.encodeComponent((q.topicLabel).toString())}'
      '&prompt=${Uri.encodeComponent(prompt)}',
    );
  }

  bool _modeShowsExplanationFirst(PracticeMode mode) {
    return mode == PracticeMode.flashcards ||
        mode == PracticeMode.conceptBuilder;
  }

  String _primaryButtonLabel(PracticeMode mode, bool hasResult) {
    if (hasResult) return 'Next';
    switch (mode) {
      case PracticeMode.flashcards:
        return 'Reveal answer';
      case PracticeMode.speedRound:
        return 'Lock in';
      case PracticeMode.examPrep:
        return 'Submit exam answer';
      case PracticeMode.conceptBuilder:
        return 'Check concept';
      case PracticeMode.adaptive:
        return 'Submit adaptive answer';
      case PracticeMode.practice:
        return 'Submit';
    }
  }

  String _modeBanner(PracticeMode mode) {
    switch (mode) {
      case PracticeMode.flashcards:

        return 'Speed round · short timer, fast grading, auto-advance.';

class PracticeSessionScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const PracticeSessionScreen({super.key});

  ConsumerState<PracticeSessionScreen> createState() =>
      _PracticeSessionScreenState();
}

class _PracticeSessionScreenState extends ConsumerState<PracticeSessionScreen> {
  int? _selectedIndex;
  bool _showExplanation = false;
  String? _boundQuestionId;

  String _promptOf(dynamic q) =>
      ((q?.prompt ?? q?.question ?? 'Question').toString());

  String _explanationOf(dynamic q) {
    final txt = (q?.explanation ?? '').toString().trim();
    return txt.isEmpty ? 'No explanation available yet.' : txt;
  }

  List<String> _optionsOf(dynamic q) {
    final raw = q?.options ?? q?.choices ?? const [];
    if (raw is List) {
      return raw.map((e) => e.toString()).toList(growable: false);
    }
    return const <String>[];
  }

  Future<void> _openNova(BuildContext context, dynamic q, dynamic state) async {
    final options = _optionsOf(q);
    final prompt =
        '''
You are helping with a ClassMate practice question.

Subject: ${state.filter.subject}
Topic: ${state.filter.topicPath.isEmpty ? 'General' : state.filter.topicPath.join(' • ')}
Mode: ${state.filter.mode.name}
Difficulty: ${state.filter.difficulty.name}

Solve this practice question step by step.
Explain why the correct answer is correct.
Also explain why the wrong options are wrong.

Question:
${_promptOf(q)}

Options:
${options.asMap().entries.map((e) => "${String.fromCharCode(65 + e.key)}. ${e.value}").join("\n")}

Reference explanation:
${_explanationOf(q)}
''';
    await Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (_) => NovaChatScreen(
          initialTitle: (q.topicLabel).toString(),
          initialPrompt: prompt,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = ref.watch(practiceSessionProvider);
    final sessionCtl = ref.read(practiceSessionProvider.notifier);
    final theme = Theme.of(context);

    if (state.questions.isEmpty && !state.isComplete) {
      return const SafeArea(child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()));

class _PracticeSessionScreenState extends ConsumerState<PracticeSessionScreen> {
  int? _selectedIndex;
  bool _showExplanation = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    ref.listen(practiceSessionProvider, (previous, next) {
      if (previous?.currentIndex != next.currentIndex ||
          previous?.isComplete != next.isComplete) {
        setState(() {
          _selectedIndex = null;
          _showExplanation = false;
        });
      }
    });

    final state = ref.watch(practiceSessionProvider);
    final controller = ref.read(practiceSessionProvider.notifier);

    final q = state.currentQuestion;

      return const Scaffold(body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()));

      return Scaffold(

        body: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 32),
          children: [

              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(28),

                  begin: Alignment.topLeft,

                    cs.surfaceContainerHigh.withValues(alpha: 0.96),
                  ],
                ),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: cs.outlineVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.35),
                ),
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    'Great session',
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall?.copyWith(

                  ),

                ],
              ),
            ),

              ),

          ],

      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('NOVA Practice'),

          Center(

      ? 'No explanation available yet.'
      : q.explanation;
  List<String> _optionsOf(PracticeQuestion q) => q.options;

  int _wrongCount(PracticeSessionState state) =>
      state.answersByQuestionId.values.where((x) => !x.isCorrect).length;

  bool _modeShowsExplanationFirst(PracticeMode mode) =>
      mode == PracticeMode.flashcards || mode == PracticeMode.conceptBuilder;

  String _modeBanner(PracticeMode mode) {
    switch (mode) {
      case PracticeMode.practice:
        return 'Practice · balanced question flow.';
      case PracticeMode.flashcards:
        return 'Flashcards · memory first, then reveal.';
      case PracticeMode.speedRound:
        return 'Speed round · quick timer and auto-advance.';
      case PracticeMode.examPrep:
        return 'Exam prep · longer, test-style rhythm.';
      case PracticeMode.conceptBuilder:
        return 'Concept builder · explanation-first learning.';
      case PracticeMode.adaptive:
        return 'Adaptive · mixed pace and challenge.';
    }
  }

  String _primaryButtonLabel(PracticeMode mode, bool hasResult) {
    if (hasResult) return 'Next';
    switch (mode) {
      case PracticeMode.flashcards:
        return 'Reveal answer';
      case PracticeMode.speedRound:
        return 'Lock in';
      case PracticeMode.examPrep:
        return 'Submit exam answer';
      case PracticeMode.conceptBuilder:
        return 'Check concept';
      case PracticeMode.adaptive:
        return 'Submit adaptive answer';
      case PracticeMode.practice:
        return 'Submit';
    }
  }

  ) async {
    final optionsText = q.options

        '''
You are helping with a ClassMate practice question.

Subject: ${state.filter.subject}
Topic: ${state.filter.topicPath.isEmpty ? 'General' : state.filter.topicPath.join(' • ')}

Difficulty: ${state.filter.difficulty.name}

Reference explanation:
${_explanationOf(q)}

    if (!context.mounted) return;
    context.push(
      '/tutor?subject=${Uri.encodeComponent(state.filter.subject)}'
      '&title=${Uri.encodeComponent(q.topicLabel)}'
      '&prompt=${Uri.encodeComponent(prompt)}',
    );
  }

  int? _selectedIndex;
  bool _showExplanation = false;
  String? _boundQuestionId;

  String _promptOf(dynamic q) =>
      ((q?.prompt ?? q?.question ?? 'Question').toString());

  String _explanationOf(dynamic q) {
    final txt = (q?.explanation ?? '').toString().trim();
    return txt.isEmpty ? 'No explanation available yet.' : txt;
  }

  List<String> _optionsOf(dynamic q) {
    final raw = q?.options ?? q?.choices ?? const [];
    if (raw is List) {
      return raw.map((e) => e.toString()).toList(growable: false);
    }
    return const <String>[];
  }

  Future<void> _openNova(BuildContext context, dynamic q, dynamic state) async {
    final options = _optionsOf(q);

Difficulty: ${state.filter.difficulty.name}

Solve this practice question step by step.
Explain why the correct answer is correct.
Also explain why the wrong options are wrong.

Question:
${_promptOf(q)}

Options:
${options.asMap().entries.map((e) => "${String.fromCharCode(65 + e.key)}. ${e.value}").join("\n")}

Reference explanation:
${_explanationOf(q)}
''';

      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (_) => NovaChatScreen(
          initialTitle: (q.topicLabel).toString(),
          initialPrompt: prompt,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

class PracticeSessionScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {

  @override
  ConsumerState<PracticeSessionScreen> createState() =>

class _PracticeSessionScreenState extends ConsumerState<PracticeSessionScreen> {
  int? _selectedIndex;
  bool _showExplanation = false;
  bool _flashcardRevealed = false;
  String? _boundQuestionId;
  Timer? _autoNextTimer;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _autoNextTimer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String _promptOf(PracticeQuestion? q) => q?.prompt ?? 'Question';

  String _explanationOf(PracticeQuestion? q) {
    final txt = (q?.explanation ?? '').trim();
    return txt.isEmpty ? 'No explanation available yet.' : txt;
  }

  List<String> _optionsOf(PracticeQuestion? q) =>
      q?.options ?? const <String>[];

  bool _isAnswered(PracticeSessionState state, PracticeQuestion? q) {
    if (q == null) return false;
    return state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(q.id);
  }

  String _modeHeadline(PracticeMode mode) {
    switch (mode) {
      case PracticeMode.practice:
        return 'Balanced practice';
      case PracticeMode.flashcards:
        return 'Recall first';
      case PracticeMode.speedRound:
        return 'Speed pressure';
      case PracticeMode.examPrep:
        return 'Formal exam feel';
      case PracticeMode.conceptBuilder:
        return 'Learn the idea';
      case PracticeMode.adaptive:
        return 'Adaptive session';
      case PracticeMode.bagrut:
        return 'Bagrut-style solving';
    }
  }

  String _modeHint(PracticeMode mode) {
    switch (mode) {
      case PracticeMode.practice:
        return 'Solve normally, then review the explanation.';
      case PracticeMode.flashcards:
        return 'Think first, reveal second, then rate your recall.';
      case PracticeMode.speedRound:
        return 'Tap fast. Your answer locks in immediately.';
      case PracticeMode.examPrep:
        return 'Treat this like a timed school exam question.';
      case PracticeMode.conceptBuilder:
        return 'Read the concept guidance first, then answer.';
      case PracticeMode.adaptive:
        return 'The pace and challenge can shift as the session moves.';
      case PracticeMode.bagrut:
        return 'Use NOVA to solve like a real written exam response.';
    }
  }

  String _buildNovaPrompt(PracticeSessionState state, PracticeQuestion? q) {
    final options = _optionsOf(q);
    final topic = state.filter.topicPath.isEmpty
        ? 'General'
        : state.filter.topicPath.join(' • ');
    final optionsBlock = options.isEmpty
        ? ''
        : '\nOptions:\n${options.asMap().entries.map((e) => '${String.fromCharCode(65 + e.key)}. ${e.value}').join('\n')}';

    final modeBlock = switch (state.filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards =>
        'This is FLASHCARDS mode. Help the student recall the fact, then explain it simply.',
      PracticeMode.speedRound =>
        'This is SPEED ROUND mode. Give a direct, quick explanation, then the fastest way to recognize the answer next time.',
      PracticeMode.examPrep =>
        'This is EXAM PREP mode. Solve carefully, justify the final answer, and mention common traps.',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder =>
        'This is CONCEPT BUILDER mode. Teach the concept first, then connect it to the exact question.',
      PracticeMode.adaptive =>
        'This is ADAPTIVE mode. Judge the level of the question and respond at the right difficulty.',
      PracticeMode.bagrut =>
        'This is BAGRUT mode. Treat it like a real bagrut question. Write a clean, step-by-step model solution in exam style. If it is open-ended, answer like a student submission.',
      PracticeMode.practice =>
        'This is regular practice mode. Solve step by step and explain the answer clearly.',
    };

    return '''
You are helping inside ClassMate.

Subject: ${state.filter.subject}
Topic: $topic
Mode: ${state.filter.mode.name}
Difficulty: ${state.filter.difficulty.name}

$modeBlock

Question:
${_promptOf(q)}$optionsBlock

Reference explanation:
${_explanationOf(q)}

Also explain why the correct answer is correct.
If there are wrong options, explain why they are wrong too.
''';
  }

  Future<void> _openNova(
    BuildContext context,
    PracticeSessionState state,
    PracticeQuestion? q,
  ) async {
    final prompt = _buildNovaPrompt(state, q);
    final title = state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut
        ? 'Bagrut solver'
        : ((q?.topicLabel ?? 'Practice explain').trim().isEmpty
              ? 'Practice explain'
              : q!.topicLabel);

    await Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (_) =>
            NovaChatScreen(initialTitle: title, initialPrompt: prompt),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _bindQuestion(PracticeQuestion? q) {
    final currentQuestionId = q?.id.toString();
    if (currentQuestionId != null && _boundQuestionId != currentQuestionId) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (!mounted) return;
        setState(() {
          _boundQuestionId = currentQuestionId;
          _selectedIndex = null;
          _showExplanation = false;
          _flashcardRevealed = false;
        });
      });
    }
  }

  void _queueNext(PracticeSessionController sessionCtl) {
    _autoNextTimer?.cancel();
    _autoNextTimer = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 550), () {
      if (!mounted) return;
      sessionCtl.nextQuestion();
      setState(() {
        _selectedIndex = null;
        _showExplanation = false;
        _flashcardRevealed = false;
      });
    });
  }

  void _submitFlashcard(
    PracticeSessionController sessionCtl,
    PracticeQuestion q, {
    required bool knewIt,
  }) {
    final wrongIndex = q.options.isEmpty
        ? 0
        : (q.correctIndex + 1) % q.options.length;
    sessionCtl.submit(knewIt ? q.correctIndex : wrongIndex);
    setState(() {
      _showExplanation = true;
    });
  }

          _showExplanation = false;

class PracticeSessionScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const PracticeSessionScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<PracticeSessionScreen> createState() =>
      _PracticeSessionScreenState();

class _PracticeSessionScreenState extends ConsumerState<PracticeSessionScreen> {
  int? _selectedIndex;
  bool _showExplanation = false;
  bool _flashcardRevealed = false;
  String? _boundQuestionId;
  Timer? _autoNextTimer;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _autoNextTimer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String _promptOf(PracticeQuestion? q) => q?.prompt ?? 'Question';

  String _explanationOf(PracticeQuestion? q) {
    final txt = (q?.explanation ?? '').trim();
    return txt.isEmpty ? 'No explanation available yet.' : txt;
  }

  List<String> _optionsOf(PracticeQuestion? q) =>
      q?.options ?? const <String>[];

  bool _isAnswered(PracticeSessionState state, PracticeQuestion? q) {
    if (q == null) return false;
    return state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(q.id);
  }

  String _modeHeadline(PracticeMode mode) {
    switch (mode) {
      case PracticeMode.practice:
        return 'Balanced practice';
      case PracticeMode.flashcards:
        return 'Recall first';
      case PracticeMode.speedRound:
        return 'Speed pressure';
      case PracticeMode.examPrep:
        return 'Formal exam feel';
      case PracticeMode.conceptBuilder:
        return 'Learn the idea';
      case PracticeMode.adaptive:
        return 'Adaptive session';
      case PracticeMode.bagrut:
        return 'Bagrut-style solving';
    }
  }

  String _modeHint(PracticeMode mode) {
    switch (mode) {
      case PracticeMode.practice:
        return 'Solve normally, then review the explanation.';
      case PracticeMode.flashcards:
        return 'Think first, reveal second, then rate your recall.';
      case PracticeMode.speedRound:
        return 'Tap fast. Your answer locks in immediately.';
      case PracticeMode.examPrep:
        return 'Treat this like a timed school exam question.';
      case PracticeMode.conceptBuilder:
        return 'Read the concept guidance first, then answer.';
      case PracticeMode.adaptive:
        return 'The pace and challenge can shift as the session moves.';
      case PracticeMode.bagrut:
        return 'Use NOVA to solve like a real written exam response.';
    }
  }

  String _buildNovaPrompt(PracticeSessionState state, PracticeQuestion? q) {
    final options = _optionsOf(q);
    final topic = state.filter.topicPath.isEmpty
        ? 'General'
        : state.filter.topicPath.join(' • ');
    final optionsBlock = options.isEmpty
        ? ''
        : '\nOptions:\n${options.asMap().entries.map((e) => '${String.fromCharCode(65 + e.key)}. ${e.value}').join('\n')}';

    final modeBlock = switch (state.filter.mode) {
      PracticeMode.flashcards =>
        'This is FLASHCARDS mode. Help the student recall the fact, then explain it simply.',
      PracticeMode.speedRound =>
        'This is SPEED ROUND mode. Give a direct, quick explanation, then the fastest way to recognize the answer next time.',
      PracticeMode.examPrep =>
        'This is EXAM PREP mode. Solve carefully, justify the final answer, and mention common traps.',
      PracticeMode.conceptBuilder =>
        'This is CONCEPT BUILDER mode. Teach the concept first, then connect it to the exact question.',
      PracticeMode.adaptive =>
        'This is ADAPTIVE mode. Judge the level of the question and respond at the right difficulty.',
      PracticeMode.bagrut =>
        'This is BAGRUT mode. Treat it like a real bagrut question. Write a clean, step-by-step model solution in exam style. If it is open-ended, answer like a student submission.',
      PracticeMode.practice =>
        'This is regular practice mode. Solve step by step and explain the answer clearly.',
    };

    return '''
You are helping inside ClassMate.

Subject: ${state.filter.subject}
Topic: $topic
Mode: ${state.filter.mode.name}
Difficulty: ${state.filter.difficulty.name}

$modeBlock

Question:
${_promptOf(q)}$optionsBlock

Reference explanation:
${_explanationOf(q)}

Also explain why the correct answer is correct.
If there are wrong options, explain why they are wrong too.
''';
  }

  Future<void> _openNova(
    BuildContext context,
    PracticeSessionState state,
    PracticeQuestion? q,
  ) async {
    final prompt = _buildNovaPrompt(state, q);
    final title = state.filter.mode == PracticeMode.bagrut
        ? 'Bagrut solver'
        : ((q?.topicLabel ?? 'Practice explain').trim().isEmpty
              ? 'Practice explain'
              : q!.topicLabel);

    await Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (_) =>
            NovaChatScreen(initialTitle: title, initialPrompt: prompt),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _bindQuestion(PracticeQuestion? q) {
    final currentQuestionId = q?.id.toString();
    if (currentQuestionId != null && _boundQuestionId != currentQuestionId) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (!mounted) return;
        setState(() {
          _boundQuestionId = currentQuestionId;
          _selectedIndex = null;
          _showExplanation = false;
          _flashcardRevealed = false;
        });
      });
    }
  }

  void _queueNext(PracticeSessionController sessionCtl) {
    _autoNextTimer?.cancel();
    _autoNextTimer = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 550), () {
      if (!mounted) return;
      sessionCtl.nextQuestion();
      setState(() {
        _selectedIndex = null;
        _showExplanation = false;
        _flashcardRevealed = false;
      });
    });
  }

  void _submitFlashcard(
    PracticeSessionController sessionCtl,
    PracticeQuestion q, {
    required bool knewIt,
  }) {
    final wrongIndex = q.options.isEmpty
        ? 0
        : (q.correctIndex + 1) % q.options.length;
    sessionCtl.submit(knewIt ? q.correctIndex : wrongIndex);
    setState(() {
      _showExplanation = true;
    });
  }

===== apps/classmate_mobile/lib/features/practice/ui/practice_session_screen.dart.pass20.1773089625.bak =====
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';

import '../providers/practice_providers.dart';
import 'practice_setup_screen.dart';

class PracticeSessionScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const PracticeSessionScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<PracticeSessionScreen> createState() =>
      _PracticeSessionScreenState();
}

class _PracticeSessionScreenState extends ConsumerState<PracticeSessionScreen> {
  int? _selectedIndex;
  bool _showExplanation = false;

  String _promptOf(dynamic q) {
    final p = q?.prompt ?? q?.question ?? '';
    return p.toString();
  }

  String _explanationOf(dynamic q) {
    final e = q?.explanation ?? '';
    if (e.toString().trim().isEmpty) {
      return 'No explanation available yet.';
    }
    return e.toString();
  }

  List<String> _optionsOf(dynamic q) {
    final raw = q?.options ?? q?.choices ?? const [];
    if (raw is List) {
      return raw.map((e) => e.toString()).toList();
    }
    return [];
  }

  Future<void> _askNova(BuildContext context, dynamic q) async {
    final text =
        '''
Explain this question step by step.

Question:
${_promptOf(q)}

Explanation:
${_explanationOf(q)}
''';

    await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: text));

    if (!mounted) return;

    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      const SnackBar(content: Text('Question copied — opening NOVA')),
    );

    context.go('/tutor');
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = ref.watch(practiceSessionProvider);
    final sessionCtl = ref.read(practiceSessionProvider.notifier);
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final cs = theme.colorScheme;

    if (state.questions.isEmpty && !state.isComplete) {
      return const SafeArea(child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()));
    }

    if (state.isComplete) {
      return SafeArea(
        child: Center(
          child: Text(
            'Practice Complete\nXP: ${state.stats.xp}',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: theme.textTheme.headlineSmall,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    final q = state.currentQuestion;
    final options = _optionsOf(q);

    return SafeArea(
      child: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        children: [
          Text(_promptOf(q), style: theme.textTheme.headlineSmall),

          const SizedBox(height: 20),

          for (int i = 0; i < options.length; i++)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
              child: ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  setState(() => _selectedIndex = i);
                },
                child: Text(options[i]),
              ),
            ),

          const SizedBox(height: 10),

          Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: OutlinedButton(
                  onPressed: () {
                    setState(() {
                      _showExplanation = !_showExplanation;
                    });
                  },
                  child: Text(_showExplanation ? 'Hide explain' : 'Explain'),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(
                child: ElevatedButton(
                  onPressed: _selectedIndex == null
                      ? null
                      : () {
                          sessionCtl.submit(_selectedIndex!);
                          setState(() => _showExplanation = true);
                        },
                  child: const Text('Submit'),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),

          const SizedBox(height: 10),

          OutlinedButton.icon(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.psychology),
            label: const Text('Ask NOVA'),
            onPressed: () => _askNova(context, q),
          ),

          const SizedBox(height: 10),

          Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: TextButton(
                  onPressed: () {
                    sessionCtl.skip();
                    setState(() {
                      _selectedIndex = null;
                      _showExplanation = false;
                    });
                  },
                  child: const Text('Skip'),
                ),
              ),
              Expanded(
                child: TextButton(
                  onPressed: () {
                    sessionCtl.nextQuestion();
                    setState(() {
                      _selectedIndex = null;
                      _showExplanation = false;
                    });
                  },
                  child: const Text('Next'),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

    final txt = (q?.explanation ?? '').toString().trim();
    return txt.isEmpty ? 'No explanation available yet.' : txt;
  }

    return raw.map((e) => e.toString()).toList(growable: false);

    if (q == null) return false;
    return state.answersByQuestionId.containsKey(q.id);
  }

  String _modeHeadline(PracticeMode mode) {
    switch (mode) {
      case PracticeMode.flashcards:
        return 'Flashcards';
      case PracticeMode.speedRound:
        return 'Speed round';
      case PracticeMode.examPrep:
        return 'Exam prep';
      case PracticeMode.conceptBuilder:
        return 'Concept builder';
      case PracticeMode.adaptive:
        return 'Adaptive';
      case PracticeMode.bagrut:
        return 'Bagrut';
      case PracticeMode.practice:
        return 'Practice';
    }
  }

  String _modeHint(PracticeMode mode) {
    switch (mode) {
      case PracticeMode.flashcards:
        return 'Memory-first mode. Reveal, self-check, then rate yourself.';
      case PracticeMode.speedRound:
        return 'Fast pressure reps. Lock in quickly and auto-move on.';
      case PracticeMode.examPrep:
        return 'Formal school-style solving with calmer pacing.';
      case PracticeMode.conceptBuilder:
        return 'Learn the rule first, then answer.';
      case PracticeMode.adaptive:

      case PracticeMode.bagrut:
        return 'Formal bagrut-style presentation. Use NOVA for a worked solution.';
      case PracticeMode.practice:
        return 'Balanced daily practice with full feedback.';
    }
  }

    return raw.map((e) => e.toString()).toList(growable: false);

      case PracticeMode.practice:

  String _buildNovaPrompt(PracticeQuestion q, PracticeSessionState state) {
    final optionsText = q.options
        .asMap()
        .entries

Topic: ${state.filter.topicPath.isEmpty ? 'General' : state.filter.topicPath.join(' • ')}

Difficulty: ${state.filter.difficulty.name}

$optionsText

Reference explanation:
${q.explanation}

Give a helpful step-by-step explanation.

If the learner made a mistake, point out exactly what was wrong.

  }

  Future<void> _openNova(
    BuildContext context,
    PracticeQuestion? q,

  ) async {

        return 'Exam prep';
      case PracticeMode.conceptBuilder:
        return 'Concept builder';
      case PracticeMode.adaptive:
        return 'Adaptive';
      case PracticeMode.examPrep:
        return 'Bagrut';
      case PracticeMode.practice:
        return 'Practice';
    }
  }

  String _modeHint(PracticeMode mode) {
    switch (mode) {
      case PracticeMode.flashcards:
        return 'Reveal-first memory mode. Think, reveal, then rate yourself.';
      case PracticeMode.speedRound:
        return 'Fast pressure mode. Pick quickly and move on.';
      case PracticeMode.examPrep:
        return 'Formal school-style pacing with full solving focus.';
      case PracticeMode.conceptBuilder:
        return 'Learn the rule first, then answer the question.';
      case PracticeMode.adaptive:
        return 'Mixed challenge mode with dynamic pacing.';
      case PracticeMode.examPrep:
        return 'Formal bagrut-style presentation. Best used with NOVA for worked solutions.';
      case PracticeMode.practice:
        return 'Balanced day-to-day multiple-choice practice.';
    }
  }

  IconData _modeIcon(PracticeMode mode) {
    switch (mode) {
      case PracticeMode.flashcards:
        return Icons.style_rounded;
      case PracticeMode.speedRound:
        return Icons.flash_on_rounded;
      case PracticeMode.examPrep:

      case PracticeMode.practice:
        return Icons.tune_rounded;
    }
  }

  Color _modeTint(ColorScheme cs, PracticeMode mode) {
    switch (mode) {
      case PracticeMode.flashcards:
        return cs.tertiary.withValues(alpha: 0.14);
      case PracticeMode.speedRound:
        return cs.error.withValues(alpha: 0.10);
      case PracticeMode.examPrep:
        return cs.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.12);
      case PracticeMode.conceptBuilder:
        return cs.secondary.withValues(alpha: 0.12);
      case PracticeMode.adaptive:
        return cs.secondaryContainer.withValues(alpha: 0.35);
      case PracticeMode.examPrep:
        return cs.primaryContainer.withValues(alpha: 0.40);
      case PracticeMode.practice:
        return cs.surfaceContainerHighest.withValues(alpha: 0.50);
    }
  }

  String _buildNovaPrompt(PracticeQuestion q, PracticeSessionState state) {
    final optionsText = q.options
        .asMap()
        .entries
        .map((e) => '${String.fromCharCode(65 + e.key)}. ${e.value}')
        .join('\n');

    return '''
You are helping with a ClassMate practice question.

Subject: ${state.filter.subject}
Topic: ${state.filter.topicPath.isEmpty ? 'General' : state.filter.topicPath.join(' • ')}
Mode: ${state.filter.mode.name}
Difficulty: ${state.filter.difficulty.name}

Question:
${q.prompt}

Options:
$optionsText

Reference explanation:
${q.explanation}

Give a helpful step-by-step explanation.
If this is bagrut mode, solve it formally like a school exam solution.
If the learner made a mistake, point out exactly what was wrong.
''';
  }

  Future<void> _openNova(
    BuildContext context,
    PracticeQuestion? q,
    PracticeSessionState state,
  ) async {
    if (q == null) return;

    final prompt = _buildNovaPrompt(q, state);

    await Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (_) => NovaChatScreen(
          initialTitle: (q.topicLabel).toString(),
          initialPrompt: prompt,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _bindQuestion(PracticeQuestion? q) {
    final currentQuestionId = q?.id.toString();
    if (currentQuestionId == null) return;
    if (_boundQuestionId == currentQuestionId) return;

    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _boundQuestionId = currentQuestionId;
        _selectedIndex = null;
        _showExplanation = false;
        _flashcardRevealed = false;
      });
    });
  }

  void _queueNext(PracticeSessionController sessionCtl) {
    _autoNextTimer?.cancel();
    _autoNextTimer = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 550), () {
      if (!mounted) return;
      sessionCtl.nextQuestion();
      setState(() {
        _selectedIndex = null;
        _showExplanation = false;
        _flashcardRevealed = false;
      });
    });
  }

  void _submitFlashcard(
    PracticeSessionController sessionCtl,
    PracticeQuestion q, {
    required bool knewIt,
  }) {
    final wrongIndex = q.options.isEmpty
        ? 0
        : (q.correctIndex + 1) % q.options.length;

    sessionCtl.submit(knewIt ? q.correctIndex : wrongIndex);

    setState(() {
      _showExplanation = true;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = ref.watch(practiceSessionProvider);
    final sessionCtl = ref.read(practiceSessionProvider.notifier);
    final savedCtl = ref.read(savedQuestionsProvider.notifier);
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final cs = theme.colorScheme;

    if (state.questions.isEmpty && !state.isComplete) {
      return Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: cs.surface,
        body: const SafeArea(child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())),

                        _MetricPill(

class _PracticeSetupScreenState extends ConsumerState<PracticeSetupScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _topicCtl = TextEditingController();

  static const List<String> _subjects = [
    'Math',
    'Physics',
    'Chemistry',
    'Biology',
    'CS',
    'Arabic',
    'Hebrew',
    'English',
    'General Knowledge',
  ];

  static const List<int> _questionCounts = [5, 10, 20, 30, 50];
  static const List<int> _manualTimes = [15, 20, 30, 45, 60];

  List<String> _defaultTopicPath(String subject) {
    switch (subject) {
      case 'Math':
        return const ['Algebra'];
      case 'Physics':
        return const ['Newton 2nd Law'];
      case 'Chemistry':
        return const ['Atoms'];
      case 'Biology':
        return const ['Cells'];
      case 'CS':
        return const ['Big O notation'];
      case 'Arabic':
        return const ['Grammar'];
      case 'Hebrew':
        return const ['Grammar'];
      case 'English':
        return const ['Vocabulary'];
      case 'General Knowledge':
        return const ['Mixed'];
      default:
        return const ['General'];
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _topicCtl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override

            : filter.topicPath.join(' • ').length,
      ),
    );

      body: SafeArea(
        child: ListView(

            _HeroCard(

              accent: cs,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            _SectionCard(
              title: 'Subject',
              child: Wrap(
                spacing: 10,
                runSpacing: 10,
                children: [
                  for (final subject in _subjects)
                    _ChoiceChipButton(
                      label: subject,
                      selected: filter.subject == subject,
                      onTap: () {
                        final nextTopic = _defaultTopicPath(subject);
                        filterCtl.patch(subject: subject, topicPath: nextTopic);
                        sessionCtl.selectOnlyFilter(
                          ref.read(practiceFilterProvider),
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            _SectionCard(
              title: 'Mode',
              child: Wrap(
                spacing: 10,
                runSpacing: 10,

                  for (final mode in PracticeMode.values)
                    _ChoiceChipButton(
                      label: practiceModeLabel(mode),
                      selected: filter.mode == mode,
                      onTap: () {
                        filterCtl.patch(mode: mode);
                        sessionCtl.selectOnlyFilter(
                          ref.read(practiceFilterProvider),
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            _SectionCard(
              title: 'Difficulty',
              child: Wrap(
                spacing: 10,
                runSpacing: 10,
                children: [
                  for (final difficulty in PracticeDifficulty.values)
                    _ChoiceChipButton(
                      label: practiceDifficultyLabel(difficulty),
                      selected: filter.difficulty == difficulty,

    sessionCtl.selectOnlyFilter(ref.read(practiceFilterProvider));

          'Grammar',
          'Vocabulary',
          'Tenses',
          'Reading comprehension',
        ];
      case 'General Knowledge':
        return const ['Science', 'History', 'Geography', 'Technology'];
      default:
        return const ['General'];
    }
  }

  List<String> _defaultTopicPath(String subject) {
    switch (subject) {
      case 'Math':
        return const ['Algebra'];
      case 'Physics':

        return const ['Atoms'];

        return const ['Grammar'];
      case 'General Knowledge':
        return const ['Science'];
      default:

    if (filter.useAiTiming) return 'AI timing';

    final filterCtl = ref.read(practiceFilterProvider.notifier);

    filterCtl.patch(subject: clean, topicPath: const ['General']);

String practiceModeLabel(PracticeMode mode) {
  switch (mode) {
    case PracticeMode.practice:
      return 'Practice';
    case PracticeMode.flashcards:
      return 'Flashcards';
    case PracticeMode.speedRound:
      return 'Speed round';
    case PracticeMode.examPrep:
      return 'Exam prep';
    case PracticeMode.conceptBuilder:
      return 'Concept builder';
    case PracticeMode.adaptive:
      return 'Adaptive';
  }
}

String practiceModeDescription(PracticeMode mode) {
  switch (mode) {
    case PracticeMode.practice:
      return 'Balanced quiz flow. Standard timing, standard answering, standard review.';
    case PracticeMode.flashcards:
      return 'Memory-first format. Think, reveal, then move on. Great for fast retention work.';
    case PracticeMode.speedRound:
      return 'Pressure format. Short timer, fast lock-in, quick auto-advance.';
    case PracticeMode.examPrep:
      return 'Test-style format. Longer timing, more serious wording, exam feel.';
    case PracticeMode.conceptBuilder:
      return 'Teaching format. Explanation is part of the question flow so the concept clicks first.';
    case PracticeMode.adaptive:
      return 'Dynamic format. The session can mix easier and harder questions instead of staying flat.';
  }
}

String practiceDifficultyLabel(PracticeDifficulty difficulty) {
  switch (difficulty) {
    case PracticeDifficulty.easy:
      return 'Easy';
    case PracticeDifficulty.medium:
      return 'Medium';
    case PracticeDifficulty.hard:
      return 'Hard';
    case PracticeDifficulty.olympiad:
      return 'Olympiad';
    case PracticeDifficulty.adaptive:
      return 'Adaptive';
  }
}

  List<String> _suggestedTopics(String subject) {
    switch (subject) {

    case PracticeMode.speedRound:

    case PracticeMode.examPrep:

String practiceModeSubtitle(PracticeMode mode) {
  switch (mode) {
    case PracticeMode.flashcards:
      return 'Reveal first, then self-check.';
    case PracticeMode.speedRound:
      return 'Fast reps with quick pressure.';
    case PracticeMode.examPrep:
      return 'Formal school-style solving.';
    case PracticeMode.conceptBuilder:

IconData practiceModeIcon(PracticeMode mode) {
  switch (mode) {
    case PracticeMode.flashcards:
      return Icons.style_rounded;
    case PracticeMode.speedRound:
      return Icons.flash_on_rounded;
    case PracticeMode.examPrep:
      return Icons.assignment_rounded;
    case PracticeMode.conceptBuilder:
      return Icons.school_rounded;
    case PracticeMode.adaptive:
      return Icons.auto_awesome_rounded;
    case PracticeMode.practice:
      return Icons.tune_rounded;
  }
}

Color practiceModeTint(ColorScheme cs, PracticeMode mode) {
  switch (mode) {
    case PracticeMode.flashcards:
      return cs.tertiary.withValues(alpha: 0.18);
    case PracticeMode.speedRound:
      return cs.error.withValues(alpha: 0.14);
    case PracticeMode.examPrep:
      return cs.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.18);
    case PracticeMode.conceptBuilder:
      return cs.secondary.withValues(alpha: 0.18);
    case PracticeMode.adaptive:
      return cs.secondaryContainer.withValues(alpha: 0.30);
    case PracticeMode.practice:
      return cs.surfaceContainerHighest.withValues(alpha: 0.45);
  }
}

class _PracticeSetupScreenState extends ConsumerState<PracticeSetupScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _topicCtl = TextEditingController();

  static const List<String> _subjects = [
    'Math',
    'Physics',
    'Chemistry',
    'Biology',
    'CS',
    'Arabic',
    'Hebrew',
    'English',
    'General Knowledge',
  ];

  static const List<int> _questionCounts = [5, 10, 20, 30, 50];
  static const List<int> _manualTimes = [15, 20, 30, 45, 60];

  List<String> _defaultTopicPath(String subject) {
    switch (subject) {
      case 'Math':
        return const ['Algebra'];
      case 'Physics':
        return const ['Newton 2nd Law'];
      case 'Chemistry':
        return const ['Atoms'];
      case 'Biology':
        return const ['Cells'];
      case 'CS':
        return const ['Big O notation'];
      case 'Arabic':
        return const ['Grammar'];
      case 'Hebrew':
        return const ['Grammar'];
      case 'English':
        return const ['Vocabulary'];
      case 'General Knowledge':
        return const ['Mixed'];
      default:
        return const ['General'];
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _topicCtl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final filter = ref.watch(practiceFilterProvider);
    final filterCtl = ref.read(practiceFilterProvider.notifier);
    final sessionCtl = ref.read(practiceSessionProvider.notifier);
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final cs = theme.colorScheme;

    _topicCtl.value = TextEditingValue(
      text: filter.topicPath.isEmpty ? '' : filter.topicPath.join(' • '),
      selection: TextSelection.collapsed(
        offset: filter.topicPath.isEmpty
            ? 0
            : filter.topicPath.join(' • ').length,
      ),
    );

    return Scaffold(
      body: SafeArea(
        child: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 28),
          children: [
            _HeroCard(
              title: 'Practice Arena',
              subtitle:
                  'Build your own endless AI practice flow. Pick the subject, mode, difficulty, topic, question count, and timing.',
              accent: cs,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            _SectionCard(
              title: 'Subject',
              child: Wrap(
                spacing: 10,
                runSpacing: 10,
                children: [
                  for (final subject in _subjects)
                    _ChoiceChipButton(
                      label: subject,
                      selected: filter.subject == subject,
                      onTap: () {
                        final nextTopic = _defaultTopicPath(subject);
                        filterCtl.patch(subject: subject, topicPath: nextTopic);
                        sessionCtl.selectOnlyFilter(
                          ref.read(practiceFilterProvider),
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            _SectionCard(
              title: 'Mode',
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Wrap(
                    spacing: 10,
                    runSpacing: 10,
                    children: [
                      for (final mode in PracticeMode.values)
                        _ChoiceChipButton(
                          label: practiceModeLabel(mode),
                          selected: filter.mode == mode,
                          onTap: () {
                            filterCtl.patch(mode: mode);
                            sessionCtl.selectOnlyFilter(
                              ref.read(practiceFilterProvider),
                            );
                          },
                        ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Container(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: cs.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                      border: Border.all(

                children: [
                  for (final difficulty in PracticeDifficulty.values)
                    _ChoiceChipButton(

              child: const Text(

                        runSpacing: 8,
                        children: [
                          _Pill(label: q.subject),
                          _Pill(label: q.topicLabel),
                          _Pill(label: 'practice'),
                          _Pill(label: 'medium'),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      DefaultTextStyle.merge(
                        style: theme.textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                        ),
                        child: CMRichContent(data: q.prompt),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 10),
                      Text(
                        'Correct answer: ${q.options[q.correctIndex]}',
                        style: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      DefaultTextStyle.merge(

                ),

===== apps/classmate_mobile/lib/features/schedule/data/schedule_repository.dart =====
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

import '../../../core/auth/auth_controller.dart';
import '../../../core/http/cm_api.dart';

const _devStudentToken = 'dev-token-student@classmate.local';

final scheduleRepositoryProvider = Provider<ScheduleRepository>((ref) {
  final session = ref.watch(authSessionProvider);
  final token = (session.token ?? '').trim();
  return ScheduleRepository(token: token.isEmpty ? _devStudentToken : token);
});

class ScheduleRepository {
  ScheduleRepository({required this.token});

  final String token;

  CMApi get _api => CMApi(token: token);

  String _weekYmd(DateTime d) {
    final x = DateTime.utc(d.year, d.month, d.day);
    final y = x.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0');
    final m = x.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final day = x.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    return '$y-$m-$day';
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> getWeek(DateTime weekOf) async {
    final ymd = _weekYmd(weekOf);
    final requestedWeek = DateTime.parse('${ymd}T00:00:00.000Z');

    try {
      final raw = await _api.getJson(
        '/student/schedule/week',
        query: <String, String>{'weekOf': ymd},
      );
      final normalized = _normalizeWeek(raw, requestedWeek);

      final days = (normalized['days'] as List?) ?? const [];
      if (days.isNotEmpty) {
        return normalized;
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    return _devFallbackSchedule(weekOf: requestedWeek);
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> _normalizeWeek(dynamic raw, DateTime requestedWeek) {
    final weekIso = requestedWeek.toIso8601String();

    if (raw is Map<String, dynamic>) {
      final copy = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw);
      copy['weekOf'] ??= weekIso;
      copy['startOfWeek'] ??= weekIso;

      final dynamic rawDays =
          copy['days'] ?? copy['week'] ?? copy['entries'] ?? copy['items'];

      if (rawDays is List) {
        copy['days'] = _normalizeDays(rawDays, requestedWeek);
      } else {
        copy['days'] = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      }

      copy['isEmpty'] = (copy['days'] as List).isEmpty;
      return copy;
    }

    if (raw is List) {
      return <String, dynamic>{
        'weekOf': weekIso,
        'startOfWeek': weekIso,
        'title': 'Week Schedule',
        'days': _normalizeDays(raw, requestedWeek),
        'isEmpty': raw.isEmpty,
      };
    }

    return <String, dynamic>{
      'weekOf': weekIso,
      'startOfWeek': weekIso,
      'title': 'Week Schedule',
      'days': <Map<String, dynamic>>[],
      'isEmpty': true,
    };
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _normalizeDays(
    List rawDays,
    DateTime requestedWeek,
  ) {
    if (rawDays.isEmpty) {
      return <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    }

    if (rawDays.first is Map) {
      return rawDays
          .map<Map<String, dynamic>>((dynamic rawDay) {
            final day = Map<String, dynamic>.from(rawDay as Map);

            final dynamic itemsRaw =
                day['items'] ??
                day['entries'] ??
                day['lessons'] ??
                day['slots'] ??
                const [];

            final items = itemsRaw is List
                ? itemsRaw
                      .map<Map<String, dynamic>>((dynamic rawItem) {
                        if (rawItem is Map) {
                          return Map<String, dynamic>.from(rawItem);
                        }
                        return <String, dynamic>{'title': rawItem.toString()};
                      })
                      .toList(growable: false)
                : <Map<String, dynamic>>[];

            day['items'] = items;
            day['entries'] = items;
            day['lessons'] = items;
            day['label'] ??= day['title'] ?? day['name'] ?? '';
            day['date'] ??= day['day'] ?? requestedWeek.toIso8601String();
            return day;
          })
          .toList(growable: false);
    }

    final grouped = <String, List<Map<String, dynamic>>>{};

    for (final rawItem in rawDays) {
      final item = rawItem is Map
          ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(rawItem)
          : <String, dynamic>{'title': rawItem.toString()};

      final key = (item['date'] ?? item['day'] ?? item['label'] ?? 'Day')
          .toString();
      grouped.putIfAbsent(key, () => <Map<String, dynamic>>[]).add(item);
    }

    return grouped.entries
        .map<Map<String, dynamic>>((entry) {
          return <String, dynamic>{
            'label': entry.key,
            'date': entry.key,
            'items': entry.value,
            'entries': entry.value,
            'lessons': entry.value,
          };
        })
        .toList(growable: false);
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> _devFallbackSchedule({required DateTime weekOf}) {
    final start = DateTime.utc(weekOf.year, weekOf.month, weekOf.day);

    String iso(int dayOffset, int hour, int minute) {
      return start
          .add(Duration(days: dayOffset, hours: hour, minutes: minute))
          .toIso8601String();
    }

    Map<String, dynamic> item({
      required String id,
      required String title,
      required String room,
      required String teacherName,
      required int dayOffset,
      required int startHour,
      required int startMinute,
      required int endHour,
      required int endMinute,
    }) {
      return <String, dynamic>{
        'id': id,
        'title': title,
        'subject': title,
        'room': room,
        'teacherName': teacherName,
        'startAt': iso(dayOffset, startHour, startMinute),
        'endAt': iso(dayOffset, endHour, endMinute),
      };
    }

    final days = <Map<String, dynamic>>[
      <String, dynamic>{

import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

import '../../../core/auth/auth_controller.dart';
import '../../../core/http/cm_api.dart';

const _devStudentToken = 'dev-token-student@classmate.local';

final scheduleRepositoryProvider = Provider<ScheduleRepository>((ref) {
  final session = ref.watch(authSessionProvider);
  final token = (session.token ?? '').trim();
  return ScheduleRepository(token: token.isEmpty ? _devStudentToken : token);
});

class ScheduleRepository {
  String _weekYmd(DateTime d) {
    final x = DateTime.utc(d.year, d.month, d.day);
    final y = x.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0');
    final m = x.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final day = x.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    return '$y-$m-$day';
  }

  ScheduleRepository({required this.token});

  final String token;

  CMApi get _api => CMApi(token: token);

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> getWeek(DateTime weekOf) async {
    final ymd = _weekYmd(weekOf);
    final raw = await _api.getJson(
      '/student/schedule/week',
      query: <String, String>{'weekOf': ymd},
    );
    return _normalizeWeek(
      raw,
      DateTime.parse(
        '$ymd'
        'T00:00:00.000Z',
      ),
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> _normalizeWeek(dynamic raw, DateTime requestedWeek) {
    final weekIso = requestedWeek.toIso8601String();

    if (raw is Map<String, dynamic>) {
      final copy = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw);
      copy['weekOf'] ??= weekIso;
      copy['startOfWeek'] ??= weekIso;

      final dynamic rawDays =
          copy['days'] ?? copy['week'] ?? copy['entries'] ?? copy['items'];

      if (rawDays is List) {
        copy['days'] = _normalizeDays(rawDays, requestedWeek);
      } else {
        copy['days'] = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      }

      copy['isEmpty'] = (copy['days'] as List).isEmpty;
      return copy;
    }

    if (raw is List) {
      return <String, dynamic>{
        'weekOf': weekIso,
        'startOfWeek': weekIso,
        'title': 'Week Schedule',
        'days': _normalizeDays(raw, requestedWeek),
        'isEmpty': raw.isEmpty,
      };
    }

    return <String, dynamic>{
      'weekOf': weekIso,
      'startOfWeek': weekIso,
      'title': 'Week Schedule',
      'days': <Map<String, dynamic>>[],
      'isEmpty': true,
    };
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _normalizeDays(
    List rawDays,
    DateTime requestedWeek,
  ) {
    if (rawDays.isEmpty) {
      return <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    }

    if (rawDays.first is Map) {
      return rawDays
          .map<Map<String, dynamic>>((dynamic rawDay) {
            final day = Map<String, dynamic>.from(rawDay as Map);

            final dynamic itemsRaw =
                day['items'] ??
                day['entries'] ??
                day['lessons'] ??
                day['slots'] ??
                const [];

            final items = itemsRaw is List
                ? itemsRaw
                      .map<Map<String, dynamic>>((dynamic rawItem) {
                        if (rawItem is Map) {
                          return Map<String, dynamic>.from(rawItem);
                        }
                        return <String, dynamic>{'title': rawItem.toString()};
                      })
                      .toList(growable: false)
                : <Map<String, dynamic>>[];

            day['items'] = items;
            day['entries'] = items;
            day['lessons'] = items;
            day['label'] ??= day['title'] ?? day['name'] ?? '';
            day['date'] ??= day['day'] ?? requestedWeek.toIso8601String();
            return day;
          })
          .toList(growable: false);
    }

    final grouped = <String, List<Map<String, dynamic>>>{};

    for (final rawItem in rawDays) {
      final item = rawItem is Map
          ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(rawItem)
          : <String, dynamic>{'title': rawItem.toString()};

      final key = (item['date'] ?? item['day'] ?? item['label'] ?? 'Day')
          .toString();
      grouped.putIfAbsent(key, () => <Map<String, dynamic>>[]).add(item);
    }

    return grouped.entries
        .map<Map<String, dynamic>>((entry) {
          return <String, dynamic>{
            'label': entry.key,
            'date': entry.key,
            'items': entry.value,
            'entries': entry.value,
            'lessons': entry.value,
          };
        })
        .toList(growable: false);
  }
}

class _ScheduleScreenState extends ConsumerState<ScheduleScreen> {
  late DateTime _selectedDate;

  String _friendlyScheduleError(Object error) {
    final raw = error.toString();
    if (raw.contains('HTTP 429') || raw.contains('Too Many Requests')) {
      return 'Schedule is refreshing too fast right now. Wait a moment and try again.';
    }
    if (raw.contains('Student not onboarded')) {
      return 'Your student profile is not fully set up yet. Showing a demo schedule for now.';
    }
    return 'Could not load schedule yet.';
  }

  Future<void> _retryWeek(String weekOf) async {
    ref.invalidate(weekScheduleProvider(weekOf));
    await ref.read(weekScheduleProvider(weekOf).future);
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _selectedDate = _dateOnly(DateTime.now());
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final weekOf = _weekStartYmd(_selectedDate);
    final weekAsync = ref.watch(weekScheduleProvider(weekOf));
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final cs = theme.colorScheme;

    return RefreshIndicator(
      onRefresh: () => _retryWeek(weekOf),
      child: GestureDetector(
        onHorizontalDragEnd: (details) {
          final v = details.primaryVelocity ?? 0;
          if (v < -50) {
            _shiftDay(1);
          } else if (v > 50) {
            _shiftDay(-1);
          }
        },
        child: ListView(
          keyboardDismissBehavior: ScrollViewKeyboardDismissBehavior.onDrag,
          physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 24),
          children: [
            weekAsync.when(
              data: (data) => _heroCard(context, data),
              loading: () => _heroLoadingCard(context),
              error: (error, _) =>
                  _heroErrorCard(context, _friendlyScheduleError(error), () {
                    _retryWeek(weekOf);
                  }),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            AnimatedContainer(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 350),
              curve: Curves.easeOut,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: cs.surfaceContainerHighest.withValues(alpha: 0.45),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: cs.outlineVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                ),
              ),
              child: Row(

                  _navBtn(

                    onTap: () => _shiftDay(-1),

  ConsumerState<ScheduleScreen> createState() => _ScheduleScreenState();

class _ScheduleScreenState extends ConsumerState<ScheduleScreen> {
  late DateTime _selectedDate;

  String _friendlyScheduleError(Object error) {
    final raw = error.toString();
    if (raw.contains('HTTP 429') || raw.contains('Too Many Requests')) {
      return 'Schedule is refreshing too fast right now. Wait a moment and try again.';
    }
    if (raw.contains('Student not onboarded')) {
      return 'Your student profile is not fully set up yet.';
    }
    return 'Could not load schedule.';
  }

  Future<void> _retryWeek(String weekOf) async {
    ref.invalidate(weekScheduleProvider(weekOf));
    await ref.read(weekScheduleProvider(weekOf).future);
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _selectedDate = _dateOnly(DateTime.now());
  }

    final weekAsync = ref.watch(weekScheduleProvider(weekOf));
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final cs = theme.colorScheme;

    return RefreshIndicator(
      onRefresh: () => _retryWeek(weekOf),
      child: GestureDetector(
        onHorizontalDragEnd: (details) {
          final v = details.primaryVelocity ?? 0;
          if (v < -50) {
            _shiftDay(1);
          } else if (v > 50) {
            _shiftDay(-1);

          keyboardDismissBehavior: ScrollViewKeyboardDismissBehavior.onDrag,

                    _retryWeek(weekOf);
                  }),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),

              data: (data) => _daySection(context, data),
              loading: () => const _LoadingState(),
              error: (error, _) => _ErrorState(
                message: _friendlyScheduleError(error),
                onRetry: () {
                  _retryWeek(weekOf);
                },
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

        ),
        child: Icon(icon),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _daySection(BuildContext context, Map<String, dynamic> data) {
    final items = _itemsForSelectedDate(data);

    if (items.isEmpty) {
      return _EmptyState(
        icon: Icons.free_breakfast_rounded,
        title: 'No classes on this day',
        subtitle: '${_weekdayLong(_selectedDate)} looks clear.',
      );
    }

    final sorted = [...items]
      ..sort((a, b) {
        final ap = (a['period'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 999;
        final bp = (b['period'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 999;
        if (ap != bp) return ap.compareTo(bp);
        return _startsAt(a).compareTo(_startsAt(b));
      });

    final theme = Theme.of(context);

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(
          _weekdayLong(_selectedDate),
          style: theme.textTheme.headlineSmall?.copyWith(
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
            letterSpacing: -0.4,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        Text(
          _friendlyDate(_ymd(_selectedDate)),
          style: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
            color: cs.onSurfaceVariant,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 14),
        ...sorted.map(
          (item) => Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
            child: _ScheduleTile(item: item),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

    final raw = error.toString();
    if (raw.contains('HTTP 429') || raw.contains('Too Many Requests')) {

    }
    if (raw.contains('Student not onboarded')) {
      return 'Your student profile is not fully set up yet.';
    }
    return 'Could not load schedule.';

  Widget _daySection(BuildContext context, Map<String, dynamic> data) {
    final items = _itemsForSelectedDate(data);

    if (items.isEmpty) {
      return _EmptyState(
        icon: Icons.free_breakfast_rounded,
        title: 'No classes on this day',
        subtitle: '${_weekdayLong(_selectedDate)} looks clear.',
      );
    }

    final sorted = [...items]
      ..sort((a, b) {
        final ap = (a['period'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 999;
        final bp = (b['period'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 999;
        if (ap != bp) return ap.compareTo(bp);
        return _startsAt(a).compareTo(_startsAt(b));
      });

    final theme = Theme.of(context);

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(
          _weekdayLong(_selectedDate),
          style: theme.textTheme.headlineSmall?.copyWith(
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
            letterSpacing: -0.4,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        Text(
          _friendlyDate(_ymd(_selectedDate)),
          style: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
            color: cs.onSurfaceVariant,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 14),
        ...sorted.map(
          (item) => Padding(

  ConsumerState<ScheduleScreen> createState() => _ScheduleScreenState();
}

class _ScheduleScreenState extends ConsumerState<ScheduleScreen> {
  late DateTime _selectedDate;

  String _friendlyScheduleError(Object error) {
    final raw = error.toString();
    if (raw.contains('HTTP 429') || raw.contains('Too Many Requests')) {
      return 'Schedule is refreshing too fast right now. Wait a moment and try again.';
    }
    if (raw.contains('Student not onboarded')) {
      return 'Your student profile is not fully set up yet.';
    }
    return 'Could not load schedule.';
  }

  Future<void> _retryWeek(String weekOf) async {
    ref.invalidate(weekScheduleProvider(weekOf));
    await ref.read(weekScheduleProvider(weekOf).future);
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _selectedDate = _dateOnly(DateTime.now());
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final weekOf = _weekStartYmd(_selectedDate);
    final weekAsync = ref.watch(weekScheduleProvider(weekOf));
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final cs = theme.colorScheme;

    return RefreshIndicator(
      onRefresh: () => _retryWeek(weekOf),
      child: GestureDetector(
        onHorizontalDragEnd: (details) {
          final v = details.primaryVelocity ?? 0;
          if (v < -50) {
            _shiftDay(1);
          } else if (v > 50) {
            _shiftDay(-1);
          }
        },
        child: ListView(
          keyboardDismissBehavior: ScrollViewKeyboardDismissBehavior.onDrag,
          physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 24),
          children: [
            weekAsync.when(
              data: (data) => _heroCard(context, data),
              loading: () => _heroLoadingCard(context),
              error: (error, _) =>
                  _heroErrorCard(context, _friendlyScheduleError(error), () {
                    _retryWeek(weekOf);
                  }),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            AnimatedContainer(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 350),
              curve: Curves.easeOut,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: cs.surfaceContainerHighest.withValues(alpha: 0.45),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: cs.outlineVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                ),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  _navBtn(
                    context,
                    icon: Icons.chevron_left_rounded,
                    onTap: () => _shiftDay(-1),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Expanded(
                    child: InkWell(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                      onTap: () => _pickDate(context),
                      child: Ink(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 14,
                          vertical: 14,
                        ),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: cs.surface.withValues(alpha: 0.72),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                          border: Border.all(
                            color: cs.outlineVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                          ),
                        ),
                        child: Row(
                          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                          children: [
                            const Icon(Icons.calendar_month_rounded, size: 18),
                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
                            Flexible(
                              child: Text(
                                '${_friendlyDate(_ymd(_selectedDate))} · ${_weekdayLong(_selectedDate)}',
                                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                style: theme.textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                  letterSpacing: -0.2,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),

                  const SizedBox(width: 10),

                    onTap: () => _shiftDay(1),

  }

  Widget _heroCard(BuildContext context, Map<String, dynamic> data) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final cs = theme.colorScheme;
    final days = _weekDays(data);
    final selectedItems = _itemsForSelectedDate(data);
    final next = selectedItems.isNotEmpty ? selectedItems.first : null;

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(26),
        gradient: LinearGradient(

                    '${days.fold<int>(0, (sum, day) => sum + (((day['items'] as List?)?.length) ?? 0))} classes · ${days.where((day) => ((day['items'] as List?)?.isNotEmpty ?? false)).length} active days',
              ),
              _statPill(
                context,
                icon: Icons.schedule_rounded,
                label: 'Next up',
                value: next == null

                value:
                    '${selectedItems.length} planned · ${selectedItems.where((item) => _isPastItem(item)).length} done',
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),

  String _friendlyScheduleError(Object error) {
    final raw = error.toString();
    if (raw.contains('HTTP 429') || raw.contains('Too Many Requests')) {
      return 'Schedule is refreshing too fast right now. Wait a moment and try again.';
    }
    if (raw.contains('Student not onboarded')) {
      return 'Your student profile is not fully set up yet.';
    }
    return 'Could not load schedule.';
  }

  Future<void> _retryWeek(String weekOf) async {
    ref.invalidate(weekScheduleProvider(weekOf));
    await ref.read(weekScheduleProvider(weekOf).future);
  }

  }

  int? _parsePeriod(dynamic v) {
    if (v == null) {
    if (v == null)  return null;
    if (v == null)}

    if (v is int) {
    if (v is int)  return v;
    if (v is int)}

    final s = v.toString().trim();
    if (s.isEmpty) {
    if (s.isEmpty)  return null;
    if (s.isEmpty)}

    return int.tryParse(s);
  }

  String _s(dynamic v) => (v ?? '').toString().trim();

  DateTime? _parseTimeOnSelectedDate(DateTime selectedDate, String raw) {
    final x = raw.trim();
    if (x.isEmpty) {
    if (x.isEmpty)  return null;
    if (x.isEmpty)}

    // HH:mm
    final m = RegExp(r'^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})').firstMatch(x);
    if (m != null) {
      final hh = int.tryParse(m.group(1) ?? '');
      final mm = int.tryParse(m.group(2) ?? '');
      if (hh == null || mm == null) {
      if (hh == null || mm == null)  return null;
      if (hh == null || mm == null)}

      return DateTime(
        selectedDate.year,
        selectedDate.month,
        selectedDate.day,
        hh,
        mm,
      );
    }

    // ISO DateTime
    final dt = DateTime.tryParse(x);
    if (dt != null) {
      return DateTime(
        selectedDate.year,
        selectedDate.month,
        selectedDate.day,
        dt.hour,
        dt.minute,
      );
    }

    return null;
  }

  bool _isOngoing({
    required DateTime selectedDate,
    required String startsAt,
    required String endsAt,
  }) {
    final today = _dateOnly(DateTime.now());
    if (_dateOnly(selectedDate) {
    if (_dateOnly(selectedDate)  != today) return false;
    if (_dateOnly(selectedDate)}

    if (st == null || et == null) {
    if (st == null || et == null)  return false;
    if (st == null || et == null)}

    final now = DateTime.now();
    return now.isAfter(st) && now.isBefore(et);
  }
